jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **What The Role Is** As a **Staff Machine Learning Engineer** at Babylist, you own personalization and decide where it goes. Millions of families depend on what we build. Agents write most of the code now. So the hard part is yours: what to model, how it should work and whether what shipped actually helped. You're still in the code for the genuinely hard problems — the embeddings, the ranking, the systems that don't exist yet. Agents handle the volume. You spend your time on the parts that need a person. We're building well beyond the registry now: the financial side of raising a kid, maternal health made simpler and more human, the education new parents are looking for and the community around them. Personalization runs across all of it — the homepage feed, what we recommend next, search — plus the platform underneath and the AI we already ship to families. You'll own a big piece of how personalization works, but you won't be boxed into it. The roadmap is open. You have a say in which bets we make, and you pick what you take on next. #### **What You'll Own** A Staff MLE here sets direction. You own personalization as a domain: the models behind the homepage feed, add\-next recommendations and search personalization, and the foundational representations several teams build on. You set where it's going over the next year or two, sequence the bets that get there and make the technical and product calls along the way. You're still in the code. We don't have architects who've stopped building. If you stepped away, multiple teams would feel it. Your models show up on the surfaces millions of families use, and in the work other teams choose to build on top of them. You don't need direct reports to have that reach. It comes from what you build. In practice, you: * Take a fuzzy business problem from the first sketch through to a production model, and stay on the hook for whether it actually helped customers. * Build custom embeddings from raw data — domain\-specific representations that go well beyond off\-the\-shelf image and text models — and own them as several surfaces adopt them. * Make the modeling and architecture calls that span teams and the ones that are expensive to reverse. * Own the full lifecycle: orchestration, deployment, monitoring and the retraining loop that keeps a model honest in production. * Set the standard for how personalization builds with AI. Decide what good looks like, build the evals that catch a model that's confidently wrong before it ships. * Partner with product, design and data as a peer, shaping what's worth building from the start. * Coach Senior engineers through the hard calls, the ambiguous ones as much as the technical ones. A few problems people at this level are working on right now: * Building the foundational embeddings that let every surface — feed, recommendations, search — personalize from one shared representation instead of each team rebuilding it. * Resolving one customer across registry, shop and health, plus the friends and family buying for them, so recommendations work everywhere. * Deciding what the registry recommends to each family, from the ranking to the model behind it, and proving in a live experiment that it actually helps. #### **Who You Are** You've shipped production ML for enough years to have earned strong opinions, and you hold them loosely. You can pick up an ambiguous problem and start moving before anyone hands you the full picture. You've already changed how a team builds with AI, and the new way stuck. You've built recommender systems or personalization that reached real users at scale, and you can point to what moved because of it. You're deep in the Python ML ecosystem (pandas, scikit\-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch) and fluent across the whole lifecycle, from orchestration to monitoring, not just training. The thing that sets you apart: you build custom representations from raw data instead of reaching for the off\-the\-shelf embedding. A few things that tend to be true of people who thrive here: * You measure yourself by impact: a customer outcome, or a model a dozen surfaces come to depend on. * You go zero\-to\-one: define the problem space, architect from scratch and own it end to end. * You're curious: you spot problems before they're filed and push your own ideas until they ship. #### **Compensation** We post real numbers. For a US\-based Staff Engineer, the starting base salary range is $233,500 to $290,700, plus a target annual bonus of 20 percent of base. That's total target cash of roughly $280,200 to $348,840\. On top of that you get meaningful equity and a 401(k) match. Where you start in that range depends on your experience, and your pay grows from there with performance and scope. **How We Build** AI is the default here. Engineers run agentic sessions for most of the work, and a lot of the interesting engineering now lives in the scaffolding that makes the agents good: the eval harnesses, the curated context, custom review skills and fast CI. Agents also triage incidents and handle a big share of support. A human always owns the outcome. The architecture is intentionally simple: one Rails monolith, MySQL and few moving parts. That's deliberate. Simple infrastructure lets us move fast and lets AI reason about the whole system, so the hardest problems are the ones in front of customers. **The Stack** * **Core app:** Rails, Packwerk, React, TypeScript, Sidekiq * **Mobile:** iOS (Swift), Android (Kotlin) * **Data, search \& events:** MySQL, Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, Weaviate, WarpStream, Hex, Sigma * **Machine learning:** deep learning, matrix factorization, retrieval \& ranking, AWS SageMaker, MLflow * **AI \& dev tooling:** Claude Code, Devin, Linear, CodeRabbit, Warden, LangChain, Bedrock AgentCore, Maxim * **Infra \& ops:** AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Datadog, incident.io, LaunchDarkly * **Key integrations:** Shopify (payments), Iterable (CRM) #### **Why Babylist** An engineer, expecting her first baby, couldn't find the registry she wanted. So she built it. That's how Babylist started, and it's still how we work: engineers solving problems for families. Becoming a parent is one of the biggest moments in a person's life. Millions reach it for the first time every year, making thousands of decisions and figuring it out as they go. That's who we build for, and we're a long way from done. Ten million people give gifts through Babylist every year. We did more than $750M in revenue in 2025, up 45 percent over the year before, and we've been profitable for eight years while staying independent. So you can take on a hard, multi\-year problem without watching over your shoulder for the next round or the next correction. And the team is small, around 65 engineers, so what you ship stays visible and your scope stays wide. #### **How We Work** Remote\-first across the US and Canada, and we have been for years. That's not changing. We trust you to own your time and your outcomes, and we get everyone in a room together twice a year. Teams are small, pods of three to five engineers, so nothing you ship disappears into a committee. You'll work shoulder to shoulder with product, design and data, and with the partners across the business who rely on what you ship. You'll also stay close to customers yourself: sitting in on user interviews, watching session recordings, riding along with support. Here that's part of the engineering job, on a regular basis. #### **How We Hire** Three rounds, usually two to three weeks start to finish. * **Recruiter conversation (30 minutes).** Trade context: what you want next, what we're building and straight answers on comp, team and remote. * **Technical screen (1 hour).** One round, no AI, language\-agnostic. Reach for Google when you normally would. We just want to see how you reason from first principles. * **Final round (4 hours).** Four one\-hour interviews: system design, AI\-assisted coding with the tools you'd actually use here, product sense and culture and values. You'll hear back either way within 24 to 48 hours. If your timeline is tight, tell us and we'll move faster. #### **Benefits** * Company\-paid medical and fully covered dental and vision * A 401(k) match * Generous paid parental leave for birthing and non\-birthing parents, plus a gradual return\-to\-work program * Winter Wonder Week, a paid company\-wide week off at the end of the year * A remote\-work stipend * Mental\-health and wellness support #### **A Few Things To Know** * We record and transcribe interviews to evaluate candidates, in line with applicable privacy laws. * We expect you to use AI in your work and we welcome it in the process, but what you submit and say should reflect your own thinking. * If you have a family member or close relationship with a Babylist employee, let your recruiter know. * Official outreach only ever comes from an @babylist.com address

jobs.title: Customer Experience Specialist
jobs.description: Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at\-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at\-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology. **What you will be doing:** --------------------------- The Customer Experience Specialist will join Beacon's Customer Experience team and report to the Manager of Customer Experience. This role does not have direct reports. This is a highly customer\-facing role combining frontline customer support with hands\-on technical troubleshooting across Beacon's software, devices, customer environments, and healthcare workflows. You will work directly with healthcare professionals, sleep laboratories, medical practices, customer IT teams, and Beacon colleagues to solve problems ranging from account and workflow questions to complex software, hardware, and customer\-environment issues. This role is designed for someone who enjoys solving problems with customers, not simply routing them elsewhere. Successful candidates will be comfortable moving fluidly between frontline customer support and advanced technical troubleshooting. You will investigate issues, reproduce problems, gather technical evidence, identify potential causes, resolve issues independently whenever possible, and partner with specialized internal technical teams when deeper engineering, development, system access, or expertise is required. The Customer Experience team operates in a high\-volume, rapidly evolving environment. This role requires someone who can manage competing priorities, maintain ownership across multiple customer needs, and adapt as Beacon's customer base, products, and support requirements continue to scale. Clinical and sleep\-medicine experience is highly valued, as is experience in healthcare technology, medical devices, application support, or technical customer support. These positions are fully remote and U.S.\-based. This position is 8 AM \- 5 PM PT. Candidates may reside anywhere in the United States. Travel of up to approximately 20% may be required based on company needs, including customer visits, conferences, training, and departmental or company meetings. Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first\-class remote work experience, but we also have in\-person office hubs available located in Boston and New York. **What success looks like:** ---------------------------- * Serve as a highly responsive and professional point of contact for customers through phone, ticket, email, virtual meetings, and other support channels. * Provide reliable coverage in a **high\-volume customer support environment**, balancing responsiveness with thoughtful investigation, ownership, and resolution. * Take ownership of customer issues from initial contact through resolution whenever possible, including both frontline support and technically complex problems. * Independently troubleshoot Beacon software, medical devices, user accounts, customer workflows, and customer computing environments. * Troubleshoot Windows environments, including Device Manager, drivers, device recognition, connectivity, browser behavior, and related environmental issues. * Work confidently and professionally with customer IT teams to investigate technical barriers and move issues toward resolution. * Investigate software problems by reproducing reported behavior, gathering relevant logs and technical details, identifying variables, documenting reproduction steps, and distinguishing customer\-environment issues from potential product defects. * Use available technical tools, **SQL, data, logs, and system information** to investigate problems rather than relying solely on scripted troubleshooting. * Own technical issues through resolution whenever possible, engaging Tier 2, Product, Engineering, Systems Integration, or other specialized teams when deeper system access or expertise is required. * When additional technical expertise is required, provide clear reproduction steps, technical evidence, customer context, troubleshooting already performed, and operational impact to support efficient resolution. * Remain equally willing to answer phones, assist with account access, provision users, support devices and ordering workflows, and resolve everyday customer questions. No customer problem is considered unimportant simply because it is less technically complex. * Develop a strong working understanding of Beacon's products, devices, technical environment, and customer workflows sufficient to troubleshoot effectively without being responsi  * Demonstrated ability to remain calm, adaptable, and solution\-oriented when customers are frustrated, priorities compete, or the cause of a problem is initially unclear. * Willingness and ability to handle the **full spectrum of customer support work**, from frontline phone and ticket coverage through advanced technical troubleshooting. * Strong written communication and documentation skills. * Ability to translate technical information for nontechnical audiences and customer workflow requirements for technical audiences. * Comfort working across multiple software systems, communication channels, and competing priorities. * Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively across technical, clinical, and operational teams. * Ability to consistently work the designated Central or Pacific Time coverage schedule. * Ability to travel up to approximately 20% based on business needs. ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * **RPSGT, CPSGT, RRT, CRT, EEG/neurodiagnostic credential, nursing credential, or another relevant allied\-health credential or completed allied\-health educational program strongly preferred.** * **Associate's degree (AA/AS)** or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Healthcare Technology, Respiratory Care, Polysomnography, Neurodiagnostics, or another relevant technical, clinical, or allied\-health discipline. * **Bachelor's degree (BA/BS)** in a relevant technical, clinical, healthcare, or related discipline. * Experience in sleep medicine, sleep technology, neurodiagnostics, respiratory care, or another clinical diagnostic environment. * Experience supporting healthcare professionals, hospitals, sleep laboratories, clinics, or busy medical practices. * Experience working directly with hospital or customer IT departments. * Experience supporting medical devices and associated software. * Experience with Windows Device Manager, device drivers, USB/serial\-connected hardware, browser troubleshooting, or related endpoint technologies. * Experience reviewing application or system logs and using them to investigate technical issues. * Experience with CRM, ticketing, or case\-management platforms. * Experience supporting SaaS or cloud\-based applications. * Experience working within a Quality Management System (QMS) or other regulated healthcare or medical\-device environment. * Experience partnering with Product or Engineering teams to reproduce bugs, document customer impact, and support technical resolution. * Experience with EHR/EMR systems, healthcare integrations, APIs, networking concepts, or adjacent healthcare technology. The strongest candidates for this role will be both **technically curious and highly customer\-oriented**. They will enjoy figuring out why something is not working while remaining equally comfortable answering the phone and helping a customer through a straightforward question. They will be comfortable saying, "I don't know yet," and methodically finding the answer; able to work effectively with clinicians, busy medical practices, customer IT professionals, and software engineers; and recognize that solving the technical problem and creating an excellent customer experience are part of the same job. The base hourly rate for this role is **$33\.65 per hour**. Final compensation and offer details are determined based on past experience, specific skills and qualifications. Base compensation is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO and other benefits. At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self\-service mindset, and \- most of all \- a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

jobs.title: Translational AI Scientist/Engineer
jobs.description: BioAge Labs (BIOA) is finding new ways to treat disease by targeting the mechanisms of aging, with the ultimate goal of increasing healthy human lifespan. https://bioagelabs.com We are seeking a scientist/engineer with hands\-on expertise in building generative and agentic AI systems and a strong foundation in target discovery, drug discovery and translational science. You will design and deploy AI\-enabled systems that take a target and produce decision\-grade, evidence\-backed recommendations — from mechanism hypotheses to validation design — with every claim grounded in retrievable evidence and every gap stated explicitly, and that assess how likely a human\-derived signal is to hold up in the lab and beyond. This role is ideal for someone who would rather build production AI systems for translational science than only run analyses, and who has enough hands\-on biology to know when a recommendation is scientifically sound and when it merely reads well. You will own the engineering of these systems end to end, from retrieval and orchestration to evaluation and deployment, and work as a peer with the scientists who act on their outputs. **What you will do** -------------------- * Design and deploy agentic AI systems that support scientific reasoning, hypothesis generation and evidence synthesis for the translational questions that follow target identification: mechanism and source of signal, indication selection, experimental design, reagent quality and translatability. * Build systems that recommend how to test a target — experimental system (in vivo, ex vivo or in vitro), model, indication, endpoints tiered by translational relevance, intervention modality and study parameters — with each choice grounded in published precedent and with an explicit statement when no precedent exists. * Develop tool\-using workflows that retrieve and integrate structured and unstructured evidence — knockout and perturbation phenotypes, endpoint precedent, published effect sizes, tool compound and reagent quality, prior programme outcomes, primary literature — with full provenance. * Build the cross\-species layer: determine whether a target's human signal is reproducible in a model system, and identify the readouts that link experimental results back to the human cohort data. * Assess translatability: develop evidence that a human\-derived signal will reproduce in vivo and onward, calibrated against targets with known preclinical and clinical outcomes, and feed that evidence back into target prioritisation. * Build the evaluation framework for these systems — reference sets of targets with known experimental outcomes, metrics for citation quality and coverage, and calibration of translatability calls — with attention to scientific reliability and interpretability in decision\-critical settings. * Encode domain rules on the meaning and reliability of each external source, so that absent, weak and contradicting evidence are handled distinctly and never collapsed. * Partner with target biology and experimental teams so that recommended designs are usable by the people who run the studies, and incorporate their outcomes back into the system. * Own these systems end to end (architecture, implementation, testing, deployment and monitoring) as maintainable software that scientists rely on day to day, not one\-off notebooks or prototypes. **What we expect of you** ------------------------- **Basic qualifications** * PhD with 2\+ years of relevant experience, **or** Master's degree with 5\+ years, **or** Bachelor's degree with 7\+ years, in computer science, computational biology, biology, translation science or a related field. We welcome scientist\-first candidates with demonstrated ability to build production\-quality AI workflows, as well as engineer\-first candidates with deep translational\-biology judgment. **Preferred technical qualifications** * Hands\-on experience building and deploying LLM\-based agentic systems in production or production\-like settings: tool use, retrieval over structured and unstructured sources, multi\-agent orchestration, structured outputs, provenance tracking, and cost and latency management. * Experience designing and running evaluation for AI systems — reference sets, automated metrics, regression testing — with a strong understanding of interpretability and scientific reliability in decision\-critical environments. * Strong software engineering fundamentals: Python, testing, version control, API design, data modelling, and reproducible, auditable workflows (orchestration, documentation, CI). * Experience integrating multi\-modal biological data — omics, phenotype, perturbation, text and literature — using AI\-enabled or model\-based approaches. * Experience with the infrastructure behind research AI systems: relational and graph databases, cloud environments and containers, pipeline orchestration, and programmatic access to large public biological databases (APIs, bulk data). **Preferred scien mical biology or translational science — enough to judge whether a proposed experiment or mechanism is sound. * Working knowledge of the resources that hold target and precedent evidence — model organism phenotype databases, chemical probe and druggability resources, drug and clinical trial databases, pathway and perturbation resources — and the judgment to know when each is reliable. * Familiarity with the evidence linking preclinical results to clinical outcomes, including the role of genetic support and the literature on animal\-to\-human translation. * Scientific rigour about evidence: you distinguish absence of evidence from evidence against, report coverage alongside conclusions, and prefer stating a gap to filling it plausibly. * Ability to work effectively across scientific and engineering functions, with strong written and oral communication, self\-motivation and independence. **Also valued** * Background in aging biology or geroscience, including healthspan endpoints and aging\-specific study designs. * Experience with proteomics, cross\-species biomarker translation or biomedical ontologies. * Familiarity with CRISPR and perturbation resources, or with pooled or arrayed screening. **Our company** BioAge is a clinical\-stage biopharmaceutical company developing therapeutic product candidates for metabolic diseases by targeting the biology of human aging. The Company's lead product candidate, BGE\-102, is a potent, orally available, brain\-penetrant small\-molecule NLRP3 inhibitor being developed for cardiovascular risk and retinal diseases including diabetic macular edema. BGE\-102 has completed a Phase 1 SAD/MAD trial demonstrating a well\-tolerated profile and potential best\-in\-class reductions in hsCRP and other inflammatory biomarkers in participants with obesity and elevated inflammation. Phase 2 cardiovascular risk proof\-of\-concept data are anticipated in H2 2026, and Phase 1b/2a diabetic macular edema proof\-of\-concept data are anticipated in mid 2027\. The Company is also developing long\-acting injectable and oral small molecule APJ agonists for obesity. BioAge’s additional preclinical programs, which leverage insights from the Company’s proprietary discovery platform built on human longevity data, address key pathways involved in metabolic aging. BioAge has been listed on Nasdaq (BIOA) since 2024\. For additional information about BioAge, visit the company’s website at https://bioagelabs.com. **Our workplace** BioAge offers competitive salary, a comprehensive compensation package, and generous paid time off in addition to company\-observed holidays. We provide comprehensive health and wellness benefits (medical, dental, and vision insurance) and a 401(k) retirement savings plan with matching employer contributions, and we support families through childcare and fertility benefits. We also pride ourselves in giving employees many opportunities for career development, including a generous annual budget for continued learning and a dedication to training and skill development. Many positions (including this one) are remote, allowing our team members to work from anywhere. The salary for this role is expected to be approximately $150,000 \- $185,000, depending on experience. We are open to the concept that different experience levels add value to the team in different ways, and therefore will consider a variety of experience and offer commensurate pay. At BioAge, we embrace diversity and differences while we learn from each other, and we believe that every team member has an important role to play. We are an equal opportunity employer. BioAge prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. BioAge conforms to the spirit as well as to the letter of all applicable laws and regulations.

They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. jobs.title: Production Engineer
jobs.description: ***Bottleless Nation was named a 2026 TOP Workplace! Thank you to ALL of our Team Members!*** **Bottleless Nation** is a purpose\-driven water solutions company dedicated to eliminating plastic waste in workplaces across the U.S. We provide sustainable, bottleless water and ice systems to businesses in a variety of industries, including healthcare, hospitality, and education. By offering environmentally friendly alternatives to single\-use plastics, we help organizations reduce costs, improve hydration, and minimize their environmental footprint. Uniquely, we recycle used water filters as part of our commitment to sustainability. Through our Bottleless Nation Charitable Foundation, we support initiatives that reduce plastic waste, promote environmental cleanup, and improve access to clean drinking water in underserved communities. **Position Summary** The Production Engineer owns the technical readiness and ongoing performance of manufacturing processes, from R\&D handoff through stable, scalable production. This hands\-on role develops assembly methods, tooling, standard work, and automation improvements that deliver safe operations, reliable throughput, and consistent product quality. The engineer is expected to independently diagnose production problems, program and troubleshoot PLC\-controlled equipment, and drive permanent corrective actions. Success requires disciplined execution on the production floor, clear communication, and verified, sustained results. **Core Responsibilities** **Production readiness and new product introduction** * Own manufacturing readiness for new products and process changes, including process flows, capacity, staffing assumptions, tooling, test methods, operator training, and launch risks. * Partner with R\&D to improve design for manufacturability and assembly; resolve build issues before release and maintain a documented readiness checklist with accountable owners. * Lead pilot builds and process validation. Establish acceptance criteria, capture defects and constraints, close critical issues, and demonstrate repeatable performance before recommending production release. * Coordinate with Supply Chain and Quality on purchased\-part readiness, supplier defects, packaging, labeling, revision control, and kitting requirements. **Process engineering and production data** * Develop and maintain controlled work instructions, standard work, assembly and test procedures, workstation layouts, and tooling specifications that operators can use accurately. * Maintain manufacturing BOM accuracy and revision alignment with controlled product definitions; develop and maintain routings, measured cycle times, and labor standards in coordination with system owners. * Implement approved ECOs with documented effectivity, material disposition, training, and verification; prevent obsolete instructions, incorrect components, or unapproved changes from reaching production. * Use time studies and observed production data to balance stations to takt, identify bottlenecks, validate capacity, and support realistic staffing and production plans. **PLC Programming and Automation** Hands\-on PLC programming competence is required. This role owns troubleshooting and controlled improvements to existing production equipment and works with qualified integrators or specialists on major automation projects. * Independently read, develop, modify, and troubleshoot PLC programs on at least one major industrial platform. Diagnose sequence logic, timers, interlocks, alarms, I/O states, and equipment handshakes; use ladder logic and additional supported languages as appropriate. * Trace faults across PLC logic, HMI indications, sensors, actuators, industrial communications, and connected devices. Identify root causes using controller diagnostics, fault histories, signal states, and observed machine behavior. * Troubleshoot automated assembly and test sequences, including RFID read/write confirmation, station permissives, timeout handling, and fault recovery. Verify both normal operation and abnormal conditions. * Develop or coordinate HMI updates that clearly show equipment state, actionable alarms, and recovery instructions; maintain alignment between HMI displays and PLC behavior. * Execute controls changes through documented review, approval, program backups, version control, test plans, and rollback provisions. Validate changes before release and maintain current programs, settings, and technical records. * Commission and verify approved improvements with Production and Quality, including I/O checks, functional tests, fault recovery, operator training, and documented acceptance results. * Preserve machine safeguarding and safety interlocks. Escalate safety\-related changes to qualified personnel and follow applicable site procedures for electrical work, energy isolation, and equipment testing. * Define technical requirements and acceptance criteria for integrator work; verify performance and obtain maintainabl , scrap, and cycle\-time data to prioritize improvements. Lead root cause analysis and confirm that corrective actions prevent recurrence. * Design, specify, and improve fixtures, gauges, test stations, and error\-proofing devices; document settings, maintenance needs, and acceptance criteria. * Apply Lean principles to improve flow, ergonomics, changeovers, and process stability. Justify investments using capacity, quality, labor, and cost benefits. * Coordinate work across Production, Quality, R\&D, Supply Chain, and external suppliers. Maintain priorities, owners, due dates, and concise status updates; train operators and technicians on released changes. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Industrial, Electrical, or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent demonstrated technical experience. * At least five years of manufacturing or production engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of assembly processes, production improvements, and new product or process launches. * Demonstrated hands\-on PLC programming and troubleshooting competence on a major industrial platform. Must be able to explain personally implemented logic changes, diagnostic methods, validation, and production results. * Ability to interpret electrical schematics and diagnose controls, I/O, HMI, and industrial communication issues within training and authorization limits. * Experience creating controlled manufacturing documentation, maintaining BOMs, implementing engineering changes, and establishing routings or labor standards in ERP/MRP and PLM environments. * Proven use of structured root cause analysis, time studies, line balancing, process validation, and corrective\-action effectiveness checks. * Ability to work independently on the production floor, manage competing priorities, communicate clearly, train others, and complete projects with measurable outcomes. **Preferred Qualifications** * Allen\-Bradley PLC programming experience, including Studio 5000 or the applicable Rockwell development environment; FactoryTalk Optix HMI and SICK RFID integration experience. * Electromechanical product assembly, automated assembly and test equipment, and coordination with automation integrators. * Lean manufacturing or Toyota Production System experience; practical application of standard work, error\-proofing, and waste reduction. * Fixture and tooling design; SolidWorks or similar CAD experience. * Experience with Arena PLM, Fishbowl, Odoo, or comparable manufacturing systems; data analysis that connects process changes to operating and financial results. **Performance Expectations** Targets will be established with the General Manager using baseline performance and business priorities. The engineer is accountable for verified improvements and sustained process control in the following areas: * Production readiness: Launch milestones met, critical risks closed, and validated processes, tooling, documentation, and training in place before release. * Reliability and capacity: Reduced recurring downtime and bottlenecks; improved throughput and cycle\-time consistency against agreed production requirements. * Quality and cost: Improved first\-pass yield and reduced rework, scrap, and avoidable labor cost, with documented before\-and\-after results. * Change control: Accurate BOMs and routings, timely approved ECO implementation, and complete records for controls changes and validation. * Execution: Corrective actions closed on time, effectiveness verified, risks escalated promptly, and clear handoff to Production and maintenance resources. If you are a person that defines good character, strong work ethic, and a willingness to hold yourself accountable, we want to hear from you! **www.onebn.com** Thank you for considering Bottleless Nation! Learn more about our mission to reduce plastic, commitment to promote environmental responsibility, and our investment in service here: https://onebn.com/pages/about\-us

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Principal Engineer
jobs.description: About CBRE Data \& Technology CBRE is the world's largest commercial real estate services and investment firm. Our Data \& Technology organization sits at the intersection of real estate expertise and digital innovation, building the platforms, data products, and AI capabilities that give CBRE and its clients a decisive competitive edge. We are transforming how CBRE operates by embedding engineers directly into the business—accelerating delivery, reducing ambiguity, and turning product vision into measurable client and revenue impact. Role Summary We are reshaping our operating model through a Forward Deploy Engineer (FDE) program—embedding senior engineers directly within business product teams to close the gap between intent and execution. This is not a traditional support role. FDEs own outcomes. As an FDE, you will work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with product managers and business stakeholders across GAM, DCI, and other high\-priority data products on a daily basis. You will build features, run demos, iterate fast, and ship software that directly influences client experience and revenue. You operate comfortably in high ambiguity, surface and resolve complexity early, and translate broad business goals into working software. This role requires a rare combination of product sensibility, deep engineering craft, AI fluency, and data expertise. You are equally at home whiteboarding a data model with a product manager and writing production\-grade code the same afternoon. What You'll Do* Embedded Product Delivery * Partner daily with product managers across data product teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions. * Own the full delivery lifecycle: design, build, demo, iterate, and release—moving at the speed of the business. * Serve as the primary engineering voice in product planning sessions, shaping roadmaps with technical precision and pragmatism. * Operate effectively in ambiguity, making high\-quality decisions with incomplete information and adjusting course rapidly. jobs.title: HVAC Mobile Engineer
jobs.description: CBRE Global Workplace Solutions (GWS) works with clients to make real estate a significant contributor to organizational productivity and performance. Our account management model is at the heart of our client\-centric approach to delivering integrated real estate solutions. Each client is entrusted with a dedicated leader and is supported by regional and global resources, demonstrating the industry's most robust platform. CBRE GWS delivers consistent, measurably superior outcomes for our clients at every stage of the lifecycle, and across industries and geographies. **About the role:*** As a CBRE HVAC Mobile Engineer, you will maintain mechanical and electrical equipment for commercial HVAC systems at multiple facilities. This job is part of the Engineering and Technical Services job function. They are responsible for providing support, preventive maintenance, and repairs on equipment and systems. * CBRE is seeking a HVAC Mobile Engineer to support various sites within our Healthcare sector, encompassing clinics in the South Houston Texas area. * This is a day shift position Monday \- Friday. * You will service and maintain 15\-18 sites. * Your duties will include preventive maintenance, repair, replacement, heavy HVAC, ceiling tiles, and installation of equipment. * Seeking a candidate with strong maintenance experience, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical ability. * Position includes a van and tools. * You will need a valid driver's license in good standing and a Universal EPA. * This role stands out as it offers the chance to work in diverse environments while guaranteeing the smooth operation of critical systems. If you're enthusiastic about delivering expert care and flawless fixes, and eager to hit the road, apply now! **What you’ll do:*** Impact a range of customer, operation, project, or service activities within your team and other related teams. * Work within broad guidelines and policies to conduct inspections and ongoing maintenance on building HVAC equipment, ensuring compliance with applicable codes, regulations, and safety standards. * Troubleshoot equipment failures, determine the best course of action for equipment modifications, and apply your expertise to maintain, operate, and repair HVAC systems and associated equipment, including electrical distribution and plumbing systems. * Perform assigned repairs, emergency, and preventive maintenance, while also completing maintenance and repair records as required. * Operate company\-issued vehicles in the execution of daily work responsibilities. * Apply an in\-depth knowledge of standard principles, techniques, and procedures to accomplish complex tasks and solve non\-routine problems. * Coach others and share your in\-depth knowledge of HVAC systems and broad knowledge of several job disciplines within the function. * Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE values. Work to build consensus and convince others to reach an agreement. * Impact the quality of your work and the work of others on the team, ensuring that tasks are completed efficiently and to a high standard. * Explain complex information to others in a straightforward manner, ensuring that team members and clients understand technical details and solutions. **What you’ll need:*** High School Diploma, GED, or trade school diploma with 4\-5 years of job\-related experience. In lieu of a diploma, a combination of experience and education will be considered. Prior shift manager or supervisory experience is preferred. * Meet the physical requirements of this role including stooping, standing, walking, climbing stairs/ladders, and the ability to lift/carry heavy loads of 50 lbs. or more. * Willingness to take a new perspective on existing solutions and apply innovative thinking to your work * In\-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, and Outlook. * Strong organizational skills with an advanced inquisitive mindset, capable of analyzing and solving mildly complex problems. * Sophisticated math skills, with the ability to calculate mildly complex figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial\-related calculations. **Why CBRE?*** CBRE provides medical, dental, vision insurance, life insurance, disability coverage, and 401(k) from your start date. * Professional Development: We are committed to investing in our employees' growth and development through training programs, certifications, and mentorship opportunities. * Career Advancement: CBRE is a global leader in commercial real estate services, providing ample opportunities for career progression and advancement within the company! **Disclaimer:*** Candidates must currently hold authorization to work in the United States without requiring visa sponsorship at present or in the future. jobs.title: Reliability Engineer-Napa, CA
jobs.description: Global Workplace Solutions (GWS) Local is a hard services\-led, tailored facility management solution. We self\-perform hard services while partnering with best\-in\-class soft service providers to offer custom facility and project management solutions to our clients. We focus on empowering our team with a high\-level of downstream accountability, resulting in an agile and efficient service delivery. In addition to our core facility and project management capabilities, our platform offers direct access to our Best\-in\-Class services including ESG, Security Consulting, Workplace Strategy, and Workplace Experience. About the Role As the CBRE Reliability Asset Engineer, you will be the on\-site reliability resource responsible for building structure around the site's asset base — a function that has been handled remotely and requires a dedicated, present expert to be effective. You will work alongside the Site Supervisor, maintenance technicians, Maintenance Planner, and CBRE management to drive asset strategy, failure analysis, and continuous improvement across a complex, multi\-environment operation. This is not a role where you do the same thing every day. The site is dynamic, agricultural\-cycle\-driven, and constantly evolving. Success in this role requires someone who is methodical and structured by nature but flexible in application — someone who can build rigor into a fast\-moving operation without slowing it down. Winery\-specific experience is not required and can be trained on\-site. What matters is a strong foundation in reliability engineering methods and the ability to apply them in a new context. Site Context This role supports a dynamic, high\-output operation that includes high\-speed manufacturing, bottling lines, guest experience facilities, general office, storage, warehousing, and wastewater and drain water systems. Understanding the operational rhythm of this site is essential. **The site operates two production lines:** one runs seasonally for approximately six months per year filling bottles, and a second line runs daily for 11–12 months per year across one or two shifts producing finished goods and empty cages. Output adapts continuously to market demand, meaning downtime is not predictable and all maintenance personnel must be capable of supporting an active bottling line. The site operates on a two\-shift model with three technicians per shift. During harvest season — typically six to eight weeks, generally falling between early August and mid\-September, though timing can vary year to year — maintenance moves to a 24/7 schedule. Shifts restructure into three 8\-hour rotations across six days, with a dedicated Sunday check\-in to ensure facility integrity. No time off is permitted during harvest. All candidates must be comfortable with this schedule structure before applying. What You'll Do • Develop and maintain asset strategies including criticality rankings, maintenance plans, and lifecycle recommendations. • Conduct failure analysis (RCA/FMEA) on recurring and high\-impact equipment failures; translate findings into actionable reliability improvements. • Optimize preventive and predictive maintenance programs to improve asset availability and reduce unplanned downtime. • Drive parts sourcing strategy; identify critical spares and work with the Maintenance Planner to ensure parts availability without excess inventory. • Maintain accurate maintenance data and documentation; own the quality of asset records in the CMMS. • Partner with the Maintenance Planner on job preparation and scheduling to ensure reliability\-driven work is properly resourced. • Support continuous improvement initiatives across the maintenance program — identify opportunities, propose solutions, and follow through on execution. • Provide technical analysis and reporting to site and CBRE leadership. • Support harvest season 24/7 operations as required. What You'll Need • 4–5 years of experience in reliability engineering, maintenance engineering, or a closely related technical discipline; manufacturing, industrial, or production environments preferred. • Working knowledge of reliability methodologies including RCA, FMEA, PM optimization, and criticality analysis. • Experience with CMMS platforms; ability to build and maintain asset data with a high degree of accuracy. • Highly organized and methodical; able to build structured programs in an environment that is operationally dynamic. • Strong problem\-solving orientation with a continuous improvement mindset. • Ability to collaborate cross\-functionally with technicians, planners, and site leadership. • Winery or food and beverage experience is a plus, not a requirement. • Comfort with physical requirements including standing, walking, climbing, and lifting up to 50 lbs. • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite; experience with data analysis or reporting tools a plus. • Availability for harvest season schedule requirements (no time off during this period). Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future **Why CBRE:** When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward\-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants. Applicant AI Use Disclosure We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process. These updates reflect our commitment to clarity, inclusivity, and a consistent candidate experience across all postings. I ask you to encourage your teams to begin incorporating the updated statements into all new job adverts immediately \- this will help us maintain alignment with our brand tone and hiring values. * CBRE carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate’s education, training, and experience. The minimum salary for the Reliability Engineer position is $84,000 annually and the maximum salary for the Reliability Engineer position is $120,000 annually. The compensation that is offered to a successful candidate will depend on the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience. **Equal Employment Opportunity:** CBRE is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity. We have a long\-standing commitment to providing equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, political belief, or any other basis protected by applicable law. **Candidate Accommodations:** CBRE values the differences of all current and prospective employees and recognizes how every employee contributes to our company’s success. jobs.description: About the Role: As a CBRE Systems Engineer Principal — Cloud \& AI Engineering, you will be one of the most technically senior individual contributors within Cloud Platform Services, bringing deep, hands\-on expertise at the intersection of data engineering, applied AI/ML, and cloud\-native software development. You design, build, and operate the intelligent data platforms, AI/ML services, and cloud automation capabilities that power CBRE's cloud engineering and FinOps organization — building the systems that engineers and operators across CBRE depend on to understand their cloud estate, reduce costs, and scale cloud operations efficiently across AWS, Azure, and GCP. This is a principal\-level individual contributor role. You are a practitioner who goes deep. You own the most complex, highest\-impact data and AI engineering problems — designing large\-scale data pipelines, training and deploying production ML models, building generative AI capabilities, and developing the cloud\-native services that bring all of it together. You work independently on open\-ended problems, collaborate closely with cloud architects and senior engineers, and set the technical bar for the data and AI engineering discipline across the team. You apply extensive, diversified knowledge of data engineering, AI/ML, and cloud\-native development principles to solve complex, multi\-dimensional platform challenges without direct supervision. What You'll Do: Cloud Engineering \& Platform Development* Design, build, and maintain large\-scale data pipelines that ingest, normalize, transform, and serve cloud usage, billing, operational, and telemetry data across AWS, Azure, and GCP — using modern ELT/ETL patterns, orchestration frameworks (Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent), and transformation tools including dbt. * Architect and implement data lakehouse solutions using Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake, building reliable, versioned, ACID\-compliant data layers that support both analytical and AI/ML consumption patterns at enterprise scale. * Develop distributed data transformation and processing workloads using Apache Spark or equivalent, optimizing for performance, cost\-efficiency, and maintainability across large cloud billing and operations datasets. * Build modular, reusable data components — shared transformation functions, canonical data models, and governed data APIs — that reduce duplication and provide consistent, lineage\-tracked access to cloud platform data across internal consumers. * Design and implement data quality frameworks: automated validation, freshness monitoring, anomaly alerting, and schema evolution strategies that ensure downstream AI/ML models and analytical consumers receive trustworthy data. * Investigate and resolve the most complex data pipeline, quality, and system issues — applying in\-depth knowledge of cloud data service architectures to diagnose and permanently fix root causes. jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** CDW Government is seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer to serve as a hands\-on principal engineer for public health and disease surveillance solutions. This individual will provide technical leadership across front\-end, back\-end, integration, and data workflows, with emphasis on public health data, record linking, DIBBS integrations, and CDC reporting. **What You Will Do** * Lead the architecture, development, and maintenance of scalable client\-side and server\-side applications supporting public health disease surveillance. * Set technical direction, make key design decisions, review code, mentor engineers, and resolve complex engineering issues. * Design and implement public health data integrations, including DIBBS workflows, APIs, HL7 and FHIR exchanges, and reliable data\-transformation and validation pipelines. * Lead record linking, matching, deduplication, and identity\-resolution solutions that improve data quality and connect surveillance records across source systems. * Transate CDC reporting requirements into production\-ready workflows for mapping, validation, submission, error handling, and troubleshooting. * Partner with product managers, public health subject\-matter experts, data engineers, designers, engineers, and client stakeholders. * Apply automated testing, continuous jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist I or II
jobs.description: Overview: MasTec Industrial is seeking a **Talent Acquisition Specialist I or II** to help attract, engage, and hire the skilled professionals who power complex industrial construction projects across North America. In this role, you'll partner closely with operations leaders to anticipate workforce needs, solve hiring challenges, and build talent pipelines that support both today's projects and tomorrow's growth. This is a true full\-cycle recruiting role with the opportunity to recruit for a diverse range of positions, including project engineers, field engineers, schedulers, estimators, project controls professionals, operations support staff, and construction leadership roles. No two days are the same, and success requires the ability to shift priorities, adapt quickly, and remain focused on delivering results. **Our culture is built on high expectations, accountability, and service to others. We work hard, move fast, and support one another in a dynamic environment where business needs can change quickly.** This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced setting, embraces challenges, takes ownership, and genuinely enjoys helping leaders, hiring teams, and candidates succeed. If you're energized by building relationships, solving problems, and connecting great people with meaningful careers, you'll find an opportunity to grow, make an impact, and help build the workforce behind some of the industry's most important projects. **Join us and help build the teams that build what's next.** **Location \& Travel Details:** This is a remote position, which can be located anywhere in the continental United States. Must be able to work within regular business hours Monday\-Friday between 7am\-6pm of the applicable time zone. We offer all IT equipment, including a work cell phone or cell phone reimbursement. **Company Overview** MasTec Industrial and Phoenix Industrial have built and maintained vital industrial infrastructure across North America since 1947\. We serve clients across energy transition, industrial processing, sustainable solutions, mining, and power generation, delivering everything from construction services to full EPC execution. Our teams combine hands\-on construction expertise with engineering, project management, fabrication, startup, and commissioning capabilities to deliver complex industrial projects. Our work matters because the facilities we help power communities, support industry, and keep the economy moving. We take pride in tackling complex challenges, delivering quality work, and leaving every project stronger than we found it. We are committed to safety, quality, and delivering results, while creating opportunities for our people to grow their careers, develop new skills, and leave a lasting mark on the projects they help build. Hardworking professionals drive our success and value teamwork, accountability, craftsmanship, and getting the job done right. The MasTec Industrial operating group is part of the MasTec Clean Energy \& Infrastructure (CE\&I) business segment. The CE\&I segment generates over $4\.5 billion in annual revenue, providing construction services across our renewables, industrial, infrastructure, and general building operating groups. Sustainability and safety are foundational to our culture and influence everything we do. MasTec, a minority\-owned Fortune 500 company, has shaped the construction industry for more than 90 years. With over 35,000 employees and 400 offices nationwide, we provide flexibility and growth in dynamic environments. Join one of the largest construction firms in the country (Engineering News\-Record \#1 in Power, \#16 Top 50 Domestic Heavy Contractors, \#13 Transportation Contractor). Responsibilities: * Partner with hiring managers as a trusted talent advisor, providing guidance on hiring strategies, candidate evaluation, and recruitment best practices. * Manage the full recruitment lifecycle for exempt and non\-exempt positions, from sourcing and screening through offer acceptance and onboarding. * Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs across a variety of construction, operations, and support functions. * Develop and execute sourcing strategies using networking, referrals, social media, job boards, talent communities, and other recruiting channels. * Deliver an exceptional candidate and hiring manager experience while driving timely hiring decisions and results. * Maintain accurate candidate records, recruitment activities, and hiring documentation within the applicant tracking system. * Identify opportunities to improve hiring processes, recruitment tools, and manager effectiveness through training and coaching. * Support diversity, equal employment opportunity, and affirmative action initiatives throughout the recruitment process. * Participate in recruiting projects, hiring events, workforce planning activities, and other talent acquisition initiatives. 10%, for career fair and other recruiting efforts may be required. * Compensation $75,000\-$95,000 / year, commensurate with experience **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** * Knowledge of EEO, OFCCP, and employment law compliance. * Experience sourcing talent through job boards, social media, networking, and internet research. * Experience with iCIMS or other applicant tracking systems preferred. manager experience. * Ability to build credibility with candidates, hiring teams, and senior leaders. * Proven ability to handle confidential information with discretion. * Skilled in sourcing strategy, candidate engagement, and talent attraction. * Strong organization, time management, and multitasking skills. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office and web\-based recruiting tools. **What's in it for You** Financial Wellbeing * Competitive pay with ongoing performance review and merit increase * 401(k) with company match \& Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) * Flexible spending account (Healthcare \& Dependent care) Health \& Wellness * Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance (plan choice) \- coverage for spouse, domestic partner, and children * Diabetes Management, Telehealth
