jobs.title: Instrumentation Control & Electrical Manager
jobs.description: ***Come to a City that Builds Careers! As one of the largest cities in Broward County, the City of Hollywood provides an energetic, innovative and collaborative work environment for its employees. Want Top Notch Insurance? We offer low cost health insurance giving you the best value \- Medical, Dental, Vision and Flexible Spending Plans. Need Work Life Balance? We have got you covered with a 4\-Day Work Week and an Award Winning Wellness Program. And We Don’t Stop There. The City of Hollywood provides a generous Paid Time Off Program inclusive of 13 Paid Holidays, Vacation Leave, Personal Leave, and Sick Leave. Repaying Student Loans? Employees at the City with 10 years of public service and on\-time payments qualify for the Federal Student Loan Forgiveness Program. Let’s Partner Together and Come Grow with the City of Hollywood. Apply Now!*** ***For more information about this position and our competitive pay, benefits package and pension plan, refer to this job posting or our City website at*** ***https://www.governmentjobs.com/careers/hollywoodfl*** *.* **JOB SUMMARY:** Under Director of the Public Utilities Manager\-WWTP, this employee is responsible for administration of all instrumentation, computer control and electrical systems for the Department of Public Utilities\-WWTP. This employee supervises subordinate personnel engaged in planning, installing and maintaining the instrumentation, computer control and electrical systems within the water and wastewater treatment facilities, raw water wells, elevated tanks, collection and storm water pumping stations, SCADA system, local and wide area networks. The Instrumentation Control \& Electrical Manager exercises extensive initiative and independent judgment in solving problems as they develop in order to maintain the continuous, effective, efficient, and safe operation of the instrumentation, computer control and electrical systems within the Public Utilities Department. Technical and computer expertise is of prime importance as error in technical judgment could result in extensive damage to the environment, facilities or both. Duties include enforcing safety precautions for employee and operational staff, implementing preventive maintenance programs and estimating cost for instrumentation, computer control and electrical systems projects. Work is performed with wide latitude in the use of independent judgment and selection of work methods and procedures. Work is reviewed through conferences, reports and observation of the operational success of the instrumentation, computer control and electrical systems and achievement of objectives. This is an essential position, which requires incumbents to report to work during catastrophic events. In case of such an event, incumbents maybe required to work 12\-hour shifts, seven days a week to help provide essential services to our customers. **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Plans and supervises the installation and maintenance of instrumentation, computer control and electrical systems within the Public Utility\-WWTP department; oversees testing of equipment and systems; enforces safety precautions for employees and the public; estimates costs for system projects. * Directs preventive maintenance programs; reviews daily work orders; oversees movable and fixed asset inventory; verifies monthly expense reports; assist in preparation of annual divisional program budgets. * Consults with engineers staff regarding new construction projects; recommends additions and replacements of instrumentation, computer control and electrical systems; maintains service and maintenance records of repairs. * Makes recommendation regarding hiring, discipline and promotion of subordinates; authorizes leaves and overtime; evaluates and rates employee performance. * Insures that the Public Utilities–WWTP department instrumentation, computer control and electrical systems are performing and operating efficiently. * Coordinates the daily operations of the Public Utilities\-WWTP department instrumentation, computer control and electrical systems. Confers with and advises the staff on difficult technical problems in their assigned areas. * Initiates and directs instrumentation, computer control and electrical systems investigations, troubleshooting and directs modification to the system to improve efficiency and performance. * Directs and reviews the preparation of plans, specifications and contracts for construction, repair or maintenance to facilities. * Authorizes and recommends purchases of supplies and equipment; conducts weekly staff meetings with subordinates. * Coordinates divisional training programs. * Works with consulting engineering firms making recommendations for new facilities, equipment and modifications of existing facilities. * Follows safety procedures and promotes a safe work environment. * Must effectively and positively represent the City in delivering and performing work with colleagues and clients,  ne library here. Employees may choose to participate in the COHERF Pension Plan and contribute 8% pretax dollars biweekly with a seven\-year vesting period, or employees may instead elect to enroll in a Defined Contribution (DC) plan or a hybrid plan. Click here to retrieve a copy of the Summary Plan Description (SPD), and call the COHERF Pension Office for more information: 954\-921\-3333\. * The City is a qualifying employer for the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program. Full\-time service at the City contributes to the 120 months of payment for certain federal student loans to be forgiven. * Supervisory employees, who complete their probationary period and receive “satisfactory” or better Employee Performance Evaluations, shall be eligible to participate in the City Educational Reimbursement Program for job\-related undergraduate and graduate course work. General employees should request approval *prior* to taking any courses. The City pays as follows to a maximum total of $3,000\.00 for tuition annually: Graduate and Undergraduate Benefit Grade of B or better 100% reimbursement at State tuition rates Grade of Pass 100% reimbursement at State tuition rates Grade of C 50% reimbursement at State tuition rates Employees will be eligible to receive 100% reimbursement for books with approval of the City Manager/designee. **Employees who receive benefits under this program, who voluntarily leave the City's employment within two (2\) years of receiving such benefit, shall be responsible for reimbursing the City for the cost of this benefit.** * The City's award\-winning wellness program, Hollywood Wellness, offers opportunities to earn incentives such as gift cards (taxable), gym reimbursements, iWatches, BBQ grills, water tumblers, lunch boxes, duffel bags, and other items for participating in wellness initiatives. Hollywood Wellness is powered by specific funding received by the City’s Third\-Party Administrator, Cigna, to improve the health and well\-being of City employees, and may be discontinued or limited at any time based on availability of funds and discretion of HR Director. Some features of Hollywood Wellness include: * Access to the BenTek Wellness Hub, where employees may earn gift cards for completing wellness activities such as preventative exams, dental exams, flu shots, health coaching, or for participating in wellness events such as health seminars and wellness challenges. * Monthly health seminars/webinars, quarterly challenges, on\-site health screenings, confidential counseling sessions, and communication campaigns. * Access to free state\-of\-the\-art fitness facilities throughout City Departments. * Partnerships with local community vendors to offer reduced fitness memberships for employees, i.e., OrangeTheory Hollywood, YogaJoint Hollywood, and F45 Hollywood. * Flexible Fitness Reimbursement Program to reimburse employees for fitness facility memberships after proof of consistent attendance and payment. * Zen Room for employees to enjoy an ambiance of solitude, where they can refresh themselves with a massage, red light therapy, or just quiet time. * A mobile lactation pod and dedicated lactation rooms throughout the City. * Supervisory employees may enter into a Deferred Compensation Program through payroll deduction. * Supervisory employees have the option of joining the Sun Credit Union. * Supervisory employees have the option of participating in payroll Direct Deposit. * Supervisory employees have the option of participating in the BeyondMed Plan for elective/cosmetic services, Pre\-paid Legal/ID Theft Protection Plans, and AFLAC Plans through voluntary payroll deductions. * Supervisory employees are eligible to participate in the City’s Work/Life Assistance Program offering a wide range of services and support, including 10 free face\-to\-face or virtual visits with licensed counselors, 24/7 telephonic support, free 30\-minute consultations with legal or financial advisers, online tools and webinars.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Applications Engineer - Spark
jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About the Role:** We are seeking a Senior Staff Applications Engineer to own how Spark answers the question of technical fit. You will build and maintain the evaluation framework that determines whether a site, partnership, or commercial opportunity is viable for the Spark modular data center (MDC) and Spark\-Liquid (DLC) product lines, and you will support the Energy Development Group (EDG), business development, and partner teams as they apply it. When an opportunity is undefined, unconventional, or contested, you are the Spark team's point of contact, the person who answers the hard product questions and delivers the technical verdict. Spark is on a path to deploy hundreds of megawatts of modular capacity, and every megawatt of it begins as an unqualified site on a map. Your judgment about where this product can be applied, not the design of the product itself, is what converts that pipeline into deployable capacity. **What You'll Be Working On:** **Product Authority \& Opportunity Qualification** * **Qualification Framework:** Build and maintain the standardized screening criteria, scoring model, decision thresholds, and report format that define what makes a site or opportunity viable for Spark deployments. Keep it current as the product roadmap evolves, and keep a record of past calls and their rationale. * **Team Enablement:** Equip EDG, business development, and partner teams to apply the framework themselves on standard opportunities. Train, document, and iterate so routine qualification does not depend on a single point of failure, you. * **Escalated Technical Judgment:** Serve as the Spark team's point of contact for opportunities the framework cannot resolve, including undefined sites, non\-standard configurations, and contested calls. Deliver a clear fit, conditional fit, or no\-fit verdict with the engineering rationale behind it. * **Speed Discipline:** Turn around escalated feasibility assessments in days, not weeks. Frame the problem tightly enough that deeper analysis, when required, lands on the respective engineering discipline ready to be worked. * **Deviation \& Exception Management:** Identify where an opportunity requires deviation from the standard Spark configuration, quantify the engineering cost and schedule impact, and route it to the responsible engineering discipline for disposition. * **New Application Assessment:** Evaluate technical fit for non\-standard applications such as edge deployments, distributed energy assets, co\-located industrial sites, and third\-party colocation and shell\-rent arrangements, and define what the product would need to change to serve them. * **Roadmap Feedback Loop:** Feed recurring field constraints back to Spark design engineering and R\&D as prioritized product requirements. You are the closed loop between what the market presents and what the product can absorb. **Site \& Partner Engagement** * **EDG Partnership:** Serve as Spark's dedicated technical counterpart to the Energy Development Group across the full site pipeline, from initial screen through definitive agreement. * **Spark Fit Assessment:** Evaluate candidate sites and opportunities against Spark module requirements, covering power, thermal, civil, and physical interface, and define what the site must deliver at the module boundary. * **Field Validation:** Conduct site walks alongside EDG, developers, and utility counterparties, converting observations into Spark product requirements and a maintained risk register. **Technical Communication \& Diligence** * **Diligence Support:** Provide the technical inputs that Finance requires to model an opportunity, including module configuration, power and cooling assumptions, and site\-specific efficiency and derate factors. * **Executive Communication:** Translate multi\-discipline engineering tradeoffs into clear go/no\-go decision frameworks for commercial and executive stakeholders. **What You'll Bring to the Team:** * **Professional Experience:** 10\+ years of progressive engineering experience spanning data center infrastructure, power generation or utility interconnection, industrial capital projects, or modular and containerized systems. * **Broad Engineering Fluency:** Working fluency across data center infrastructure disciplines including electrical (MV/LV distribution, switchgear, transformers), mechanical/thermal (DLC, CDUs, heat rejection), and civil/structural (foundations, seismic/wind loading, rigging). * **First\-Principles Decision Making:** Track record of making feasibility calls from first principles under incomplete information, with direct accountability for recommendations carrying real capital consequences. * **Technical Counterparty Credibility:** Proven ability to hold technical credibility with external developers, utilities, enterprise customers, and executives while keeping opportunities moving rapidly. * **Unit Economics Command:** Ability to connect engineering decisions directly to $/MW, capex, PUE, and deployment schedules. * **Product Authority Track Record:** Demonstrated depth on a specific engineered product or platform, where you were the person others relied on for an authoritative answer on capabilities and limits. * **Mountaineer Spirit:** Relentless technical rigor, comfort with ambiguity, a safety\-first culture, the judgment to say no early, and the discipline to make calls when perfect information is unavailable. * **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline. **Bonus Points** * Experience with modular, containerized, or prefabricated infrastructure product lines. * Familiarity with agency certification and AHJ coordination for modular electrical equipment across varied jurisdictions. * Deep familiarity with energy development, interconnection processes/queues, and behind\-the\-meter site configurations. **This Role Is Not a Good Fit If:** * You prefer purely theoretical design work over applied, rapid feasibility assessments. * You require complete data and fully finalized engineering designs before making a technical recommendation. * You struggle to communicate complex engineering tradeoffs to commercial partners or executive stakeholders. **Benefits:** * Competitive compensation and equity packages * Restricted Stock Units * Paid time off, paid holidays \& leave of absence programs * Comprehensive health, dental \& vision insurance * Employer contributions to HSA account * Paid parental leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Professional development \& tuition reimbursement * Mental health \& wellness support * Commuter benefits (parking \& transit) * Cell phone stipend * 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary * Volunteer time off * Global travel insurance \& emergency assistance * Daily meals allowance * Additional perks \& programs specific to location **Compensation Range** Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $190,000\-$215,000 \+ Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: Senior Development Engineer I - CAP UI
jobs.description: We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. **POSITION SUMMARY** The CVS Digital \- Developer Experience team is on a mission to build an enterprise software deployment platform, CVS Application Platform (CAP), that will transform how developers deploy applications at scale for CVS Digital application teams. We are a team of engineers and engineering leader's laser\-focused on delivering exceptional self\-service experiences to our developers who are writing critical guest\-facing digital applications to help people on their path to better health. We are looking for engineers and engineering leaders across all levels and skillsets that are passionate about delivering highly scalable, reliable and secure platforms that make deploying software incredibly easy. *About the Role* Digital Senior Development Engineer I \- CAP UI is a hands\-on software engineering role that will be using their software development experience to build various services for CAP. As a Digital Senior Development Engineer I \- CAP UI you will be working with a team of experienced engineers to design, code, test, and debug software applications that power critical experiences for both internal and external customers using CAP. What We Expect of You * Self\-starter who can see the big picture and prioritize their work to make the largest impact on the business and customers vision and requirements. * Collaborate with other engineers and stakeholders to define, design, and implement software features and functionality. * A commitment and drive for quality, technical excellence, and results. We like pushing code to production! * Perform unit testing and integration testing to ensure code quality and reliability. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams as necessary to deliver high value work for the organization. * Be a daily advocate for and implement security best practices. * Participate in on\-call rotations providing exceptional service to our customers. * Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * 3\+ years of experience exhibiting deep expertise in one or more programing languages such as TypeScript, JavaScript, React. * 3\+ years of full software development life cycle including ideation, coding, coding standards, testing, code reviews and production deployments. * 3\+ years of experience with modern software development practices like CI/CD and collaborative coding tools like GitHub, GitLab, etc. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Familiarity with containerization technologies like Docker and container orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes. * Have a strong desire to see others succeed by mentoring and coaching other engineers through pair programing. * Ability to learn quickly and adapt to change requirements. * Strong understanding of observability and using telemetry to inform decision making. * Experience working in a Scrum/Agile development methodology. * Ability to work independently and part of a team. **EDUCATION** Bachelor’s degree from accredited University or equivalent work experience * **BUSINESS OVERVIEW** Bring your heart to CVS Health Every one of us at CVS Health shares a single, clear purpose: Bringing our heart to every moment of your health. This purpose guides our commitment to deliver enhanced human\-centric health care for a rapidly changing world. Anchored in our brand — with heart at its center — our purpose sends a personal message that how we deliver our services is just as important as what we deliver. Our Heart At Work Behaviors™ support this purpose. We want everyone who works at CVS Health to feel empowered by the role they play in transforming our culture and accelerating our ability to innovate and deliver solutions to make health care more personal, convenient and affordable. We strive to promote and sustain a culture of diversity, inclusion and belonging every day. CVS Health is an affirmative action employer, and is an equal opportunity employer, as are the physician\-owned businesses for which CVS Health provides management services. We do not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, promotion, or any other personnel action based on race, ethnicity, color, national origin, sex/gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We proudly support and encourage people with military experience (active, veterans, reservists and National Guard) as well as military spouses to apply for CVS Health job opportunities. **Anticipated Weekly Hours** 40**Time Type** Full time**Pay Range** The typical pay range for this role is: $92,700\.00 \- $203,940\.00 This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full\-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short\-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong. **Great benefits for great people** We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families. This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility. Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments. We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 10/30/2026 Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. The Cost Estimation and Navigation AI portfolio at CVS Health is seeking a Staff Software Development Engineer to help build solutions that simplify healthcare navigation and improve the experience for the people we serve. This portfolio includes Cost Estimator, Benefit Quoting, and Digital Consumer Products, supporting key moments across the healthcare journey from plan selection through active care navigation. These solutions help members, prospective members, customer service agents, and providers access clearer information about cost, benefits, and care options so they can make more informed decisions. As a Staff Software Development Engineer, you will help design, build, and deliver modern cloud\-based applications within a complex distributed systems environment on Google Cloud Platform. You will contribute across architecture, system design, and implementation, helping deliver scalable, reliable solutions while strengthening the long\-term technical foundation of the portfolio. This role offers the opportunity to work on high\-impact products that support healthcare decisions and make complex information more accessible and actionable for a broad set of users. **Responsibilities** * Lead the design, development, and delivery of scalable software solutions within the Cost Estimation \& Navigation AI portfolio * Drive architecture and technical design across distributed services, APIs, and platform components to support scalability, resiliency, security, and long\-term maintainability * Partner with product, data science, and engineering teams to translate business priorities and portfolio use cases into production\-ready technical solutions * Provide technical leadership across complex initiatives by guiding implementation decisions, managing dependencies, and addressing engineering tradeoffs * Design, build, and enhance cloud\-native applications, microservices, and APIs using modern service, interface, and messaging patterns * Define and ensure achievement of non\-functional requirements, including performance, availability, failover, scalability, and security * Evaluate existing architectures and recommend improvements to reliability, operability, flexibility, and cost efficiency * Lead proof\-of\-concept development and technical exploration for emerging technologies, including AI/GenAI\-enabled capabilities relevant to portfolio needs * Apply knowledge of data and analytics technologies, including orchestration, non\-relational data stores, caching, and large\-scale service integration patterns * Mentor engineers and contribute to engineering excellence through design reviews, code reviews, and technical guidance * Communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders to build alignment across teams and organizational boundaries * Ensure solutions are designed and delivered in compliance with regulatory, privacy, and security requirements, including secure handling of PII and PHI data **Required Qualifications** * 7\+ years of experience delivering enterprise\-scale software solutions in distributed systems environments * 5\+ years of experience in one or more programming languages such as Java, Python, Go, or JavaScript * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience designing, building, and operating cloud\-based enterprise solutions * 5\+ years of experience designing and developing modern microservices and scalable, cost\-effective APIs * 3\+ years of experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps practices * 3\+ years of experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes * Experience working with AI/GenAI platforms and applying intelligent capabilities within software products **Preferred Qualifications** * Healthcare domain experience * Experience building and operating solutions on Google Cloud Platform, including GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Build, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, and IAM * Strong understanding of software design principles, distributed systems, and scalable architecture patterns * Experience influencing technical direction, engineering standards, and solution design across teams or domains * Experience with ETL processes, data quality practices, and healthcare data management * Hands\-on experience developing user\-facing features and applications * Experience implementing monitoring and observability solutions using OpenTelemetry, Grafana, or similar platforms * Ability to create and execute roadmaps that balance delivery, innovation, and reliable scale * Strong collaboration, communication, and stakeholder management skills across organizational boundaries **Education** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience (HS diploma \+ 4 years relevant experience) **Pay Range** The typical pay range for this role is: $106,605\.00 \- $284,280\.00 This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full\-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short\-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. This position also includes an award target in the company’s equity award program. Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong. **Great benefits for great people** We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families. This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility. Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments. We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 10/22/2026 Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

jobs.title: Staff Software Development Engineer - Cost Estimation & Navigation AI
jobs.description: We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. The Cost Estimation and Navigation AI portfolio at CVS Health is seeking a Staff Software Development Engineer to help build solutions that simplify healthcare navigation and improve the experience for the people we serve. This portfolio includes Cost Estimator, Benefit Quoting, and Digital Consumer Products, supporting key moments across the healthcare journey from plan selection through active care navigation. These solutions help members, prospective members, customer service agents, and providers access clearer information about cost, benefits, and care options so they can make more informed decisions. As a Staff Software Development Engineer, you will help design, build, and deliver modern cloud\-based applications within a complex distributed systems environment on Google Cloud Platform. You will contribute across architecture, system design, and implementation, helping deliver scalable, reliable solutions while strengthening the long\-term technical foundation of the portfolio. This role offers the opportunity to work on high\-impact products that support healthcare decisions and make complex information more accessible and actionable for a broad set of users. **Responsibilities** * Lead the design, development, and delivery of scalable software solutions within the Cost Estimation \& Navigation AI portfolio * Drive architecture and technical design across distributed services, APIs, and platform components to support scalability, resiliency, security, and long\-term maintainability * Partner with product, data science, and engineering teams to translate business priorities and portfolio use cases into production\-ready technical solutions * Provide technical leadership across complex initiatives by guiding implementation decisions, managing dependencies, and addressing engineering tradeoffs * Design, build, and enhance cloud\-native applications, microservices, and APIs using modern service, interface, and messaging patterns * Define and ensure achievement of non\-functional requirements, including performance, availability, failover, scalability, and security * Evaluate existing architectures and recommend improvements to reliability, operability, flexibility, and cost efficiency * Lead proof\-of\-concept development and technical exploration for emerging technologies, including AI/GenAI\-enabled capabilities relevant to portfolio needs * Apply knowledge of data and analytics technologies, including orchestration, non\-relational data stores, caching, and large\-scale service integration patterns * Mentor engineers and contribute to engineering excellence through design reviews, code reviews, and technical guidance * Communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders to build alignment across teams and organizational boundaries * Ensure solutions are designed and delivered in compliance with regulatory, privacy, and security requirements, including secure handling of PII and PHI data **Required Qualifications** * 7\+ years of experience delivering enterprise\-scale software solutions in distributed systems environments * 5\+ years of experience in one or more programming languages such as Java, Python, Go, or JavaScript * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience designing, building, and operating cloud\-based enterprise solutions * 5\+ years of experience designing and developing modern microservices and scalable, cost\-effective APIs * 3\+ years of experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps practices * 3\+ years of experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes * Experience working with AI/GenAI platforms and applying intelligent capabilities within software products **Preferred Qualifications** * Healthcare domain experience * Experience building and operating solutions on Google Cloud Platform, including GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Build, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, and IAM * Strong understanding of software design principles, distributed systems, and scalable architecture patterns * Experience influencing technical direction, engineering standards, and solution design across teams or domains * Experience with ETL processes, data quality practices, and healthcare data management * Hands\-on experience developing user\-facing features and applications * Experience implementing monitoring and observability solutions using OpenTelemetry, Grafana, or similar platforms * Ability to create and execute roadmaps that balance delivery, innovation, and reliable scale * Strong collaboration, communication, and stakeholder management skills across organizational boundaries **Education** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience (HS diploma \+ 4 years relevant experience) **Pay Range** The typical pay range for this role is: $106,605\.00 \- $284,280\.00 This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full\-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. jobs.description: Job Posting: Senior Network Engineer Employment Development Department JC\-533914* Senior Network Engineer INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY SPECIALIST II $8,625\.00 \- $11,557\.00 per Month New to State candidates will be hired into the minimum salary of the classification or minimum of alternate range when applicable. **Final Filing Date:** **10/10/2026** **Application Methods:**Electronic (Using your CalCareer Account) By Mail Drop\-off Print Job Save Job ### **Job Description and Duties** THIS POSITION MAY BE ELIGIBLE FOR A HYBRID WORK SCHEDULE. THE AMOUNT OF TELEWORK IS AT THE DISCRETION OF THE DEPARTMENT AND IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE AS BUSINESS NEEDS ARISE. The Enterprise Infrastructure Services Section is seeking a highly motivated and technically skilled Information Technology Specialist II to serve as a Senior Network Engineer supporting one of California's largest enterprise network environments. This position is responsible for engineering, implementing, integrating, and supporting complex enterprise network solutions that provide secure, reliable, and highly available connectivity for thousands of users across statewide offices, data centers, and remote locations. The incumbent serves as a senior technical resource responsible for designing implementation strategies, leading complex infrastructure projects, resolving critical network issues, and ensuring the operational integrity of the Department's enterprise network. The successful candidate will work with a wide range of enterprise technologies including routing and switching, Palo Alto firewalls, remote access solutions, software\-defined networking (SD\-WAN), enterprise wireless, load balancing, DNS, DHCP, IP address management, network monitoring platforms, and data center networking. Responsibilities include network engineering, lifecycle management, technology refreshes, performance optimization, complex troubleshooting, incident response, technical documentation, and implementation planning. This position regularly collaborates with infrastructure, cybersecurity, server, storage, cloud, application, and project teams to deliver enterprise technology solutions that support critical business operations. The incumbent is expected to exercise sound engineering judgment, evaluate technical alternatives, identify operational risks, develop implementation and rollback plans, and provide technical guidance throughout the project lifecycle. The ideal candidate possesses strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, excellent communication abilities, and experience implementing and supporting large\-scale enterprise network environments. Success in this role requires the ability to balance security, performance, availability, scalability, and maintainability while delivering reliable technology solutions that support the Department's mission. If you are passionate about solving complex technical challenges, enjoy working on large\-scale enterprise infrastructure, and want the opportunity to help modernize one of the State's largest technology environments, we encourage you to apply. This position may be eligible for a hybrid work schedule. The amount of telework is at the discretion of the Department and is subject to change as business needs arise. Employees are required to report to their headquarters office on their assigned in\-office days. Travel expenses to and from the assigned headquarters are the responsibility of the employee. Position located at 1416 9th Street, Sacramento, CA 95814\. This position is headquartered at the New Labor Agency Building (NLAB), a newly remodeled high\-rise building. Located in the heart of Downtown Sacramento and in close proximity of the State Capitol and the Golden1 Center, this beautiful and modern building provides the following amenities: Break areas, wellness/lactation rooms, coffee points, a fitness center with private showers, a Career Center for EDD Employees, a micro market, building\-wide WiFi, an outdoor terrace, bike storage, nearby public transit options, and much more. Apply today for the opportunity to work in this state\-of\-the\-art building! jobs.description: At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life\-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R\&D and engineering services across all industries. jobs.description: AI Engineer 4 (AI Foundations: Benchmarking, Evaluation, and Explainability) At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real\-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world\-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI \& ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world\-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high\-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build. **Team Description:** The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand\-in\-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact. **What You’ll Do:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI\-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One. * Design, develop, test, deploy, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, agents and multi\-agent workflows, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc. * Leverage a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more. * Invent and introduce state\-of\-the\-art foundation model optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems. * Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One. * Own the end\-to\-end architecture for complex AI systems \- ensuring maintainability, observability, and ethical alignment * Define and maintain service\-level objectives (SLOs) for AI reliability, including latency, uptime, and model performance drift * Collaborate with infrastructure engineering to optimize GPU/TPU utilization and accelerate model inference pipelines * Lead cross\-functional technical reviews for new AI system deployments, ensuring security, data governance, and compliance standards are met * Mentor Principal and Senior Associates on scalable design, performance tuning and research\-to\-production translation **The Ideal Candidate:** * You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good * Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production * You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven * You are deeply Technical. jobs.title: Sr. AI Product Engineer
jobs.description: **About Cardiff** ----------------- Cardiff lends to small businesses. Since 2004 we've funded more than $12 billion across the country, to businesses in logistics, healthcare, construction, professional services, and plenty in between. We're building our own underwriting technology, and we still answer the phone; our customers need capital fast, and they want a straight answer from a person who can actually help. **Location:** Remote (U.S.)**Employment Type:** Full\-time**Department:** Engineering Role Overview This senior individual contributor will turn AI\-built prototypes into reliable software that Cardiff’s teams use every day. Working directly with the Managing Partner and business owners across sales, operations, underwriting, and marketing, this person will define the initial scope, build and deploy solutions, and support them in production. The initial focus will be the Managing Partner’s existing prototypes, including lender routing, sales calculators, decisioning workflows, and agents that reduce manual work. These projects support Cardiff’s goal of reducing application\-to\-funding turnaround from 24 business hours to minutes. The role has no people\-management responsibilities. Over time, it may transition into a dedicated AI engineering role within one of Cardiff’s business teams. What you will own * **Prototype assessment:** Review each prototype and document whether it should move forward, be revised, or be discontinued. * **Production development:** Build the data models, APIs, integrations, error handling, tests, and deployment processes needed to make each solution reliable. * **Release controls:** Establish automated testing, secret scanning, and code and dependency checks for the Managing Partner’s projects, aligned with engineering’s production approval process. * **System integrations:** Connect Cardiff’s systems with external lenders and vendors and standardize inconsistent data. * **Ongoing reliability:** Monitor, maintain, and improve deployed systems, including resolving incidents and documenting corrective actions. * **Project communication:** Provide clear written updates, flag blockers promptly, and coordinate scope and acceptance with each business owner. What Success Looks Like **First 30 days** * Release controls are operating and blocking releases that fail required checks. * The prototype portfolio has been reviewed, with a documented recommendation and production requirements for each project. **First 90 days** * Two prototypes are live in production, have business\-owner sign\-off, and are actively being used. * Decisions to discontinue any unsuitable prototypes are documented. * Each live system has a clear record of remaining risks and follow\-up work. **First six months** * A consistent delivery rhythm moves suitable prototypes into production within weeks. * Deployed systems operate reliably, supported by monitoring and clear ownership. * Completed projects demonstrate measurable improvements in processing efficiency and time to funding. What We’re Looking For * Seven or more years of software development experience, with recent hands\-on ownership of systems delivered to real users. * Strong production engineering judgment across testing, security, reliability, monitoring, and incident response. * Proficiency in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL, REST APIs, and cloud deployment, preferably AWS. * Experience integrating external systems and translating inconsistent inputs into clean, usable data models. * AI development as a core working practice, including coding tools, LLM APIs, agents, and evaluations, with careful review of generated code. * Ability to assess existing code, determine what to retain or rebuild, and deliver practical solutions quickly. * Comfort working directly with the Managing Partner and nontechnical stakeholders, with clear communication and accountability. Cardiff’s environment includes AWS, Salesforce, Snowflake, Twilio, Slack, and internal APIs. The role will use established open\-source tools where appropriate and balance delivery speed with the controls required for dependable production systems.

jobs.title: Data Center ICT Technical Lead
jobs.description: **SUMMARY** The Company is a premier acoustic and technology design consulting firm that has worked with world\-class developers, architects, and large end\-user clients for more than 60 years, and is now part of Trinity Consultants, a multi\-billion\-dollar company headquartered in Dallas, TX. We are seeking an experienced ICT Technical Lead to provide management and design oversight for outside plant (OSP) and inside plant (ISP) pathways and cabling systems on large\-scale, multi\-building data center campus projects, including hyperscale campus developments. This role ensures design quality and consistency, and on\-time delivery of client projects. The successful candidate for this position will have demonstrable experience managing engineers designing multiple projects. Strong interpersonal, project management, and client management skills are required. Knowledge of large\-scale outside plant conduits, duct banks, manholes, and distribution systems, data center equipment layout, and multi\-tier cabling pathways is necessary. Familiarity with building information modeling (BIM) design delivery is a must. **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** Technical Responsibilities * Serve as a technical authority for OSP and ISP pathways and cabling design across data center campus projects. * Lead the development of scalable standards for underground duct banks, vaults, building entrances, and campus fiber/copper distribution. * Provide technical leadership for inside plant systems including cable tray, ladder rack, equipment layouts, backbone and horizontal cabling. * Review and approve design packages, ensuring compliance with client standards, constructability, and long\-term scalability. * Coordinate with civil, structural, electrical, mechanical, and BIM teams to resolve complex cross\-discipline issues. * Guide team members through design challenges related to hyperscale capacity, redundancy, diversity, and future expansion. * Support client engagement, technical workshops, and design reviews. * Translate client operational requirements into buildable designs. * Promote best practices and continuous improvement. Team Management * Team and individual employee management * Constant interaction with team members working on multiple projects. * Communicate and work closely with the Managing Principal, New York regional office. Project Management * Continuous oversight and supervision of data center projects in the areas of programming and design, through construction administration and testing/commissioning. * Manage and attend client and other stakeholder meetings and oversee completion of tasks, development of deliverables, and execution of construction supervision. * Monitor and supervise development of project deliverables along the milestone schedules and timelines of multiple projects tracked by Project Manager * Manage project priorities to ensure consistent design and deliverables between different projects. * Track and monitor all projects against budgeted hours – identify need for shifting of workflows and resource allocations as necessary. * Develop and execute QA/QC plans. Financial Metrics * Budgeting, tracking, and monitoring of same. * Contribution and margin ($ and %). * A/R oversight, including the team's efforts to collect on overdue accounts. **REQUIRED SKILLS/ABILITIES:** * Ability to work efficiently in a fast\-paced, team\-based environment. * General knowledge of (or aptitude to quickly grasp) data center infrastructure pathways and cabling concepts * General knowledge of (or aptitude to quickly grasp) BIM design workflows, model coordination, clash detection * Experience in ICT infrastructure design, with demonstrated leadership on large data center or mission\-critical campus projects. * Deep expertise in OSP pathways and cabling (duct banks, manholes, diverse routing, campus fiber systems). * Strong expertise in ISP pathways and cabling (tray/ladder rack systems, equipment layouts, backbone and distribution cabling). * Thorough knowledge of industry standards and codes (TIA, BICSI, NEC, client hyperscale standards). * Proven ability to lead technical teams, perform design reviews, and resolve complex infrastructure challenges. * Strong communication skills with the ability to interface with clients, contractors, and internal stakeholders. Preferred (Not Required) * Hyperscale data center design experience for cloud or large enterprise clients. * BICSI RCDD (or equivalent) certification. * Familiarity with Revit\-based BIM workflows and large\-scale coordination models. * Experience developing internal design standards and reusable details. **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:** * BS in Engineering, Technology\-oriented studies, Business Management, or another relevant degree. * 8\+ years of progressive experience in ICT infrastructure design, including demonstrated technical leadership and team leadership experience. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:** The physical requirements listed below represent the minimum standards that an employee must meet to perform the essential functions of this role successfully. Reasonable accommodations can be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. * Regularly required to sit, use a computer, and communicate verbally in meetings and presentations. * Occasionally required to stand, walk, and travel to client sites and project locations. * Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds (e.g., presentation materials or equipment).

jobs.title: Junior Marketing Designer
jobs.description: **ChopAir \| Kansas City, MO \| West Bottoms** **Full\-Time \| In Office** **Salary: $45,000–$50,000 annually** ChopAir is looking for a **Junior Marketing Designer** to join our growing marketing team. This is a design\-first role for someone early in their career who wants to develop across presentations, print, web, UX, content, brand work, and podcast production. You’ll work directly with **Wyatt Miller, ChopAir’s Marketing Manager**, and collaborate with teams throughout the company. We’re not just looking for someone who can make things look nice. We want someone curious about **why** something works. Why this layout? Why this color? Why this hierarchy? We want someone who enjoys exploring those questions and wants to keep getting better at answering them. **What You’ll Work On** Presentations \& Collateral * PowerPoint presentations and sales decks * Proposals and one\-pagers * Brochures and product collateral * Trade show graphics, signage, and displays * Internal and external branded materials Web \& Content * WordPress website updates * Product and manufacturer pages * Blog layouts and supporting graphics * Website imagery * General UX and content improvements * Exposure to SEO and digital marketing strategy Podcast \& Media Production * Assist with filming and recording ChopAir’s company podcast * Set up cameras, lighting, microphones, and basic recording equipment * Edit podcast footage for full\-length episodes and short\-form LinkedIn content * Perform basic video and audio synchronization, color correction, and editing * Design episode graphics, thumbnails, and promotional materials * Create branded visual assets for LinkedIn promotion * Organize and prepare video, audio, and graphic files for distribution * Understand appropriate file formats, resolutions, and export settings for different publishing needs * Support podcast publishing and distribution across designated platforms Creative Support * Image editing and photo manipulation * Brand and campaign graphics * Social media and email marketing creative * Photography and video support * Sales and marketing materials * Other creative projects as the company continues to grow * Photography experience is a plus, but not a requirement. **How We Work** Good design at ChopAir is intentional, not decorative. We want you thinking through your choices, not simply defending them. You won’t always be right, and neither will we. What matters is being able to explain your thinking, take feedback, learn from it, and continue improving the work. Communication matters a lot in this role. If something is unclear, ask. If priorities shift, communicate it. We would rather solve a problem early than discover it at the end of a project. We’re also a collaborative team, not a competitive one. We share ideas, teach each other, and jump in when someone needs help. Titles don’t excuse anyone from that. We believe creativity works best when people enjoy what they do. We take our work seriously, but that doesn't mean every day needs to feel serious. There's room to experiment, laugh, share ideas, and occasionally step away from a project when you need a fresh perspective. We want to create an environment where people enjoy coming to work and feel proud of what they create. **You’re Allowed to Be Junior** We don’t expect you to walk in knowing our industry, every tool, or our internal processes. You’ll receive direction and support while you learn, with more responsibility and ownership as your confidence grows. You’ll have opportunities to explore different areas of marketing and design, discover your strengths, and develop new ones. The goal over time is to move from: **“Tell me what to make.”** To: **“Here’s how I think we should solve this.”** We’re looking for someone who wants to grow into that kind of designer. **What We’d Like to See** * Strong foundation in typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and color * Working knowledge of Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign * Strong comfort working in PowerPoint * Interest in video production, filming, and editing * Ability to take feedback and translate it into stronger creative work * Strong attention to detail * Clear communication and willingness to ask questions * Curiosity and a desire to continuously improve * Ability to organize projects and manage priorities across different creative tasks **Nice to Have** * WordPress experience * Figma or Adobe XD experience * Photography experience * Familiarity with Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar video editing software * Experience operating cameras, lighting, and audio recording equipment * Basic video and audio editing experience * Familiarity with video export settings, file formats, and publishing workflows * Podcast or media production experience * SEO familiarity * Digital marketing experience * Basic understanding of UX/UI principles A design\-related degree is welcome but **not required**. Your **portfolio, fundamentals, creativity, and thought process matter more than the name of your degree**. Recent graduates and early\-career designers are encouraged to apply. **Compensation \& Benefits** * **Salary: $45,000–$50,000 annually**, depending on experience * Health benefits * Paid time off * Opportunity to grow alongside an expanding company and marketing department * Direct mentorship and professional development from ChopAir’s Marketing Manager * Exposure to multiple areas of design, marketing, and media production * Opportunities to take ownership of projects as your skills develop **Location** This is an **in\-office position** based at ChopAir’s office in the **West Bottoms of Kansas City, Missouri**. The role involves collaborating directly with our marketing and sales teams, participating in creative discussions, and supporting hands\-on projects, including photography, podcast filming, and physical collateral production. **About ChopAir** ChopAir is a growing commercial and industrial HVAC manufacturer’s representative and distributor serving contractors, engineers, building owners, and developers. Our business spans air distribution, ventilation, industrial fans, building controls, heating, and other specialty HVAC solutions. As ChopAir continues to grow, so does the way we communicate our brand, products, expertise, and relationships. Our marketing department supports everything from technical presentations and digital experiences to campaigns, trade shows, and media production. We're building a company that values technical expertise, strong relationships, thoughtful execution, creativity, and people who want to keep getting better at what they do. **Ready to Apply?** Send us your resume and portfolio showcasing your design work. We’re interested in seeing how you think, not just the finished product. Whether your portfolio includes school projects, freelance work, personal projects, or professional experience, we want to see what you can do and what excites you about design. **Portfolio required with application.** Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

This role will be focused on providing quality engineering support to the new product development process, operations/production, and quality systems. This individual will also serve as a Quality representative to improve awareness, visibility, and communication on quality initiatives to support site and corporate quality goals and priorities. **Key Responsibilities:** * Provide Quality Engineering support for engineering product development, or sustained manufacturing. * Provide Quality Project Management support as needed for product transfers from development to validation to production. * Verification/Validation System Owner responsible for the development and management of the verification/validation master plan along with the verification/validation determination. * Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures. * Develop and maintain project Quality Plans for assigned projects. * Develop protocols, perform statistical analyses, and write reports for validations and formal product/process development, which requires quality\-engineering involvement. * Support the development and implementation of IQ (Installation Qualification) and OQ (Operational Qualification) protocols to ensure compliance with the Quality System. * Provide Quality Engineering support for engineering/manufacturing. * CAPA (Corrective and Preventative Action) system owner or support responsible for the support of the corrective action system and procedures. * Interact with customers and suppliers to resolve CAPA and complaint investigations. * Provide Quality Support for the disposition of material via NCRs. * Support supplier quality activities including vendor approval and maintaining and assessing vendor performance data (i.e. SCAR/on time). * Review and document procedure changes for quality requirements and compliance with the quality system. * Develop quality systems and procedures as needed. * Audit support for third party audits, customer audits and internal audits. * Support the implementation of continuous improvement initiatives. * Develop and maintain production quality control plans. * Initiate and maintain SPC (Statistical Process Control) for production processes. * Lead or support FMEA (Failure Modes \& Effects Analysis), and DOE (Design of Experiment) as applicable. * May serve as backup to Quality Manager **Must Have:** * A Bachelor's degree (STEM engineering discipline) * 5 years of experience in an engineering environment with mechanical, tool design, and manufacturing processes (medical device preferred). * Must be fluent in use of computer systems for the analysis of data, specifically Microsoft Office. * Must possess excellent verbal communication, organizational and management skills. * Training or equivalent experience in computer use and software\-Microsoft Word, Excel, Power Point and Access. jobs.description: **The application window is expected to close on:** 12/30/2026This position requires that you live within commuting distance of our San Jose, CA office and commute to the office at least 4\-5 days per week. Meet the Team Cisco Silicon One (\#CiscoSiliconOne) is a business organization with a long track record of building complex and high\-performance Silicon ASICs. Our silicon devices drive the world’s most complex networks and carry over 90% of IP traffic. Our team designs, develops, and operates highly scalable, reliable, and secure distributed storage services that power cloud\-native applications across Cisco. We build resilient services deployed across Kubernetes and AWS environments, with a focus on scalability, availability, security, and operational excellence. Our engineers work closely with engineering, architecture, product management, and other cross\-functional partners to design solutions that simplify the customer experience while meeting demanding production requirements. In this role, you will remain hands\-on while providing technical leadership across distributed storage and cloud\-native services. You will contribute to architectural decisions, lead features and projects from design through production, and help establish strong engineering and operational practices across the team. Our engineers own the full service lifecycle, from design and implementation through deployment, observability, on\-call response, and continuous improvement. The team's portfolio spans graph, key\-value, and related structured\-storage services running on premises and across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Lead small\-to\-medium features from technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production validation, and contribute to larger initiatives spanning multiple teams. Develop clean, maintainable, secure production code and unit tests while helping establish strong coding and engineering practices across teams. Contribute to service architecture and technical design decisions with a focus on security, scalability, reliability, simplification, and user experience. Develop and operate software deployed in Kubernetes\-based and containerized environments, including monitoring and observability capabilities that improve service reliability and performance. Proactively identify, prioritize, and resolve risks and complex issues in development and production environments. Lead postmortems and root\-cause analysis, drive durable corrective actions, and help ensure effective on\-call coverage and operational readiness. jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: Professional Engineer (P.E.) required Candidates across New England and Mid Atlantic will be considered. **POSITION SUMMARY** The Senior Electrical Engineer is responsible for the design, review, and coordination of electrical systems for new construction, remodels, and infrastructure upgrades across commercial and retail facilities. This role provides technical leadership for power distribution, lighting, controls, refrigeration support systems, energy management system (EMS) integrations, and other critical building systems. The Senior Electrical Engineer partners with internal stakeholders, consultants, contractors, and vendors to ensure code\-compliant, cost\-effective, and constructible solutions. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Review, design, and coordinate electrical systems for new construction, remodels, and capital improvement projects. * Develop and review electrical plans, load calculations, circuiting, equipment layouts, and specifications. * Utilize AutoCAD and/or Revit to support electrical design and drawing reviews. * Coordinate electrical requirements with Architecture, Mechanical, Refrigeration, Controls, EMS, and Construction teams. * Perform engineering reviews, redlines, and code compliance evaluations for design packages. * Support bid package preparation, vendor selection, and equipment procurement activities. * Evaluate system changes and provide technical recommendations to improve performance, reliability, safety, and cost effectiveness. * Investigate and resolve equipment, installation, and field construction issues. * Research and assess emerging technologies, equipment, vendors, and engineering best practices. * Ensure all designs meet client requirements, applicable codes, industry standards, and utility requirements. * Provide senior\-level technical review and redlining of electrical plans, calculations, and specifications prepared by internal teams or external engineering consultants. * Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers and designers. **TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS** * Travel up to 15% to support field assessments, site visits, project meetings, and construction inspections. * Conduct on\-site assessments of existing electrical systems and provide recommendations regarding system condition, safety, and replacement needs. * Perform field inspections of completed installations for compliance with plans, specifications, and applicable codes. Prepare deficiency reports and support corrective actions. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering. * 10\+ years of progressive electrical engineering experience within an MEP consulting, design\-build, retail industrial, or similar technical environment. * **Professional Engineer (PE) license required**. * Extensive experience with electrical distribution, lighting, grounding, and life safety systems in commercial, retail, industrial, or supermarket facilities. * Demonstrated expertise performing high‑level technical reviews, code compliance evaluations, and system\-level coordination. * Strong verbal and written communication skills, including client\-facing interaction. * Deep knowledge of the National Electrical Code (NFPA 70\), applicable building codes, and industry standards. * Proficiency in reviewing AutoCAD or Revit\-based design packages. **SKILLS \& COMPETENCIES** * Expert knowledge of commercial and retail electrical systems, including power distribution, lighting, grounding, and life safety. * Strong command of the National Electrical Code (NFPA 70\), applicable building codes, and utility requirements. * Proven ability to perform senior‑level engineering review, redlining, and code compliance evaluation. * Experience coordinating electrical systems across mechanical, refrigeration, controls, and architectural disciplines. * Demonstrated engineering judgment with the ability to assess constructability and recommend cost‑effective solutions. * Effective technical communicator with strong client‑facing consulting skills. * Project management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple assignments, manage deadlines, and support concurrent projects. * Ability to mentor junior engineers and support the development of engineering standards. * Detail‑oriented, quality‑focused, and effective at resolving complex technical issues. **ABOUT CBES** City Building Engineering Services (CBES) is a leading integrated professional services firm supporting technical requirements and sustainable solutions for the retail and related industries. Utilizing our vast array of in\-house resources, CBES experts tackle the most challenging projects from inception to completion, including project design, engineering, construction and commissioning. Our integrated team provides unique value serving our clients and our climate. **WHY SHOULD YOU WORK AT CBES?** CBES is part of a global network of leading professional services, infrastructure management, and data\-driven sustainability solutions firms for starters. We offer a generous benefits package that includes 28 days of PTO along with a 401(k) with immediate vesting and company match. We don’t just hire anyone at CBES; we’re looking for team members with a deep sense of responsibility, an ability to collaborate, a desire to learn and grow, a willingness to always lend a helping hand. When you join CBES, you’re committing to making a difference. We make a commitment to you too – helping you embark on a career with purpose! Whether through our world\-classes training or our Leadership Development framework – CBES cares passionately about the people we hire and ensures that growth is always on the horizon. Wondering if this is the place for you to take the next step in your career? If you put clients first, care passionately about what you do and are committed to working on a team that respects each other, this is the place for you! So, if you’re ready to get started, let’s go! CBES is An Affirmative Action / Equal Opportunity Employer. The Company has a Drug\-Free Workplace Policy in effect that is strictly adhered to.
