jobs.title: Full Stack Developer - AODocs
jobs.description: Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in technology who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced **Full Stack Developer,** you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. If so, consider an opportunity with Deloitte under our Project Delivery Talent Model. Project Delivery Model (PDM) is a talent model that is tailored specifically for long\-term, onsite client service delivery. **Work you'll do/Responsibilities** As a Full Stack Developer you will build data migration tooling to transition client's document management to the AODocs platform, and provide ongoing operational support including solution development, bug fixes, enhancements to the document compare utility, third\-party integrations, performance monitoring, and change management. Services also include business analysis, project/program management, and technical support for the Google Application Engine, with deliverables spanning migration tooling, solutions development planning, fixes, integrations, enhancements, and regular reporting. The successful candidate would possess these skills: * Develop new features, enhancements, and customizations on the AODocs and LEA Doc Compare platforms using Java, Python, and REST APIs on GCP. * Provide production support and bug fixes during standard US business hours under the 8x5 delivery model (no 24x7 coverage required). * Serve as first responder for customer requests originating in US time zones; delegate work to India\-based developers as needed. * Coordinate with the AODocs (third\-party) product support team on upgrades, certifying changes in staging before production release. * Execute manual build/deployment for customizations, validating changes prior to go\-live. * Support onboarding of new teams/libraries onto AODocs, including maintaining/updating existing data\-migration tooling. * Participate in disaster resiliency testing (DiRT) activities, documenting recovery steps so someone unfamiliar with the architecture can replicate the environment. * Collaborate with the Solution Designer and Technical Project Manager on requirement clarification and delivery sequencing. * Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team * Effective written and verbal communication skills * Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product * Ability to build and sustain professional relationships * Ability to lead projects or workstreams * Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment * Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor * Ability to meet deadlines **The Team** AI \& Engineering leverages cutting\-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission\-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology \& data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements. **Qualifications** **Required** * 3\+yrs experience in AODocs, Java, Python, REST APIs, GCP stack; hands\-on AODocs and LEA Doc Compare experience; production support/bug\-fix experience in a customer\-facing support model * 3\+yrs experience in Java, Python, REST APIs, SQL, GCP services; experience customizing and extending third\-party platforms (AODocs, LEA Doc Compare) rather than building from scratch. * Familiarity with G3\-style documentation and review tooling. * Experience delivering within a defined 8x5 support window (not 24x7\); able to triage, prioritize, and resolve bugs from a live ticket/bug queue. * First point of contact for customer requests arriving in US business hours; able to delegate/hand off tasks to India\-based developers when work extends beyond the US day. * Comfortable with largely manual build/deployment pipelines for platform customizations; coordinates directly with the third\-party AODocs product support team on upgrades and production releases. * Clear technical documentation; works independently against evolving/undocumented legacy customizations; comfortable being the escalation point between US customers and offshore team members. * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience. * Limited immigration sponsorship may be available Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve * **Recruiting tips** From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters. **Benefits** This position is aligned with the Project Delivery Model. To view the associated benefit package, please reference this document USBenefitsJourneyProjectandCenterTAM **Our people and culture** Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients' most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work. Deloitte is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for people with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the recruiting process, please direct your inquiries to the Global Call Center (GCC) at USTalentCICInbox@deloitte.com. **Our purpose** Deloitte's purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities. Learn more. **Professional development** From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there's always room to learn. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership opportunities and connect and grow through mentorship. From on\-the\-job learning experiences to formal development programs, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career. Qualified applicants with criminal histories, including arrest or conviction records, will be considered for employment in accordance with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, City of Los Angeles's Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the California Fair Chance Act. See notices of various fair chance hiring and ban\-the\-box laws where available. **Fair Chance Hiring and Ban\-the\-Box Notices \- Deloitte US Careers** You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: GenAI Applied Scientist and Solution Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** The AI Transformation Team, part of the Applied AI Strategic Growth Market (AAI SGM), is dedicated to accelerating the adoption and delivery of agentic AI solutions within Deloitte. We work at the intersection of business and technology, rapidly evaluating, prototyping, and scaling AI\-powered solutions that drive measurable value. Recruiting for this role ends on 10/31/2026\. **Role Description:** The Applied AI SGM AI Transformation Team is seeking a GenAI Applied Scientist and Solution Engineer to join our intake solutioning team for top\-prioritized agentic AI solutions in our Enterprise Solutions. You will support the end\-to\-end process for agentic AI solutions: use case intake, solution feasibility assessment, solution design, requirements gathering, technology and tooling selection, and initial prototyping. You will also serve as the link between business stakeholders and technical development teams, ensuring clear handoffs and robust solution foundations. This role requires a blend of traditional software engineering skills, cloud solution architecture experience, and hands\-on expertise with generative AI models and agentic frameworks. **Qualifications:** * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills * Software Engineering: Strong proficiency in Python and Git, grounded in core software engineering practice including modular design, API design, testing, code review, and CI/CD. * Cloud Solution Architecture: Experience designing and deploying solutions on Azure, GCP, or AWS, including the security, integration, and cost considerations that shape design. * Design Trade\-offs and Technical Judgment: Ability to translate business objectives into technical options, and to explain the effort, risk, and value of each in terms stakeholders can act on, driving decisions on scope, sequencing, and architecture. * Generative AI APIs: Hands\-on experience integrating and orchestrating solutions using APIs from OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar providers. * AI Tool Experience: Hands\-on experience with AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT, ideally including code generation work with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc. * Agentic Frameworks: Familiarity with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Vertex AI Agent Development Kit, or OpenAI Agents SDK. * Solution Evaluation: Ability to assess build vs. buy decisions, evaluate risk, data requirements, ROI, and timelines. * Stakeholder Collaboration and Design Trade\-offs: Experience working with business and technical stakeholders to prioritize and align solution opportunities, translating business objectives into technical options and explaining the effort, risk, and value of each in terms stakeholders can act on. * Project and Team Leadership: Experience scoping and sequencing delivery work, managing timelines across concurrent intakes, coordinating handoffs with development teams, and mentoring less experienced engineers. * Responsible AI and Risk: Familiarity with data privacy, confidentiality, and auditability requirements for enterprise AI, human\-in\-the\-loop design, and agent\-specific risks such as prompt injection and tool permission scope. * Agent Interoperability (preferred): Exposure to emerging standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A) for connecting agents to enterprise tools, data sources, and other agents. * Full Solution Lifecycle (preferred): Experience taking solutions from intake through prototyping to deployment and adoption. * Ability to travel 0\-10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $93,000 to $191,000\. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance. jobs.description: Description: Diality is a medical device company focused on developing solutions to improve lives impacted by kidney disease. Diality offers the Moda\-flx Hemodialysis System, a user\-friendly, mobile, and connected hemodialysis system designed to maximize clinical flexibility and ease\-of\-use for both clinical and non\-clinical users. The Moda\-flx Hemodialysis system combines flow rate capabilities of conventional in\-center dialysis devices with a fully integrated reverse osmosis (RO) water filtration system to provide a broad range of prescriptions and meet the needs of any professional dialysis care setting. The Associate Director of Software, Digital Health Solutions, leads the development of digital products that support Diality’s vision: revolutionizing dialysis across every setting—empowering patients, inspiring innovation, and expanding access to care. This strategic role will bridge technology and clinical impact by building cloud\-based solutions that leverage device data for a range of user types, through thoughtful execution and cross\-functional collaboration. **Responsibilities** **Leadership \& Strategy** * Lead the definition and execution of Diality’s digital software strategy, including product roadmaps, foundational tools and infrastructure, and resourcing plans. * Mentor and guide a team of engineers and partners, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. * Identify, recruit, retain, and motivate key talent to support organizational goals. * Collaborate cross\-functionally with device software, systems, research, and product teams to align digital software development with the overall product strategy. * Champion a culture that reflects Diality’s core values: Patient\-Centric, Driven, Accountable, and Collaborative. **Technical Oversight** * Oversee architecture, design, prototyping, testing, verification and validation, and deployment of digital software products—including cloud, connectivity, mobile applications, and AI solutions. * Ensure compliance with regulatory standards (e.g., FDA, HIPAA, IEC 62304\) and industry best practices. * Drive delivery of high\-quality, reliable software solutions. **Project \& Resource Management** * Oversee project schedules, budgets, and resource distribution to ensure timely achievement of development milestones. * Optimize resourcing strategies based on business needs, including schedule, cost, and capabilities. * Identify, evaluate, and manage external development partners. **Innovation \& Continuous Improvement** * Identify and implement emerging technologies, tools, and processes to enhance Requirements: * Deep understanding of AWS and cloud architecture, mobile development, and embedded systems * Proven track record in developing and deploying Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) * Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset * Demonstrated ability to collaborate closely with cross\-functional stakeholders—including clinical, product, and commercial teams—to assist in translating user needs and desired outcomes into intuitive, high\-impact digital products and services * Passion for improving lives through technology **Education \& Experience** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related field * 10\+ years of experience in software development, with 5\+ years in leadership roles. * Proven track record of delivering complex software systems in a medical device environment * Experience with EMR/EHR integration preferred * Hands\-on experience integrating AI and machine learning technologies into software solutions, with a focus on enhancing clinical decision support, predictive analytics, or personalized patient experiences * Experience navigating ambiguity and aligning technical execution with strategic business goals **Travel** * Willingness to travel domestically as needed (up to 10%), primarily to visit vendors and attend select conferences. **Physical Requirements** * Sustained periods of time standing and sitting in a laboratory * Sitting at a desk utilizing a computer * Some lifting of\<25 pounds The information contained in this job description is for compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and is not an exhaustive list of duties performed for this position.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, IAEF
jobs.description: **Overview** ============ The Founding Vice President, Engineering, leads the architecture, delivery, and engineering team for **Independent AI Evaluation Foundation (IAEF)**, a platform for evaluating the trustworthiness of artificial intelligence (AI). Reporting to the **CEO of IAEF**, this leader combines technical ownership, team development, security leadership, and external representation. Independent AI Evaluation Foundation (IAEF)’s mission is to identify and reduce barriers to evaluating the efficacy, transparency, and safety of specific educational AI\-centric solutions used by students and opportunity seekers in their educational context. IAEF is a fiscally sponsored project of Digital Harbor Foundation. Digital Harbor Foundation is dedicated to fostering learning, creativity, productivity, and community through education with a vision of digital equity for everyone. Driven by our sincere belief that access to opportunity is a basic right, we take bold yet practical actions to support making a better future now. Through a portfolio of projects focused on developing leadership within communities, we support those closest to challenges to take deliberate actions based in design thinking approach, backed by data analysis, grounded in a practice of collective impact, and driven by a commitment to racial equity. **Education and Experience Requirements** ========================================= **Required** ------------ * 12\+ years of software engineering experience, including at least four years in senior technical leadership at a startup, evaluation or audit firm, machine\-learning infrastructure company, or research\-grade platform team. * Experience building and operating a platform with a plugin, extension, or component model, and running AI evaluation, red\-teaming, machine\-learning observability, or model\-testing systems in production. * A record of hiring and retaining senior engineers in a distributed team, including at least one applied machine\-learning or agentic\-systems specialist. **Strongly preferred** ---------------------- * Prior CTO, VP Engineering, or founding\-engineer experience at an early\-stage company that raised institutional capital; experience enabling external developers to build on a platform; and prior evaluation\-methodology work with academic or civil\-society partners. * A PhD and extensive experience at a frontier AI research laboratory are not required. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** ==================================== * Ability to design reusable platform components and work with human\-in\-the\-loop (HITL) transcripts, benchmark scores, and large language model (LLM) red\-teaming results. * Ability to communicate technical decisions to enterprise security leaders, foundation program officers, investors, customers, and partners. * Ability to prioritize competing technical and organizational needs and lead a distributed engineering team through delivery, operational issues, and growth. * Understanding of the operational separation required between a public benefit corporation, a companion nonprofit, and grant\-funded programs. * Strongly preferred: experience leading implementation of ISO 42001, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, or SOC 2 requirements, rather than participating only as a reviewer. **Additional Notes** ==================== This is a full\-time, remote\-first role based in the US or EU. New York or the San Francisco Bay Area is strongly preferred for quarterly in\-person meetings with the CEO of IAEF, partners, and the board. Travel is approximately 15% for funder meetings, partner sites, conferences, and off\-sites. **Role and Responsibilities** ============================= **Platform architecture and delivery** -------------------------------------- Own the Workbench’s Design Test Analyze* Publish (DTAP) workflow, Component Contract, Artifacts API, component registry, and canvas interface. * Create a persistent, structured, queryable evaluation history rather than one\-off engagement exports, and integrate the existing red\-teaming platform, administrative dashboard, and HITL data\-capture architecture instead of rebuilding them from scratch. * Decide when to build or buy authentication, storage, orchestration, LLM\-provider services, and sandboxing for the planned notebook environment. **Engineering leadership** -------------------------- * In conjunction with the Human Resources Department of Digital Harbor Foundation, recruit, develop, and retain the engineering organization against the approved build plan, including Staff/Senior Backend, Senior Frontend, DevOps/site reliability, Applied Machine Learning, and Senior Product Manager roles * Set planning, code\-review, on\-call, incident\-response, and roadmap\-review practices; provide engineering progress and risks for board and funder reporting. **Evaluation platform strategy** -------------------------------- * Partner with the **IAFE’s CEO** and Evaluation Science Lead to translate HITL red teaming, automated benchmarks, LLM red teaming, LLM\-as\-judge, and drift detection into a Component Contract that supports all three Test artifact types and planned agentic components. **Security, compliance, and trust** ----------------------------------- * Lead vendor risk reviews for LLM providers, cloud infrastructure, and third\-party evaluation tools. * Coordinate with Digital Harbor Foundation’s Leadership, where applicable, on required approvals, funder restrictions, and separation of PBC and nonprofit resources, data, and intellectual property under approved agreements. Escalate unresolved risks rather than independently determining legal or sponsor policy. **External representation and fundraising** ------------------------------------------- * Represent IAEF in technical conversations with customers, partners, funders, and press, and own the technical content of investor fundraising decks, roadmap materials, demonstrations, and due diligence reviews in partnership with the **Executive Director of IAEF** and Digital Harbor Foundation’s leadership. * Lead the developer\-relations narrative for software and agent development kits (SDK/ADK) as the Component Contract opens to outside developers in Phase 1, partnering with the Developer Relations \& Ecosystem hire planned for Period 2\. **Other Duties** ================ This job description is not a comprehensive listing of all activities, duties, or responsibilities required for this role. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. **Compensation** Compensation for this full\-time position is $215,000 \- $315,000 annually, commensurate with experience. Digital Harbor provides a best\-in\-class, comprehensive set of benefits to support the team. All regular, full\-time employees are eligible to receive: **Health Benefits \& Insurance** * Carefirst Blue Cross Blue Shield \- Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance (100% of the premium paid for employees and 85% of dependents) * Pre\-Tax Health Savings Account (HSA) (with $365 monthly employer contributions) * Pre\-Tax Flexible Savings Account (FSA) * Paid Accidental Death \& Dismemberment (AD\&D) Insurance * Paid Short\-Term \& Long\-Term Disability Insurance * Paid Basic Life Insurance * Supplemental Voluntary Life Insurance (Employee, Spouse \& Dependent Children) * Total Pet Plan and Supplemental Wishbone Pet Insurance * Employee Opportunity Program (EAP) \- Health and Wellness * Wellness Reimbursement Program **Retirement** -------------- * 401k Retirement Plan (with 6% matching) **Paid Time Off** ----------------- * 15 Days Paid Time Off Per Year * 20 Days Paid Time Off Per Year (after 3rd Anniversary) * 25 Days Paid Time Off Per Year (after 6th Anniversary) * 16 Paid Holidays (14 common plus 2 flexible holidays, including Dec 25 \- Jan 1\) * Paid Bereavement Leave * Paid Parental Leave for Moms and Dads (two weeks after first year) If our mission and vision align with your personal values, please apply! A cover letter outlining your qualifications for the position, along with your resume, is required. Interviews will be conducted virtually. Digital Harbor and IAEF are equal opportunity employers. aUsHwyoaAV

jobs.title: Senior GTM Engineer
jobs.description: Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast\-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you'll find your place here. We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world. Revenue Operations, part of DigitalOcean's Revenue Organization, owns the systems that power our go\-to\-market motion — Salesforce at the center, connected to sales engagement (Outreach, including Kaia), customer success (Planhat), CPQ (DealHub), enrichment (Clay, Sumble), marketing automation touchpoints, and our Snowflake data layer. We're hiring a Senior GTM Engineer to own the project work that moves this stack forward. This is the builder role on the team, you take on the tier 2 escalations and the project work: implementations, integrations, automation, and the AI\-powered workflows reshaping how our GTM teams operate. You'll work with our Technical Program Manager on scoped initiatives, contribute to solution design, and be trusted to take a defined project from design through delivery across any tool in the stack. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Deliver project work across the GTM stack: new tool implementations, integration builds, automation of routing/handoff/lifecycle processes, and cross\-tool enhancements — owning them from design through testing, rollout, and enablement * Handle tier 2 escalations: the flow errors, integration failures, data model questions, and cross\-system issues that frontline triage can't resolve — tracing them to root cause and shipping durable fixes rather than patches * Build and maintain integrations and data flows using iPaaS tooling (e.g. Fivetran) and APIs, keeping data like account ownership, territories, routing, and product catalogs consistent from Snowflake to Salesforce to every downstream tool * Build AI\-powered workflows: implement AI agents and LLM\-based automation (triage, enrichment, next\-step capture), work with MCP integrations across the stack, and propose new places AI can remove manual work * Do meaningful Salesforce work: complex flows, data model changes, permission architecture updates, sandbox and release management — plus equivalent depth in Outreach, Planhat, DealHub, and Clay as projects demand * Contribute to solution design: partner with the TPM and senior engineers on requirements and architecture, flag tradeoffs and downstream impacts you see, and pressure\-test proposed approaches against how the systems actually behave * Coordinate with vendors on implementations, support cases, and POCs, and evaluate new tools hands\-on * Raise the team's bar: document your builds, establish reusable patterns, and mentor the IC2 engineer on troubleshooting and configuration **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * 5\+ years administering and building on GTM/business systems, with real depth in Salesforce (flows, data model, permissions, deployments) and hands\-on experience in at least two other GTM tool categories — sales engagement, CS platforms, CPQ, enrichment, or marketing automation * A delivery record: projects you owned end to end — implementations, integrations, or process automations — that shipped and held up in production * Integration experience: you've built and debugged real integrations via iPaaS tools and/or APIs, and you understand auth, rate limits, sync direction, and failure modes * Hands\-on experience (or strong demonstrated interest) applying AI to systems work: agents, LLM\-powered automation, or MCP\-style integrations * Data fluency: comfortable with SQL and warehouse concepts, able to trace a data quality issue from source to destination * Root\-cause discipline: you fix the class of problem, not the instance, and you write it up so it stays fixed * Strong stakeholder skills: you can turn a vague request into a scoped piece of work, communicate progress and tradeoffs clearly, and push back constructively * Familiarity with code (Apex, Python, or JavaScript) — enough to read, understand, and review it; heavy development is not the job * Salesforce certifications (Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder) are a plus **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- * **First 90 days:** You've shipped your first project, tier 2 escalations route to you naturally, and you understand how the major systems in the stack connect * **First 6 months:** You own multiple concurrent projects with the TPM, your fixes have measurably reduced recurring escalations, and at least one AI\-powered workflow you built is live * **First year:** You're the trusted builder for anything in the stack — new tools, integrations, or AI workflows — and your patterns and documentation are how the team ships **Compensation Range:** ----------------------- * $120,000 \- $140,000 * This is a remote role JR: 2026\-8282 *\#LI\-Remote* **Why You'll Like Working for DigitalOcean** -------------------------------------------- * **We innovate with purpose.** You'll be a part of a cutting\-edge technology company with an upward trajectory, who are proud to simplify cloud and AI so builders can spend more time creating software that changes the world. As a member of the team, you will be a Shark who thinks big, bold, and scrappy, like an owner with a bias for action and a powerful sense of responsibility for customers, products, employees, and decisions. * **We prioritize career development.** At DO, you'll do the best work of your career. You will work with some of the smartest and most interesting people in the industry. We are a high\-performance organization that will always challenge you to think big. Our organizational development team will provide you with resources to ensure you keep growing. We provide employees with reimbursement for relevant conferences, training, and education. All employees have access to LinkedIn Learning's 10,000\+ courses to support their continued growth and development. * **We care about your well\-being.** Regardless of your location, we will provide you with a competitive array of benefits to support you from our Employee Assistance Program to Local Employee Meetups to flexible time off policy, to name a few. While the philosophy around our benefits is the same worldwide, specific benefits may vary based on local regulations and preferences. * **We reward our employees.** The salary range for this position is based on market data, relevant years of experience, and skills. You may qualify for a bonus in addition to base salary; bonus amounts are determined based on company and individual performance. We also provide equity compensation to eligible employees, including equity grants upon hire and the option to participate in our Employee Stock Purchase Program. * **DigitalOcean is an equal\-opportunity employer.** We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service. **Application Limit:** You may apply to a maximum of 3 positions within any 180\-day period. This policy promotes better role\-candidate matching and encourages thoughtful applications where your qualifications align most strongly.

jobs.title: Lead Enterprise Architect (Disney Experiences)
jobs.description: **Lead Enterprise Architect (Disney Experiences)** At Disney Experiences Technology, our team creates world\-class immersive digital experiences for the Company’s premier vacation brands including Disney’s Parks \& Resorts worldwide, Disney Cruise Line, Aulani, A Disney Resort \& Spa, and Disney Vacation Club. We are seeking a Lead Enterprise Architect (Disney Experiences) to lead through influence — shaping strategy, driving enterprise alignment, and guiding our most critical technology initiatives across the domains. This is not an ivory\-tower role. Our Lead Architects work International Parks, Hotels, Ticketing, Retail shoulder\-to\-shoulder with business leaders, solution teams, and technologists to connect strategy with execution. The ideal candidate blends executive presence, architectural depth, and collaboration mastery, inspiring teams to deliver technology that scales the Disney magic globally. ———————— **What You Will Do** * Contribute to and influence the enterprise strategy: Prioritizing initiatives by business impact and mapping investments into capability maps for Disney Parks International based roadmaps and initiatives (International Parks, Hotels, Retail, Ticketing, etc.) * Strategic Partner: Serve as strategic partner and orchestrator for technology strategy and long\-term technology roadmap * Lead Through Influence: Operate as a senior advisor and strategic influencer to executives and domain leaders, helping align technology investments with business outcomes. * Advance Repository Practices: Ensure architectural metadata and taxonomy integrity within the BlueDolphin repository, enabling enterprise transparency and decision support. * Foster Collaboration: Build partnerships with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Security teams to co\-own outcomes, not dictate them. * Communication and Influence: Translate architectural strategy into compelling business narratives that resonate with executive audiences and technical teams alike. * Champion Modernization and Platform Thinking: Lead initiatives that simplify, modernize, and integrate platforms across Disney Parks International locations. * Balance Short\-Term Delivery with Long\-Term Strategy: Facilitate informed trade\-offs, track technical debt decisions, and ensure alignment with enterprise objectives. ⠀ ———————— **What We’re Looking For:** **Required Qualifications \& Skills** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field required. * Expertise with enterprise architecture repository tools (e.g., tools similar to BlueDolphin or LeanIX) * Strong leadership experience mentoring architecture teams * Proven ability to influence without authority across technical and business domains * Experience defining and applying metadata models, taxonomy relationships, and governance * Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-domain architectural initiatives and guide decision processes * Understanding of both front\-end and back\-end technologies * Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical decisions to business stakeholders * 7\+ years of experience as a Solution or Enterprise Architect for International locations (Parks, Hotels, Ticketing, Retail, etc.) related domains (Preferably an Enterprise Architect) * 7\+ years Engineering experience across multiple languages, both front\-end and back\-end. + Expertise in modern programming languages and technologies. + Experience with testing and debugging applications to deliver scalable enterprise solutions. **Core Leadership Capabilities** * Demonstrate executive presence: can influence VP and SVP level leaders without authority. * Proven collaboration leader who mobilizes teams across organizational boundaries. * Skilled storyteller who can articulate the “why” behind architectural direction in simple, business\-relevant terms. * Diplomatic and pragmatic — a trusted advisor who aligns people as effectively as systems. ⠀ **Enterprise Architecture Expertise** * Deep understanding of governance frameworks and ARB operations. * Experience developing and managing architecture taxonomies, patterns, and standards. * Proven ability to align architecture with strategic objectives, OKRs, and scorecards. * Hands\-on familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), API\-led integration, security\-by\-design, and data architecture principles. * Experience integrating emerging platforms or modernizing legacy systems at scale. ⠀ **Business and Cultural Alignment** * Experience supporting International Parks, Hotels, Ticketing, Retail platforms preferred. * Thrives in a federated, creative, and high\-visibility environment, where technology enables storytelling and guest experience. * Comfortable operating in matrixed organizations and partnering with multiple business units. * Exceptional written and verbal communication skills — clear, concise, and outcome\-oriented. **Software Engineering** * Deliver high\-impact projects supporting enterprise platforms and technology infrastructure. * Contribute to the design, testing, and implementation of major systems and applications. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders to define requirements and influence technical direction. * Shape scalable architectures and support planning for complex enterprise projects. * Evaluate emerging technologies within your area of expertise to guide strategic recommendations.⠀ **Preferred Qualifications** * Advanced degree (MBA, MS) preferred. * Experience delivering architecture in platform\-oriented and product\-led organizations * Background in API design and messaging standards * Knowledge of security\-by\-design principles and secure architecture practices * Experience integrating SaaS solutions and working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) * Familiarity with architecture maturity models and scorecards * Certifications such as TOGAF, ArchiMate, or equivalent enterprise architecture frameworks are desirable. * 7\+ years of experience working with cloud vendors * 7\+ years of experience with databases (relational and non\-relational) * Experience with SaaS vendor implementations * Experience with messaging patterns and API design best practices * Experience implementing security best practices and security\-by\-design ⠀ ———————— **The Ideal Candidate** Lead Enterprise Architect (Disney Experiences) * Thinks strategically like an executive and acts pragmatically like a builder. * Is as comfortable on stage presenting to VPs as in workshops with engineers. * Believes architecture is a team sport — driven by collaboration, context, and clarity. * Measures success not by control, but by influence and adoption. The hiring range for this position in Orlando, Florida is $145,000\-$175,000 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

jobs.title: HR Business Partner (HRBP)
jobs.description: **About Distyl AI** =================== Distyl is an applied AI technology company partnering with the world’s most ambitious institutions to rearchitect critical operations for the frontier of AI. Our customers include the largest companies in telecom, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing, consumer goods, and global social organizations. We research and deploy technologies that power AI\-native operations — both for our partners and for Distyl itself. Our work spans research into self\-constructing systems, the development of the most reliable execution of AI systems, and products that transform mission\-critical workflows. As a result, Distyl's technologies affect some of the world's largest operations — from hundreds of millions of consumer interactions to tens of millions of supply chain transactions and millions of patient journeys. Distyl is backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Coatue, DST Global, and the board\-members of 20\+ F500s. **What We Are Looking For** =========================== You will be Distyl's first HR Business Partner reporting directly to the Head of People. You will help define what business partnering looks like here, and get to build out our core capabilities in this function. Your client group includes engineers, researchers, AI strategists, growth, and the leaders who run those teams. Most of the people you support build and ship technical systems for a living so having a passion for technology and its possibilities is critical. A typical day might be to coach people through the moments that matter, diagnosing organizational issues and building solutions to them, researching compensation on a novel role, or facilitating a manager skill building session. This is a true opportunity to put your fingerprints on how we scale our People function. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * **Partner with managers and leaders:** Be the first call for managers across the company on team performance, structure, hiring plans, and the conversations they are putting off. You will listen, offer coaching, back it with evidence, and help the business move forward with your guidance * **Coach:** Coach managers and ICs through growth, feedback, and transitions. Make the people who lead teams here measurably better at it, and our teams stronger as a result * **Apply frameworks inside teams:** Help to define evidence backed frameworks that allow Distyl to scale and that our systems are designed fairly and thoughtfully * **Advise on compensation:** Be fluent in our bands and philosophy so you can guide managers on offers, promotions, and merit decisions * **Lead team\-level org design and change:** When a team restructures, a leader changes, or scope shifts, you run the change: the design, the sequencing, the comms, and the follow\-through * **Read the system:** Use engagement data, attrition signals, and what you hear in 1:1s to tell the leadership team what is actually happening in the org before it shows up as a problem * **Work AI\-native:** Use AI tools daily in your own work, from documentation to analysis to prep and create repeatable systems with it **Who You Are** =============== * **At least 5 to 8 years in HR with a background in business partnering:** You have been an embedded partner to a leadership team, coached employees and managers through difficult moments, and navigated complex employee relations issues and organizational changes with sound judgment and discretion * **Direct, kind, low ego:** You give feedback thoughtfully, care about your work and others around you, and focus more on outcomes than credit * **Tech or AI background, strongly preferred:** You have supported engineers, researchers, or technical leaders at a technology company and earned their trust. You understand how technical teams work, what they respect, and what makes them tune out. Experience inside an AI or applied\-AI company is a plus * **Coaching that holds up:** You coach managers rather than solve their problems for them, and you can point to leaders who improved because of you * **Comp literacy:** You can read a band, explain a leveling decision, and hold the line on an off\-cycle request and when an exception might be warranted * **Org design and change management in practice:** You have run at least one team\-level restructure or leader transition from design through comms and follow\-through. You know the difference between an org chart and an org * **Systems thinker:** You understand the system before you design the intervention. You separate symptoms from causes and resist the quick fix * **Builder's instinct:** You have operated without a playbook and then written one. You are comfortable being first. Experience in a high growth startup environment is preferred **What We Offer** ================= * The base salary range for this role is $180,000\-$220,000, depending on experience, location, and level. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for meaningful equity, along with a comprehensive benefits package * 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents * Flexible time off * Retirement and financial planning benefits, including access to pre\-tax HSA, FSA, and commuter accounts, 401(k), and financial coaching resources * Comprehensive wellness benefits, including physical fitness, mental well\-being, and fertility and family\-building benefits through Carrot * Complimentary in\-office lunches and snacks provided * Access to state\-of\-the\-art AI models, generous usage of modern AI tools, and real\-world business problems * Ownership of high\-impact projects across top enterprises * A mission\-driven, fast\-moving culture that values curiosity, pragmatism, and excellence Distyl has offices in San Francisco and New York. This role follows a hybrid collaboration model with 3\+ days per week (Tuesday–Thursday) in‑office. *\#LI\-Hybrid* We believe diverse perspectives make our work stronger and more impactful. We are an equal opportunity employer and evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Domino’s is a purpose\-inspired, performance\-driven company powered by exceptional people who are committed to feeding the power of possible—one pizza at a time. Founded in 1960 as a single store in Ypsilanti, Michigan, Domino’s has grown into the largest pizza company in the world, with more than 22,300 stores across 90\+ markets. Our success is built on the strength of our people, technology, and franchise system. As a leader in innovation, we continue to transform the pizza and QSR industry while creating opportunities for team members to learn, grow and thrive. If you're ready to make an impact, build a meaningful career and help shape what's next, there's a place for you at Domino's. **Job Description** Domino’s continues its journey towards the dominant \#1 Pizza Company in the world and sound data is the most fundamental of assets that helps us drive towards that. To help accelerate our drive, we are looking for a driven Databricks Data Platform Engineer to join our team at World Resource Center (WRC) in Ann Arbor, MI. **Main Responsibilities** * Administer and support Databricks workspaces, clusters, jobs, runtimes, compute policies, SQL Warehouses, and platform configurations. * Troubleshoot and resolve production issues involving cluster instability, jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **The Company** DRINKSTATION is a **hardware technology startup** that designs, manufactures, and sells the most advanced beverage dispensing appliances on the market. Our flagship system, the **Da Vinci 2\.0**, delivers purified, sparkling, chilled, and near\-boiling water on demand — replacing the filter, kettle, sparkling\-water maker, and pitcher with one integrated appliance. Our **Model\-J** pushes the platform further into **multi\-beverage dispensing and flavored water**, serving a range of customizable beverages on demand from a single connected machine. Founded in Los Angeles in 2014 on more than two decades of water\-dispensing R\&D, we now operate across three countries: our **U.S. headquarters in Torrance, CA**, our **engineering and manufacturing facility in Shenzhen, China**, and our **R\&D and patent center in Pisa, Italy**. With 80\+ team members, **100\+ patents**, decades of combined experience, and an ambitious product roadmap, we're scaling fast — and we need an operator who can keep the whole machine running as we grow. **The Role** We're looking for a Software Engineer to help accelerate development across our connected products and internal tools. You'll write real code that ships — powering the apps, interfaces, and systems behind our beverage machines, and building the tools that keep our global operation running. This is a great fit for a sharp, hungry engineer early in their career — including recent grads — who wants to move fast, own meaningful work from day one, and grow quickly in a startup where your impact is visible. You'll work closely with our engineering and product teams across the U.S., China, and Italy. **What You'll Do** * Build and ship features across our software stack — device interfaces, mobile/web apps, and the back\-end systems that connect our machines * Collaborate with hardware, operations, and R\&D teams to bring new product capabilities to life (including our multi\-beverage **Juli 5\.0** platform) * Debug, test, and improve existing systems for reliability and performance * Use AI tools heavily to accelerate your own development and ship more, faster * Learn the full picture — from firmware and connected devices to customer\-facing apps — and grow into greater ownership over time **What We're Looking For** **Required** * Solid programming fundamentals and a real desire to build — degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent hands\-on experience (bootcamp, personal projects, internships) * Proficiency in one or more modern languages (e.g., **Python, jobs.title: Field Commissioning Engineer - Warehouse Robotics & Automation
jobs.description: Exotec designs elegant, plug\-and\-play, and reliable end\-to\-end warehouse robotics solutions. As a leading original equipment manufacturer (OEM) and integrator, we support some of the world’s most iconic brands in their transition to automation. We’re proud to design technology that doesn’t just redefine intralogistics, it also makes warehouses safer, faster, more efficient, and less physically demanding for the people working inside them. **Why This Role Matters** As a **Field Commissioning Engineer**, you’ll be the boots on the ground bringing Exotec’s robotics and automation systems to life at our client warehouse locations. It's a high\-travel position (our engineers are on\-site generally 3 weeks out of each month), but an ideal role for individuals who love solving real engineering challenges in real\-world environments. Working hands\-on with robotics, hardware, software, programming tools, and third‑party industrial equipment, you'll gain broad technical experience quickly. Unlike other "engineering" roles in the industry, this is a true engineering position where you help design and refine test plans—not just execute them. The work is varied, collaborative, and directly tied to the success of each system launch. **What You'll Do** * Manage the integration of Exotec products and third‑party systems on customer warehouse, distribution, and fulfillment sites * Actively participate in the commissioning process to ensure system functionality and reliability * Plan, coordinate, and execute system validation tests—including defining and refining test plans * Measure, improve, and maintain the reliability of the full solution throughout deployment phases * Coordinate and implement software configurations and improvements to deployed systems * Troubleshoot across software, mechanical, electrical, and networking layers * Communicate directly with customers to assess and fulfill their needs and requirements * Provide clear updates and documentation through Exotec’s internal tools, including coordination with the Atlanta‑based team * Support on\-site interactions with clients, including de\-escalating challenging or time‑sensitive situations * Inform operational teams on project progress and risks **Requirements** We strongly encourage applications from candidates of all genders to help us build a truly inclusive environment. If you don’t meet every requirement listed below, don’t worry—your skills and experiences may still make you a great fit * At least 1 year of commissioning robotic systems and/or equipment, ideally in industrial automation, material handling, warehousing, or logistics * Demonstrated experience with frequent travel (e.g., field service, commissioning, consulting, construction, or similar roles) * BS degree in mechatronics, robotics, mechanical, or electrical engineering (or related field) * Broad working knowledge across software, mechanical, and electrical engineering, with the ability to perform both hands\-on troubleshooting and software configuration * Clear, professional communication skills, including the ability to manage on‑site client interactions and de‑escalate as needed * Ability to work within internal systems and tools for documentation, notes, coordination, collaborate with off\-site team members, etc. * **Comfort and openness with regular travel** (up to 100% of working hours) * **Ability to meet the physical demands of the job:** * + Use and manipulation of standard hand tools + Occasional lifting up to 50 lbs + Working from heights of up to 50 ft + Use and operation of lifts with a manufacturer‑rated capacity of **250 lbs**, including tools and equipment (approximately 30 lbs) + Stooping, kneeling, crouching or crawling to access and repair equipment at ground level + Working on overhead equipment, including extended reaching and manual dexterity **Preferred Skills \& Competencies:** * Working knowledge of AutoCAD (reading and minor edits) * Familiarity with Python, Node‑RED, or Linux * Experience with Git/GitHub * Prior work on complex automation or robotics systems * Experience contributing to the creation of test plans or validation procedures **Benefits** * Competitive compensation package, inclusive of salary and annual bonus * Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage * Generous vacation and time off policy * 401(k) with company match up to 5% * Continuous opportunities for training and development within a growing, international company * Regular company\-hosted teambuilding, training and social events *To apply, please submit your résumé. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the next steps in the hiring process. We look forward to receiving your application!*

jobs.description: Location: New York Other locations: Anywhere in Region Salary: Competitive Date: Sep 28, 2026 **Job description** ------------------- Requisition ID: 1746705 Location: New York, Charlotte, Atlanta At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. **The opportunity:** Our Financial Services ("FSO") teams help clients address complex transformation priorities across Banking, Insurance and Capital Markets. This opportunity combines Insurance Risk, Credit Risk and Capital Markets technology expertise with modern engineering to deliver high\-impact enterprise transformation programs. Financial institutions are modernizing risk, finance and trading platforms to improve scalability, transparency, control and responsiveness. The role supports cloud\-native risk platforms, analytical and model\-execution engines, regulatory and actuarial processing, and front\-to\-back modernization across front\-office, middle\-office and back\-office functions. Key capabilities include pricing and positions, pre\-trade and counterparty risk, Value at Risk (VaR), stress testing, sensitivities, XVA, clean P\&L, hypothetical P\&L, actual P\&L, P\&L attribution, settlement, reconciliation and regulatory reporting. As a Senior Technology Consultant, you will be a hands\-on member of the engineering team, working with architects, managers, business stakeholders, traders, risk teams, actuaries, model developers and operations teams. You will translate functional and analytical requirements into reliable software components, data pipelines, cloud services and integration solutions across trading, risk, finance and operations. **Your key responsibilities:** **Risk Technology \& Solution Architecture** * Contribute to the design, development and modernization of Insurance and Credit Risk platforms. * Translate business, regulatory, actuarial and analytical requirements into technical designs and implementation tasks. * Develop components for front\-to\-back Capital Markets modernization across front\-office trading and pricing, middle\-office risk and controls, and back\-office settlement, accounting and reconciliation. * Implement and enhance capabilities supporting VaR, stress testing, sensitivities, XVA, counterparty risk, clean P\&L, hypothetical P\&L, actual P\&L and P\&L attribution. * Build components supporting Credit Risk Management, CECL / IFRS 9, CCAR stress testing, Expected Credit Loss, portfolio analytics, regulatory reporting, insurance modeling and reserving, and liquidity or balance\-sheet risk. * Participate in solution reviews and recommend improvements for maintainability, performance and scalability. **Platform Engineering** * Develop cloud\-native services supporting model execution, analytical workloads and risk calculations. * Implement distributed processing, workflow orchestration and event\-driven integration patterns. * Optimize application and data\-processing performance through profiling, testing and engineering improvements. * Apply platform standards for resiliency, scalability, observability, security and supportability. **Data \& Analytics** * Develop and maintain data models supporting Insurance and Credit Risk calculations. * Build data pipelines and integration services across risk engines, data lakes and operational systems. * Implement controls supporting lineage, governance, auditability, data quality and reconciliation. **Engineering Delivery and Collaboration** * Deliver high\-quality software through design, development, unit testing, code review and technical documentation. * Collaborate effectively with onshore and offshore teams across architecture, development, data, testing and platform engineering. * Participate in design reviews, sprint planning, estimation, defect resolution and production\-readiness activities. * Share technical knowledge and provide guidance to junior engineers when appropriate. **Skills and attributes for success:** * Strong software\-engineering fundamentals with the ability to understand risk\-domain requirements. * Ability to solve technical problems, communicate design choices and work effectively in multidisciplinary teams. * Commitment to engineering quality, automated testing, documentation and continuous improvement. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. **Required domain expertise:** **Insurance Risk** * Insurance Risk Management * Actuarial Modeling Platforms * Reserving and Capital Models * Solvency Frameworks * Risk Aggregation and Reporting * Insurance Data Platforms * Reinsurance Processing **Credit Risk** * CECL / IFRS 9 * Credit Portfolio Analytics * Probability of Default (PD) * Loss Given Default (LGD) * Exposure at Default (EAD) * Credit Stress Testing * Regulatory Capital * Counterparty Credit Risk * Basel Frameworks **Financial Risk Programs** Experience supp nowledge of Python; exposure to Scala or C\+\+ is beneficial. * Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, source control and modern software\-delivery practices. * Undergraduate or graduate degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, actuarial science, finance or a related field. * Prior consulting experience is preferred. **What we offer you** At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers. * We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is: * + New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $122,900 to $204,900 + Bay Area California offices – $128,100 to $213,400 + All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $102,500 to $187,900 * Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options. * Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being. **Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.** * To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six\-month period. * EY accepts applications for this position on an on\-going basis. * For those living in California, please click here for additional information. * At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment. **EY \| Building a better working world** EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets. Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow. EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. This position provides hands\-on technical support across a variety of customer environments. The technician will support computer deployments, hardware installations, Microsoft technologies, end users, networking, troubleshooting, technical documentation, and customer\-site service activities. This is a **regular part\-time employment position**, not an internship or temporary work\-experience program. ABOUT EAGLE TECH CORP Eagle Tech Corp provides Managed IT Services, Cybersecurity, Microsoft solutions, AI Management \& Governance, and Business Applications to commercial and government customers. Our technical team supports customers with their day\-to\-day technology needs while helping improve productivity, security, and operational efficiency. POSITION SUMMARY The IT Field Technician / IT Support Technician will provide hands\-on technology support at Eagle Tech Corp's Springfield office and customer locations. The technician must be able to independently handle common desktop\-support issues, workstation deployments, Microsoft 365 support, hardware installations, basic network troubleshooting, and customer\-site service requests. More complex issues will be documented and escalated to senior technicians or engineers. Responsibilities include computer installations, workstation deployments, hardware replacements, end\-user support, Microsoft 365 support, network\-connectivity troubleshooting, equipment preparation, IT asset management, and service\-ticket documentation. **A minimum of one year of hands\-on experience in IT support, help desk, desktop support, field service, or a comparable technical position is required.** The successful candidate must be dependable, professional, comfortable working directly with customers, and able to follow established technical, security, documentation, and escalation procedures. SCHEDULE \& GUARANTEED HOURS This is a **part\-time, hourly position with a guaranteed minimum of 20 paid working hours per week**. * Eagle Tech Corp guarantees a minimum of **20 paid working hours each week**. * Additional hours may be available based on client demand, projects, and business needs. * Hours beyond the guaranteed 20 hours must be scheduled or approved by Eagle Tech Corp. * Work will generally be scheduled Monday through Friday based on customer and operational requirements. * The specific weekly schedule may vary depending on service appointments, deployments, projects, and customer needs. * Travel to customer locations may be required. * All hours worked must be accurately recorded in Eagle Tech Corp's approved ticketing and/or timekeeping systems. * Employees will be compensated for all hours worked in accordance with applicable wage and overtime laws. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES * Independently diagnose and resolve common Microsoft Windows desktop and laptop issues. * Set up, install, configure, and deploy desktop and laptop computers. * Perform workstation replacements, migrations, and computer\-deployment projects. * Install monitors, docking stations, keyboards, mice, printers, and other peripheral equipment. * Troubleshoot Windows operating systems and common end\-user application issues. * Provide professional end\-user technical support. * Support Microsoft 365 applications and common user issues. * Perform basic user\-account, access, and workstation\-configuration tasks. * Prepare computers and other technology equipment for deployment. * Diagnose basic LAN, Wi\-Fi, Ethernet, DNS, DHCP, and general connectivity issues. * Identify, label, and document network equipment. * Assist with Ethernet cabling and physical network connectivity. * Assist with network\-equipment and technology installations at customer locations. * Maintain accurate equipment, inventory, and IT asset information. * Organize and prepare IT equipment, tools, and replacement devices. * Complete assigned service tickets with accurate troubleshooting notes, time entries, and resolution documentation. * Communicate professionally with customers regarding assigned technical work. * Identify when an issue requires escalation. * Provide senior technical staff with complete troubleshooting and escalation documentation. * Follow Eagle Tech Corp and customer cybersecurity, confidentiality, privacy, access\-control, and acceptable\-use requirements. * Protect company and customer equipment, credentials, systems, and information from cations. * Comfortable traveling to customer locations when required. * Reliable transportation for required local customer\-site visits. * Ability to safely move and install standard computer equipment and peripherals, with or without reasonable accommodation. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS * CompTIA A\+, CompTIA Network\+, Microsoft Fundamentals, or comparable technical certifications. * IT coursework or formal technical training. * Experience working for a Managed Service Provider. * Experience with IT ticketing, remote monitoring, or endpoint\-management systems. * Experience supporting multiple customer environments. * Experience with computer\-deployment or workstation\-replacement projects. * Basic structured\-cabling or network\-equipment installation experience. Certifications and formal education are preferred but not required when the candidate has sufficient relevant hands\-on experience. COMPENSATION **$26\.00 to $30\.00 per hour** The actual hourly rate offered will be based on the candidate's relevant IT experience, demonstrated technical skills, certifications, education, and ability to independently perform the responsibilities of the position. Candidates considered for the upper end of the range should demonstrate stronger hands\-on experience in several of the following areas: * End\-user technical support * Microsoft 365 support * Windows troubleshooting * Workstation deployments and migrations * Network\-connectivity troubleshooting * Customer\-site support * IT ticketing and documentation * Independent technical problem\-solving Employees will be compensated for all hours worked in accordance with applicable law. All working time must be accurately recorded using Eagle Tech Corp's approved ticketing and/or timekeeping systems. BENEFITS Subject to Eagle Tech Corp's applicable policies and eligibility requirements, this position includes: * Opportunity for additional approved hours based on business and client needs. * **10 paid vacation days per year after completing one full year of continuous employment.** * **Paid sick leave** in accordance with Eagle Tech Corp policy and applicable law. * Exposure to Microsoft technologies, networking, cybersecurity, and managed IT services. * Opportunities to expand technical knowledge and professional field\-service experience. WORK ENVIRONMENT \& TRAVEL Work may be performed at Eagle Tech Corp's office in Springfield, Virginia, and at customer locations. The position requires local travel for scheduled installations, deployments, troubleshooting, maintenance, and other customer\-service activities. The employee must follow all applicable Eagle Tech Corp and customer security, confidentiality, safety, access, and operational requirements while working at customer locations. IDEAL CANDIDATE The ideal candidate is dependable, professional, technically capable, and committed to providing a positive customer experience. This position is well suited for someone who enjoys: * Troubleshooting and resolving technical problems * Working directly with computers and business technology * Installing and configuring equipment * Supporting end users * Working at different customer environments * Documenting work accurately * Learning new Microsoft, networking, and cybersecurity technologies * Working independently while knowing when to escalate an issue EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY Eagle Tech Corp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without unlawful discrimination. jobs.title: Advisor - Scientific Machine Learning & Agentic Workflows Engineer
jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. **Organization Overview:** At Eli Lilly and Company, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Lilly is a leader in global healthcare and has been discovering and developing medicines that help improve lives for more than 140 years. Our 50,000 employees around the world work as a team to bring breakthrough medicines to patients who need them. We are looking for motivated, highly skilled scientists and engineers to help us continue to bring breakthrough medicines to patients. Delivery, Devices, and Connected Solutions (DDCS) sits within Lilly's Product Research \& Development organization. We are a diverse team of scientists and engineers responsible for discovering, designing, and developing patient\-centric drug delivery solutions across a broad range of modalities — from injection devices to novel routes of administration and nanomedicines. DDCS drives the drug delivery innovation agenda across early and late development to meet the needs of an expanding portfolio that spans small molecules, biologics, and nucleic acid therapeutics. DDCS is organized around a matrix model with strong disciplinary and functional horizontals supporting innovation and commercialization verticals. Our vision is to get our medicines to more patients faster by accelerating reach and scale, guided by three strategic pillars: Delivery Systems, Robust \& Sustainable, and Patient Experience \+ Outcomes. Computational Modeling \& Simulation (M\&S) is a disciplinary horizontal within DDCS that builds and applies predictive models spanning molecular to system scales. M\&S outputs inform device architecture, formulation and delivery\-system design, and development strategy — reducing empirical iteration, quantifying risk, and building mechanistic understanding of how our delivery systems perform in real use. The scope of the capability spans continuum\-scale multiphysics (CFD and FEA), molecular and mesoscale simulation, and scientific machine learning, working closely with Formulation Sciences, Device Engineering, Analytical Sciences, Manufacturing, Quality, and Regulatory. **Position Overview:** This role builds hybrid physics\-and\-data models — and the agentic software layer that puts them in the hands of working scientists. It has two connected halves. The first is scientific machine learning: physics\-informed networks, operator learning, multi\-fidelity surrogates, Bayesian calibration, and gray\-box system identification that accelerate or extend physics\-based simulation. The second is AI engineering: agentic workflows that plan, set up, execute, and post\-process modeling and simulation tasks by calling real solvers and real data, so that a scientist can move from question to credible answer without hand\-assembling every step. The role sits within the Computational Modeling \& Simulation team in DDCS and works across the programs that the team supports. This is not a standalone research role: the models and tools are built with and for the drug product, device, and process development functions across Product Research \& Development that use them. You will independently design, implement, validate, and support the workflows you build, working closely with the DDCS AI Application Development and Data Sciences functions on architecture, platform choices, and compliance. **Key Responsibilities:** Scientific Machine Learning Development * Independently design, train, and validate SciML models — physics\-informed neural networks, operator\-learning architectures (e.g., DeepONet, Fourier neural operators), and Gaussian\-process or multifidelity surrogates — against high\-fidelity simulation and experimental data. * Apply Bayesian calibration and uncertainty quantification to deliver predictions with a defensible confidence statement rather than a point estimate. * Apply gray\-box identification and symbolic\-regression methods to infer unknown parameters or missing mechanisms from sparse experimental data. Agentic Modeling Workflow Engineering * Design and build LLM\-based agentic workflows that plan, set up, execute, monitor, and post\-process modeling tasks by calling real tools — solvers (e.g., Abaqus, COMSOL, Ansys, OpenFOAM, LAMMPS, GROMACS), meshing and geometry utilities, HPC schedulers, and internal data services. * Implement the tool interfaces, APIs nt orchestration and either tool and function calling or retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG). * Experience running computational work on HPC clusters or cloud infrastructure. * Peer\-reviewed publications or open\-source contributions in scientific machine learning. **Additional Preferences:** * A working practice grounded in evaluation, provenance, and reproducibility, and the ability to explain to both technical and business audiences what these methods can and cannot do. * Neural operator methods, multifidelity modeling, Bayesian UQ and calibration, active learning, or Bayesian optimization applied to engineering or biomedical problems. * Gray\-box identification, symbolic regression, or discovery of pharmacokinetic, pharmacodynamic, or transport models from sparse data. * Experience with agent frameworks and tool\-interoperability standards (e.g., tool\-calling APIs, graph\-based agent orchestration, Model Context Protocol) and with production deployment practice (containers, CI/CD, observability). * Familiarity with commercial or open\-source simulation solvers and their scripting interfaces and input/output formats. * Awareness of model credibility practice for regulated products (ASME V\&V 40; FDA credibility assessment guidance) and of GxP and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements for computerized systems. * Front\-end or full\-stack experience sufficient to build usable interfaces for scientific tools. * Domain exposure to drug delivery, medical devices, combination products, or biomedical transport problems. **Other Information:** * Travel: 0–10% * Location: Indianapolis, IN; Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response. Lilly is proud to be an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. jobs.description: We have an exciting opportunity for a talented Mechanical Engineering Manager to join our Product Development organization in Marshalltown, Iowa!
