This is a hands\-on leadership role that combines people leadership, technical direction, and product development execution. You will build a high\-performing engineering team while providing technical leadership and contributing to key engineering decisions across multiple initiatives. **In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:** ***People Leadership \& Team Development*** * Lead, coach, and develop a team of mechanical engineers and Cad Designers supporting new product development programs. * Establish clear goals, priorities, and performance expectations aligned with organizational objectives. * Conduct performance reviews, development planning, talent assessments. * Recruit, onboard, and retain top engineering talent while building organizational capability. * Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and innovation. * Create development opportunities that strengthen both technical expertise and leadership capabilities across the team. ***Technical Leadership*** * Provide technical leadership and oversight for mechanical engineering activities across multiple development programs. * Guide product architecture decisions, design reviews, technology selection, and risk management activities. * Ensure engineering solutions balance performance, manufacturability, reliability, quality, cost, and schedule objectives. * Review and approve key technical deliverables and engineering decisions. * Serve as a technical escalation point for complex engineering challenges. * Remain actively engaged in critical design, analysis, validation, and problem\-solving activities when appropriate. ***New Product Development Leadership*** * Partner with Program Managers and Product Managers to ensure successful execution of product roadmaps. * Ensure engineering deliverables support milestone commitments, product launch objectives, and business goals. * Manage technical risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies. * Participate in gate reviews and provide recommendations regarding technical readiness and project execution. ***Cross\-Functional Collaboration*** * Build strong partnerships across Engineering, Product Management, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, and Marketing. * Align stakeholders on technical direction, priorities, and project execution plans. * Promote collaboration between global engineering teams to leverage expertise and accelerate development efforts. ***Engineering Excellence \& Continuous Improvement*** * Drive adoption of engineering best practices, design standards, and product development methodologies. * Champion initiatives that improve product quality, engineering productivity, and development cycle time. * Evaluate and implement emerging technologies, digital engineering tools, simulation methods, and AI\-enabled engineering practices. Contribute to long\-term technology roadmaps and engineering strategy development. * **Who You Are** You are a leader who enjoys developing people as much as developing products. You build highly engaged teams and inspire engineers to perform at their highest level. You create clarity during uncertainty and balance technical depth with strong business judgment. You effectively influence diverse stakeholders and bring teams together around a common vision. You have a passion for innovation, continuous improvement, and delivering products that create meaningful customer and business value. While you enjoy remaining connected to technical challenges, your greatest impact comes from enabling others to succeed. **What You'll Gain** * This role offers the opportunity to directly influence both people and products while shaping the future of our engineering organization. * Leadership responsibility for a growing team of new product development engineers. * Significant influence over product strategy, technical direction, and organizational capability. * Exposure to senior leadership and participation in strategic business decisions. * Opportunities to mentor and develop future technical and organizational leaders. * Broad cross\-functional collaboration across global engineering and business teams. A career path toward senior engineering leadership, engineering director, or broader product development leadership roles. * **For This Role, You Will Need** * Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related engineering discipline. * 5\+ years of engineering experience in product development. * Demonstrated experience leading complex technical projects and cross\-functional teams. * Prior experience leading, mentoring, or supervising engineers. * Strong understanding of mechanical product development   a variety of medical insurance plans, with dental and vision coverage, Employee Assistance Program, 401(k), tuition reimbursement, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave. Our compensation philosophy is simple: We pay a competitive base salary, within the local market in which we operate, and reward performance during the annual merit review process. The total target comp range for this position is **$90,000 \- $ 110,000 annually** , commensurate with the skills, talent, capabilities, and experience each candidate brings to a role. \#LI\-LS4 **WHY EMERSON** **Our Commitment to Our People** At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration. We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the world’s most complex problems — for our customers, our communities, and the planet. You’ll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award\-winning employee development programs. We are a proud corporate citizen in every city where we operate and are committed to our people, our communities, and the world at large. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor. At Emerson, you’ll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let’s go. Let’s think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace free of any discrimination or harassment. **Accessibility Assistance or Accommodation** If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, please contact: idisability.administrator@emerson.com . **ABOUT EMERSON** Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software. Through our deep domain expertise and legacy of flawless execution, Emerson helps customers in critical industries like life sciences, energy, power and renewables, chemical and advanced factory automation operate more sustainably while improving productivity, energy security and reliability. With global operations and a comprehensive portfolio of software and technology, we are helping companies implement digital transformation to measurably improve their operations, conserve valuable resources and enhance their safety. jobs.title: Project Specialist
jobs.description: The ideal candidate is highly organized, customer\-focused, and comfortable managing multiple priorities while maintaining accurate schedules, documentation, and communications. This position offers the opportunity to support critical electric utility infrastructure projects that improve reliability, system performance, and customer service. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Coordinate electric distribution design projects through planning, design, permitting, construction, and project closeout. * Serve as a primary point of contact for customers and stakeholders, providing project updates and responding to inquiries. * Monitor project schedules, milestones, and deliverables to ensure projects remain on track. * Coordinate activities between project managers, designers, engineers, permitting agencies, contractors, and utility stakeholders. * Review project documentation to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with client requirements. * Support permitting, easement, and municipal approval processes as required. * Maintain project records and documentation within company and client systems. * Track customer contributions, invoices, billing activities, and project financial information. * Assist with preparation of project reports, dashboards, and status updates for leadership and clients. * Facilitate communication between cross\-functional teams to identify and resolve project issues. * Participate in customer meetings, project review meetings, and operational discussions. * Support quality assurance and quality control efforts for project deliverables. * Identify opportunities for process improvements that enhance project execution and customer satisfaction. * Ensure project activities comply with client standards, company procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering Technology, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * 2\+ years of experience in project coordination, utility operations, engineering support, construction administration, or a related environment. * Strong organizational, planning, and multitasking abilities. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to work effectively with customers, technical teams, and external stakeholders. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and Teams. * Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate project documentation. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience supporting electric utility distribution projects. * Familiarity with electric distribution design and construction processes. * Experience with GIS, work management systems, project tracking software, or utility databases. * Knowledge of permitting, municipal coordination, easement acquisition, or right\-of\-way processes. * Experience working directly with utility customers, contractors, and field personnel. * Understanding of overhead and underground electric distribution systems. **Key Competencies** -------------------- * Project Coordination \& Administration * Customer \& Stakeholder Management * Schedule \& Milestone Management * Documentation \& Record Management * Utility Design \& Construction Support * Financial \& Billing Coordination * Problem Solving \& Decision Making * Cross\-Functional Collaboration * Continuous Improvement * Attention to Detail Why Join Us? At ENTRUST Solutions Group, a Leidos company, we are driven by a commitment to innovation, technical excellence, and delivering the critical infrastructure that powers and connects communities. Together with Leidos, we are building a scaled, end\-to\-end energy and infrastructure organization focused on modernizing the grid, improving reliability, and helping utilities and network providers meet rising demand. jobs.title: Director of Consulting Services
jobs.description: EnerNex LLC, a CESI Group company Director of Consulting Services Basic function and purpose Under executive management direction, the Director of Consulting is responsible for developing the United States consultancy business of the Company, with focus on investor\-owned utility, independent system operator, and regional transmission organization clients, together with the cooperative, municipal, and public power segment and Renewables and BESS developers as well as EPCs. The position carries responsibility for organic growth and for the profit and loss of the assigned unit. It also carries responsibility for operations and program areas including special projects, budget analysis, contract administration, and other specialized functions, and requires the preparation of reports intended to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of operations, as well as the coordination of assigned activities with other departments and divisions. The ideal candidate has previously established strong relationships with major participants in the industry, including large utilities, ISOs and RTOs, developers, and independent vendors, and is able to act as a representative of the Company by remaining conversant with the services and skills offered across all departments of the organization. Context for the search EnerNex holds established technical references in power quality engineering, ADMS advisory, grid modernization roadmaps, standards and interoperability, OT cybersecurity, and independent testing advisory through KEMA Laboratories. Adjacent capability includes large load and data center interconnection, DER interconnection, BESS validation, resilience and storm hardening, and regulatory and rate case support. The constraint on growth is origination rather than delivery capability. The Company is therefore establishing regionally based senior consulting positions. This appointment is the first of three planned regional positions. Territories are exclusive, and the subsequent appointments will not compete for the same accounts. Geographic focus Candidates are required to reside within one of the three target regions and to hold established client relationships within that region. The position is home\-based and remote working is supported within the United States. Relocation assistance is not provided, as the value of the appointment lies in the professional network already established in the territory. Region Priority Market rationale and principal accounts Texas First ERCOT interconnection queue and the large load and data center pipeline. Oncor, CenterPoint, AEP Texas, together with an extensive cooperative and municipal segment. Northeast Second Con Edison, National Grid, Eversource, and NYPA, together with the NYISO and ISO\-NE stakeholder processes. Midwest Third MISO footprint utilities, interconnection queue activity, and the cooperative and municipal segment across the region. Minimum qualifications The following three requirements are mandatory. All other provisions of this document are preferences. 1\. Technical consulting experience A minimum of ten years delivering paid consulting or advisory engagements to electric utilities, ISOs, RTOs, or developers, in a scoping, technical lead, or engagement management capacity. The candidate must be able to describe engagements they personally scoped, priced, and stood behind technically. Candidates whose entire career has been internal to a single organization, without a period of external client delivery, do not satisfy this requirement. 2\. Established relationships with United States electric utilities The candidate must possess a substantial network of key contacts within the electric power industry, with focus on utilities, ISOs and RTOs, developers, vendors, and municipalities, at the level that awards consulting work. Relevant counterparts include vice presidents of engineering, directors of distribution and transmission planning, grid modernization program managers, and their equivalents at ISOs, RTOs, cooperatives, and municipal utilities. The candidate is expected to identify the accounts and to describe the most recent engagement sold into each. 3\. Demonstrated depth in at least one technical area The following list is stated in the alternative. A candidate is required to demonstrate depth in one area only, together with a working command of the remainder. * Distributed Energy Resource Management Systems (DERMS) at utility scale. * Interconnection analysis and planning for a United States ISO or RTO, an electric utility, or a consulting firm. Application experience in at least one ISO or RTO is required, with ERCOT and MISO preferred. * Grid modernization program design and delivery, including distribution automation, ADMS, and utility enterprise architecture. * Transmission and distribution engineering services, including power system modeling and power market analysis. * AI feasibility and implementation in electric utilities Demonstrated depth in a si research and analysis of new programs, services, policies, and procedures, and prepares and presents reports. * Plans, coordinates, and evaluates activities associated with assigned contracts, participates in the research and evaluation of proposed contractual obligations and agreements, assists in contract negotiation and administration, and monitors compliance with applicable contractual agreements. * Provides highly responsible assistance to executive\-level management staff, including market and pipeline reporting. * Represents the Company within the assigned territory at state associations, ISO and RTO stakeholder processes, and industry conferences. * Coordinates and collaborates with departments, divisions, and outside agencies, including public and private organizations and industry bodies, and serves as a resource to them. * Coordinates with CESI Group affiliates where scope extends beyond the United States or into laboratory testing and certification. * Performs related duties as required. Compensation Base salary. A base salary determined by market value and experience, determined by record and by the substantiated size of the portfolio the candidate can bring. Variable compensation. An uncapped profit share on originated and completed work. The incumbent receives a share of cash collected on engagements they originate, on every project clearing an annual margin threshold measured across the portfolio as a whole rather than project by project. There is no ceiling, no discretionary element, and no retrospective adjustment. At a mature portfolio the variable component represents a six\-figure payment in addition to base salary. **In addition EnerNex offers a full suite of benefits including:** * Full paid medical and dental insurance on a high\-deductible plan that starts on the first day of the first full month of employment * Vision, well care, behavioral health and prescription drug plans * Life insurance at the rate of 1\.5 times salary * Short term disability insurance * Long term disability insurance * Accidental death and dismemberment insurance * Workman’s compensation * 8 paid holidays and 2 floating holidays * 4 weeks paid vacation/sick leave * Company paid society membership dues * Company paid professional license fees * Company sponsored 401k plan with 4% match Candidate sourcing Consulting experience is a mandatory qualification. Candidates are therefore to be sourced principally from consulting and engineering organizations serving the electric power sector: * Management and technology consultancies holding utility practices, including grid modernization, DER, metering, and enterprise advisory groups. * Transmission and distribution engineering firms, including interconnection study, system planning, and owner’s engineer practices. * Specialist power systems consultancies serving utilities, ISOs, RTOs, and developers. * Independent testing, certification, and technical advisory organizations serving the sector. Candidates presently employed by a utility, ISO, RTO, or developer remain within scope where their background includes a substantive period of external consulting delivery. The requirement is demonstrated consulting experience, not a current consulting employer. Priority is to be given to candidates whose client relationships sit within the target regions identified above. Recruiting partners are asked to identify, prior to submission, any client relationship that may present a conflict for EnerNex or for CESI Group affiliates. Administrative details * Target commencement date for the first appointment : on or before January 2027\. * Reporting line: President and CEO. * Travel expectation: 20%. * Work authorization and sponsorship position: US citizens and permanent residents only. * The company will consider remote working from the 3 geographic locations listed (United States only) Candidate submissions should be accompanied by the account summary described in item one of the screening criteria.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble!** Ensemble is a leading provider of technology\-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end\-to\-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country. Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference! O.N.E Purpose: * **Customer Obsession:** Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations. * **Embracing New Ideas:** Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation. * **Striving for Excellence:** Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results. **The Opportunity:** The Data Senior Engineer plays a critical role in designing, developing, and optimizing data solutions that support healthcare revenue cycle operations. Data integrity, scalability, and performance across complex systems, enabling actionable insights and operational efficiency. Combines advanced engineering expertise with a deep understanding of data architecture and analytics to drive innovation and compliance in a highly regulated environment. Develops and maintains robust data pipelines, architectures, and integrations to support enterprise analytics and reporting. Ensures data quality and security while implementing best practices for ETL processes, database optimization, and cloud\-based solutions. Collaborates with cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions, leverages modern tools for data modeling and warehousing, and proactively monitors system performance to ensure reliability and scalability. Supports governance initiatives and compliance with healthcare data standards. **Essential Job Functions** --------------------------- * Develop, test, deploy, monitor, and continuously improve scalable data pipelines and API integrations. * Apply generative AI tools in day\-to\-day engineering work to accelerate development and improve quality. * Translate product and business concepts into incremental, high\-quality technical deliverables. * Contribute through hands\-on design sessions and thorough code reviews. * Implement data quality monitoring to ensure accurate, reliable production data. * Review and recommend architectural patterns aligned with enterprise platforms and best practices. * Consistently applies generative AI in day‑to‑day engineering work \- using it to accelerate development, improve code quality, troubleshoot complex systems, and design scalable data solutions. **Required Skills \& Experience** * 6\+ years of hands\-on experience developing solutions using Microsoft SQL. * 3\+ years working with big data technologies such as Databricks, Apache Spark, Python, and Microsoft Azure (ADF, Dataflows, Azure Functions, Service Bus). * Strong understanding of engineering fundamentals including automated testing, code reviews, telemetry, iterative delivery, and DevOps. * Experience with polyglot storage architectures including relational, columnar, key\-value, and graph systems. * Hands\-on experience with Delta Lake tables and Parquet data stored in ADLS. * Experience building distributed, componentized applications using event\-driven patterns. * Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical, globally distributed audiences. * Solid foundation in software architecture, design patterns, and engineering best practices. * Experience working with healthcare datasets; familiarity with HL7 or EDI is a plus. * High attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership. * This position pays between $101,600 – $152,400 based on experience * Must be inquisitive and demonstrate openness to innovation including AI to explore better processes and ways to alleviate friction and improve patient and client experiences. * This is a remote position; however, candidates must be willing and able to travel to and work onsite at client, temporary, or corporate office locations as business needs require. \#LI\-SA1 \#LI\-REMOTE **Join an award\-winning company** Five\-time winner of “Best in KLAS” 2020\-2022, 2024\-2025 Black Book Research's Top Revenue Cycle Management Outsourcing Solution 2021\-2024 22 Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA) MAP Awards for High Performance in Revenue Cycle 2019\-2024 Leader in Everest Group's RCM Operations PEAK Matrix Assessment 2024 Clarivate Healthcare Business Insights (HBI) Revenue Cycle Awards for strong performance 2020, 2022\-2023 Energage Top Workplaces USA 2022\-2024 Fortune Media Best Workplaces in Healthcare 2024 Monster Top Workplace for Remote Work 2024 Great Place to Work certified 2023\-2024 * Innovation * Work\-Life Flexibility * Leadership * Purpose \+ Values Bottom line, we believe in empowering people and giving them the tools and resources needed to thrive. A few of those include: * **Associate Benefits –** We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial health of you and your family, including healthcare, time off, retirement, and well\-being programs. * **Our Culture** – Ensemble is a place where associates can do their best work and be their best selves. We put people first, last and always. Our culture is rooted in collaboration, growth, and innovation. * **Growth –** We invest in your professional development. Each associate will earn a professional certification relevant to their field and can obtain tuition reimbursement. * **Recognition –** We offer quarterly and annual incentive programs for all employees who go beyond and keep raising the bar for themselves and the company. Ensemble is an equal employment opportunity employer. It is our policy not to discriminate against any applicant or employee based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, religion, national origin, age, disability, military or veteran status, genetic information or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. Ensemble also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories. Due to business, operational, payroll, and regulatory requirements, this position is limited to individuals who reside and are authorized to work within the United States. Applications generated from outside the United States will not be considered. Individuals may reapply when located within the United States. Ensemble provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act and applicable state and local law. If you require accommodation in the application process, please contact TA@ensemblehp.com. This posting addresses state specific requirements to provide pay transparency. Compensation decisions consider many job\-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location; knowledge; skills; relevant experience; education; licensure; internal equity; time in position. A candidate entry rate of pay does not typically fall at the minimum or maximum of the role’s range. Employment Disclaimers – Ensemble

jobs.title: Project Manager (Pump, Power & HVAC)
jobs.description: **Build the Future with Us — EquipmentShare is Hiring a Project Manager (Pump, Power \& HVAC)** =============================================================================================== At EquipmentShare, we're not just filling a role — **we're assembling the best team on the planet to build something that's never been built before**. We're on a mission to transform an industry that's been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real\-time support, and a team that truly cares. We're hiring a **Project Manager** for our Advanced Solutions rental market and we're looking for someone who's ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction. A District Project Manager will provide specialty engineered rental solutions, including pumping\-fluid handling, power generation, climate control\-HVAC offerings, and compressed air. This role will partner with Operations and Sales to shape and grow our Pump, Power, HVAC, and Compressed Air business through technical support and direct efforts. ### **Primary Responsibilities** * Maintain all compliance regulations related to position * Must be able to train and coach Pump, Power, HVAC, and Compressed Air associates on equipment trouble\-shooting and product knowledge * Travel to all Pump locations within the territory (Southwest) to help train, repair, coach, and mentor Technicians, Territory Account Managers, and customers * Working knowledge of current fleet in all locations * Must stay up\-to\-date on all safety procedures relating to fleet * Develop multi skill level Pump Training programs for EquipmentShare Product Specialist and Field Service Mechanics * Assist Territory Account Managers in technical sales applications * Engineer and manage large projects ### **Why EquipmentShare?** Because we do things differently — and we think you'll feel it from day one. We're a people\-first company powered by cutting\-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn't just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you're behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports *you*, and you drive *us* forward. We're a team of problem\-solvers, go\-getters, and builders. And we're looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of **building something special**. #### **Perks \& Benefits** * Competitive compensation * Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full\-time employees * Generous PTO \+ paid holidays * 401(k) \+ company match * Tool and boot reimbursements (role dependent) * Gym membership stipend \+ wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!) * Company events, food truck nights, and monthly team dinners * 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year — give back to the community you call home * Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities ### **About You** You want to be part of a team that's not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we're transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you're excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast\-paced, mission\-driven environment. We're looking for people who: * See challenges as opportunities * Embrace change and continuous improvement * Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day ### **Skills \& Qualifications** * Ability to manage multiple projects with high efficiency, meeting budget and timeline * Proficient in Google Suites, ability to adapt to applications and software * Excellent communication skills * Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills * Attention to details while multi\-tasking priorities * Demonstrate sense of urgency and make decisions on company's behalf * Ability to exhibit strong leadership skills and serve as a mentor * Ability to travel frequently **Education and Experience:** * Past project management/job foreman experience * Must be a subject matter expert in Pump, Power and HVAC equipment * Prior experience facilitating training (in the classroom or the field) required **Physical Requirements:** * Must be able to travel frequently * Must be able to sit, stand, bend and stoop for periods of time * Ability to be in extreme weather conditions for a period of time * Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds ### **A Workplace For All** At EquipmentShare, we believe the best solutions come from a team that reflects the world around us. Our initiative — *A Workplace For All* — is rooted in the belief that we must work together to solve some of the toughest problems in construction. That means attracting, developing, and retaining great people from all walks of life. We value different backgrounds, talents, and perspectives. We want you to feel like you belong here — because you do. **EquipmentShare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.** ***Employment is contingent on passing a background check. Additionally, some roles require passing a drug test, depending on the job responsibilities.***

jobs.title: Sr. Data Engineer – FCP Tech

FCP®, a subsidiary of Federated Hermes, Inc, is a leading real estate investment company that has invested in or financed more than $14\.8 billion in gross asset value since its founding in 1999\. familiarity with AI services such as Azure OpenAI strongly preferred * Excellent written and oral communication skills * Experience in presenting ideas and analysis to groups and leadership * Motivated self\-starter with effective time management skills and strong attention to detail * A desire to work within a fast\-paced, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment * Experience or previous interest in Real Estate strongly preferred * Required Technical Skills: + Excel (Complex Formulas, PivotTables, Formatting) + Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Data Factory, Notebooks) + Python + SQL + Power BI \& DAX * Preferred Technical Skills: + Azure OpenAI \& AI Services + Databricks + JavaScript/HTML/CSS + LangChain or other AI/LLM orchestration frameworks + Financial Modeling

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer: Computer Vision & 3D
jobs.description: ##### **Role Overview** FitMatch is seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to advance the computer vision and 3D reconstruction behind QuadraScan, starting with improving how we reconstruct human geometry from ordinary camera images, focusing on geometric accuracy, reliable measurements, and real\-world performance. You'll own model development end to end, from data preparation and experimentation through evaluation and shipping, building on existing prototypes, datasets, and tools with real influence over our methods. This is a hands\-on senior IC role on a small team, reporting to the Head of Mobile Development. You'll align with them on objectives and trade\-offs while independently driving ML implementation and technical decisions. We expect strong, evidence\-backed recommendations and a track record of seeing work through to delivery. ##### **Location:** Remote ##### **Base salary:** $160,000–$200,000, depending on experience and work location ##### **Responsibilities:** * Own model development for human reconstruction and related computer vision work, from data preparation and training through evaluation and production integration * Select, adapt, and fine\-tune pretrained models, modifying architectures or training objectives when a clear product need justifies it * Design focused experiments with clear baselines, success criteria, and sensible time and compute limits * Improve training data and capture coverage across synthetic and real imagery, maintaining reliable labels, dataset versioning, and train/eval subject separation * Diagnose failures across the full pipeline, from capture quality and camera geometry to model predictions and reconstructed surfaces * Evaluate geometric fidelity, regional errors, robustness, and failure rates, tying model metrics to scan and measurement quality * Build maintainable training and inference code with reproducible experiments and practical regression checks * Partner with mobile and backend engineers to deploy improvements, balancing accuracy, latency, memory, and cost * Communicate findings clearly, including what the evidence supports, what remains uncertain, and the best next step ##### **Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of professional experience in ML, computer vision, or related engineering, with substantial hands\-on model development * Proven track record taking a computer vision model from experimentation into production and improving it based on real\-world performance and failure cases * Strong Python and PyTorch skills, including building training pipelines, modifying model components and losses, and diagnosing training issues * Practical experience with geometric computer vision (e.g., depth estimation, camera calibration, multi\-view geometry, 3D perception, or reconstruction) * Solid grasp of model evaluation, including overfitting, data leakage, distribution shift, and the limits of aggregate metrics * Strong software engineering fundamentals: maintainable code, version control, testing, debugging, and reproducible environments * Ability to turn ambiguous objectives into actionable technical plans and execute independently * Clear communication and sound judgment in balancing model quality, speed, and resources ##### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with human reconstruction, body shape, pose estimation, photogrammetry, or measurement\-sensitive vision applications, including work with point clouds, meshes, or differentiable rendering * Experience using synthetic data to improve transfer to real camera imagery, and adapting pretrained vision transformers or other large vision models to specialized tasks * Familiarity with deploying models on Apple platforms (Core ML, MLX, Metal) or other constrained devices * Experience delivering applied ML in a small company or a team with limited specialist support ##### **How We Work:** * We organize work around concrete product improvements, using experiments to drive decisions and following promising results through to reliable implementation. * Technical direction is collaborative. We value engineers who explain their reasoning, flag problems early, and push for better approaches when the evidence supports it. * We keep tooling proportionate to the work. Clear evaluation, reproducible results, and dependable delivery matter more than the size of the stack. * AI\-assisted engineering is standard at FitMatch. Tools like Claude Code are part of our daily workflow, and we expect engineers to use them thoughtfully while owning the correctness of the resulting code and conclusions.

jobs.title: Lead Business Systems & Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **Lead Business Systems \& Automation Engineer** **Overview** Fulfyld is a third\-party logistics company helping e\-commerce brands store inventory, fulfill orders, and serve their customers. Our operation depends on connected systems spanning warehouse management, shipping, billing, customer service, and reporting. We’re hiring a hands\-on technical lead to own and improve those systems. You’ll work directly with the people using them, identify what needs to change, build practical solutions, and take responsibility for making them work reliably in daily operations. This is a senior individual contributor role with substantial autonomy. You’ll inherit existing applications, integrations, and automations, along with a backlog of operational improvements. Your responsibility will span discovery, development, deployment, training, and ongoing support. A typical problem might involve a billing discrepancy, an unreliable data feed, a warehouse printer, or a process that takes several spreadsheets and too much manual effort. You should be comfortable investigating the problem, gathering missing information, recommending an approach, and carrying it through to completion. **What you’ll own** * **Business\-system integrations**: Build and maintain connections between Salesforce, warehouse and shipping platforms, carrier services, databases, and internal applications. * **Internal tools and automation**: Develop applications, scripts, and workflows that reduce manual work and help employees complete tasks accurately. * **Data reliability**: Investigate discrepancies across orders, inventory, shipping costs, and customer billing. Create repeatable checks, reconciliation processes, and clear exception reporting. * **Warehouse technology**: Troubleshoot applications and integrations involving scanners, label printers, packing stations, cameras, and automated equipment. Coordinate with equipment vendors when specialist work is needed. * **Deployment and ongoing operation**: Own testing, releases, monitoring, recovery procedures, and troubleshooting across hosted services, NAS containers, and Windows workstations. * **Workflow improvement**: Spend time with warehouse, billing, and customer\-service teams to understand how work happens. Simplify processes and verify that improvements work for their users. * **Technical coordination**: Work directly with existing contributors and vendors, set clear acceptance criteria, and follow issues through to resolution. * **Documentation and handoffs**: Maintain practical runbooks and train users and backup owners so systems can operate reliably beyond any one person. **What you bring** * A track record of independently delivering and maintaining production integrations, internal applications, or business systems. * Strong hands\-on Python and SQL skills, plus the ability to work productively in JavaScript or TypeScript. * Experience with REST APIs, authentication, webhooks, scheduled jobs, and relational databases. * Sound judgment around data integrity, including duplicate records, incomplete data, retries, and partially completed operations. * Experience deploying and troubleshooting applications, using Git, reading logs, and managing configuration. * The ability to translate an operational problem into a working solution without needing a fully written specification. * Clear communication with nontechnical colleagues and the ability to introduce process changes respectfully. * Effective use of AI development tools such as Claude Code or Codex, with personal accountability for reviewing, testing, and maintaining the results. * Willingness to work directly on the warehouse floor and stay involved after a solution launches. **Experience that would be especially useful** * Logistics, fulfillment, distribution, manufacturing, or e\-commerce operations. * Salesforce administration, Flow, Apex, or integrations. * PostgreSQL, MySQL, Supabase, Docker, Windows automation and Synology NAS environments. * Barcode printing, Zebra devices, equipment interfaces, or warehouse automation. * Billing reconciliation, carrier\-cost analysis, inventory controls, or operational reporting. *You do not need experience with every tool listed. We care most about demonstrated ownership, technical judgment, and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems.* **What success looks like** Within your first 90 days, you will have: * Established a clear understanding of our critical systems, dependencies, and current issues. * Taken ownership of routine technical troubleshooting and coordination. * Delivered a meaningful operational improvement through deployment and user adoption. * Improved monitoring and reduced recurring manual intervention in selected workflows. * Documented key processes and established backup coverage. * Measurably reduced the CEO’s involvement in day\-to\-day technical execution. Longer\-term success means reliable systems, fewer recurring problems, less manual work, and employees who can get their jobs done without waiting for technical intervention. **Benefits** * Paid time off * Accidental death and dismemberment (AD\&D) and life insurance * Medical insurance * Dental insurance * Vision insurance * Voluntary supplemental insurance options (accident, critical illness, whole life, and term life) *Fulfyld, LLC is an equal opportunity employer committed to fair and merit\-based employment practices. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected under applicable law.* Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Staff Data Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **About Faire** Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi\-hundred\-billion\-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive. We're looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours. **About this role:** Our Engineering organization owns the software that makes our marketplace work. The Data Platform group supports everyone at Faire who depends on data: Product Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, Analytics, Strategy, Finance, and Product. Our job is to make sure the data is there, it's right, and people can find it and query it without having to think about the plumbing underneath. We are hiring a Staff Engineer to own that plumbing. Concretely, this means the path data takes out of our production databases (CockroachDB and MySQL) and into a place where analysts and data scientists can query it. Today that involves Fivetran, Kafka, Spark, and Airflow landing data in Snowflake and Databricks. It works, but it grew up over time and it shows. We want someone who can design the next version of it, build the hard parts personally, and bring the rest of the company along. This is a hands\-on role. You'll also be the person other teams come to when they need to know how data should move at Faire. **What you'll do:** * Set the technical direction for how data moves from production systems into our analytical stores, and own the roadmap to get there over the next couple of years. * Build the CDC and streaming ingestion layer: CockroachDB changefeeds and MySQL binlogs into Kafka, then into Iceberg tables on S3\. You'll be responsible for the hard details like ordering, deduplication, late data, schema changes, and backfills. * Implement data contracts and quality checks throughout our platform * Put real ownership and SLAs on the datasets the business runs on, and wire quality checks into the platform with tools like Anomalo and Monte Carlo so we hear about broken data before a dashboard or a model does. * Run Airflow and Fivetran well, and have an opinion about what we should keep buying versus what we should build. * Own reliability for the platform: SLOs, on\-call, incident reviews, and the follow\-through so the same thing doesn't break twice. * Work with the senior engineers, data scientists, and analysts who depend on this platform, and lead the migration of existing pipelines onto the new one without breaking what they rely on. * Mentor the engineers around you. We want the team's data engineering practice to be better because you were here. **Qualifications:** You've built and run data infrastructure that other teams depended on, at meaningful scale, and you've been the person setting direction for it, not just working on it. * Deep experience with change data capture and streaming ingestion from operational databases through Kafka. You know what goes wrong with ordering, duplicates, snapshots, and schema evolution because you've dealt with it. * Hands\-on experience with lakehouse architectures on an open table format. Iceberg on S3 is what we use, so that's especially valuable. You should be comfortable talking about partitioning, compaction, catalogs, and copy\-on\-write versus merge\-on\-read. * Strong Spark skills, and experience running Databricks and Snowflake against shared storage. * Experience with data quality and observability in practice, including data contracts, SLAs, and tools like Anomalo or Monte Carlo. * Experience operating Airflow at scale and working with managed ingestion like Fivetran. * Strong SQL, and good instincts for how to model data so analysts and data scientists can actually use it. * Solid Python plus at least one of Kotlin, Java, Scala, or Go. Experience shipping infrastructure on AWS with Terraform. * A working understanding of data governance: access control, PII, retention and deletion, lineage, and audit. * A track record of leading cross\-team data initiatives and migrations, and of mentoring senior engineers. * You can explain a technical tradeoff to a leadership team and to a new grad, and you can get people who disagree with each other to a decision. * You take ownership of things that are broken or unowned, and you're willing to be on call for the systems you build. * Experience in a marketplace, e\-commerce, or other transaction\-heavy business is a plus. **Technologies we use and teach:** * Python, Kotlin, SQL * Kafka, Fivetran, Airflow * S3, Apache Iceberg, Snowflake, Databricks, Apache Spark * AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes * CockroachDB, MySQL, Scylla and DynamoDB **Salary range:** San Francisco \& New York: the pay range for this role is $246,500 to $339,000 per year. This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors such as transferable skills, work experience, market demands, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future. *Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday).* *Additionally, hybrid in\-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting.* **Why you'll love working at Faire** * **Move fast:** You'll own meaningful problems that serve customers around the globe with the agency to move fast and see your results clearly. * **Equipped to scale:** We invest in what matters, including the latest enterprise AI tools, to help you work smarter and get more out of every day. * **Best in class:** Our team is full of sharp, kind, and generous colleagues who care about their craft and about helping you grow in yours. * **Real rewards.** Competitive pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits designed to support your life inside and outside of work. * **Belonging:** We're intentional about building an environment where every Faire employee has equal access to opportunities, growth, and success. Faire was founded in 2017 by a team of early product and engineering leads from Square. We're backed by some of the top investors in retail and tech including: Y Combinator, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Forerunner Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, and DST Global. We have headquarters in San Francisco and Kitchener\-Waterloo, and a global employee presence across offices in Toronto, London, and New York. To learn more about Faire and our customers, you can read more on our blog. Faire provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression. Faire is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process and applicants with a disability may request to be accommodated throughout the recruitment process. We will work with all applicants to accommodate their individual accessibility needs. To request reasonable accommodation, please fill out our Accommodation Request Form (https://bit.ly/faire\-form) **Privacy** For information about the type of personal data Faire collects from applicants, as well as your choices regarding the data collected about you, please visit Faire's Privacy Notice (https://www.faire.com/privacy)

Farmers employees tackle challenges head\-on, learn from every experience and measure their impact on the customers who trust them. Join usand help power the success of Farmers. Ready to make your mark? This role will help the team to design, set up, and monitor the data ecosystem that's needed to support the modeling needs. Tasks include, but not limited to, setting up data pipelines and design efficient data storage solutions. **Essential Job Functions** --------------------------- Data infrastructure development: * Pipeline Design and Development; Architects and builds scalable data pipelines using modern ETL (Extract, Load, Transform) tools and frameworks such as DBT (Data Build Tool), or similar. * Automates data ingestion processes from various sources including databases, APIs, and third party services. * Data Storage and Management \- Designs and implements data warehousing solutions using platforms like Snowflake, Redshift, or BigQuery. * Optimizes storage solutions for performance, cost efficiency, and scalability. Data modeling and transformation: * Data Modeling \- Develops and maintains logical and physical data models to support business analytics. * Creates and manages dimensional models, star/snowflake schemas, and other data structures. * Data Transformation \- Transforms raw data into clean, organized, and analytics\-ready datasets using SQL, Python, or other relevant languages. * Implements data transformation workflows to handle data cleansing, normalization, and enrichment. * Data Quality Assurance \- Conducts data validation and consistency checks to ensure the accuracy and reliability of data. Implements data quality monitoring and alerting mechanisms. Collaboration and stakeholder management: * Cross\-Functional Collaboration \- Works closely with data analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and understand their data needs. * Acts as a liaison between technical teams and business units to translate business requirements into technical specifications. Data governance and security knowledge: * Governance Policies Implements and enforces data governance policies to ensure data privacy, security, and compliance with relevant regulations. * Defines and manages data access, controls, permissions, and audit trails. * Security Measures \- Monitors and enforces data security measures to protect sensitive information from unauthorized access and breaches. * Ensures compliance with industry standards and regulations such as GDPR, CCPA, or HIPAA and others as applicable. **Physical Actions** -------------------- **Physical Environment** ------------------------ **Education Requirements** -------------------------- High School Diploma or equivalent required. Bachelors degree preferred in computer science, data science, engineering, or a related field. **Experience Requirements** --------------------------- * 4\+ years working with Python and SQL * Data Transformation * Data Quality Assurance * Pipeline Design and Development * Technical Communication * Experience working with DBT and SnowFlake * Experience working with Data Governance **Special Skill Requirement** ----------------------------- **Additional Qualification** ---------------------------- * Experience working with Databricks **Benefits** This position offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and work–life balance. jobs.title: Strategic Solutions Engineer - CNC - Boston, MA
jobs.description: **About MISUMI Americas** MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas. ### **Impact In This Role** Misumi Americas is seeking a Strategic Solutions Engineer \- CNC to join our solution engineering team focused on strategic, high\-complexity, production\-level customer programs. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, manufacturing, customer advisory, and commercial execution, supporting customers as they scale from prototype into production. The ideal candidate brings deep experience in CNC machining, casting, CAD, (SolidWorks), GD\&T, and DFM skills,strong technical communication skills, and the ability to guide customers through DFM/DFA, production readiness, operational/program support, cost optimization, and mechanical assembly considerations. This role is mainly customer\-facing and requires comfort operating in ambiguous, high\-stakes environments. ### **What You'll Be Doing** **Customer \& Program/Production Support** * Serve as a trusted technical advisor/guide for strategic customers with complex CNC manufacturing needs. * Lead technical scoping discussions, translating customer requirements into manufacturable, scalable solutions. * Some level of support for customers through prototype production transitions, anticipating manufacturing risks early. **Manufacturing \& DFM Expertise** * Perform detailed DFM/DFA reviews for CNC\-machined components. * Evaluate part geometry, tolerances, GD\&T, material selection, and finish requirements for manufacturability and cost. * Provide cost optimization recommendations based on process selection, feature simplification, and volume scaling. * Support efforts with manufacturing\-informed input on feasibility, risk, and lead time. **Assembly \& System\-Level Understanding/Support** * Evaluate and guide on mechanical assemblies, including: * + Part\-to\-part fit, stack\-ups, and tolerance interactions + Fastener selection, joint design, and access for assembly + Assembly sequencing and installation considerations * Help customers identify risks related to assembly, serviceability, and field installation. * Provide feedback that improves downstream assembly efficiency and reduces rework. **Technical Execution** * Review and interpret engineering drawings with strong command of GD\&T. * Perform CAD work, including: * + Design updates for manufacturability + Parametric 3D Modeling \& Visualization + Detailed Documentation \& Drafting with GD\&T + Optimizing CAD — CNC to Casting and 3DP to IM + Reverse engineering * Collaborate cross\-functionally with Sales, Operations, Quality, and LoB teams. **Quality \& Compliance Awareness** * Apply working knowledge of ISO 9001 and AS9100D requirements in customer discussions and internal workflows. * Identify quality risks early and ensure proper requirements definition ("quality in, quality out"). ### **Desired Traits** * 6\+ years of relevant experience in manufacturing roles such as CNC (candidates with deeper experience are strongly encouraged to apply). * Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering or related field, or equivalent demonstrated hands\-on experience. * Strong expertise in CNC machining processes (milling, turning, multi\-axis) and Casting, . * Must have DFM, cost optimization, and manufacturing trade\-off fluency. * Hands\-on experience in production\-scale manufacturing programs. * Proven ability to interpret and apply engineering drawings and GD\&T. * Solid understanding of mechanical assemblies and installation considerations. * Experience supporting customer\-facing technical discussions. * Familiarity with ISO 9001 and AS9100D compliance environments. * Willingness and ability to travel 30–40%. * Proficiency with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Office. * Strong verbal, written, and digital communication skills. * SolidWorks CAD proficiency. * Willingness to perform hands\-on CAD work and reverse engineering as needed. * Willingness to support the Marketing team with technical publications, seminars, university lectures, and other related activities as needed. ### **Nice\-to\-Have Qualifications** * Experience with Casting, Molding (IM) and/or Additive Manufacturing (3DP). * Prior experience working with external suppliers or contract manufacturers. * Leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude and other AI assistants) to accelerate DFM analysis, documentation, customer\-facing content creation, and day\-to\-day engineering workflows. * Experience integrating AI/LLM tools into engineering or customer\-facing workflows. ### **Physical Demands** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Standard Office \& Remote Work: Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer for remote customer consultations. * Onsite Environments: Must be able to walk and stand on manufacturing floors and trade show environments for extended periods. Must be able to safely navigate industrial areas around heavy machinery and wear required PPE (safety glasses, safety shoes, hearing protection). * Lifting \& Handling: Ability to occasionally lift, move, and position mechanical parts, prototypes, or trade show materials weighing up to 30 lbs. ### **Perks and Benefits** * Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401K plan * Parental leave programs * Paid volunteer days * And much, much more! **Salary Range: $125,000 to $142,000 per year, based upon experience** **Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.** We're actively seeking teammates who: * Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company. * Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team. * Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth. * Have an 'always learning' mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins. * Help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

jobs.title: Data Engineer, Analytics & Performance Insights
jobs.description: ### **Fidelity will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position.** ### **Job Description:** **Data Engineer, Analytics and Performance Insights** Do you enjoy supporting data architecture to enable business partners the ability to improve the associate, leader and customer experience? The Data Engineer, Analytics and Performance Insights supports the Brokerage Client Services Analytics organization by supporting the data infrastructure that makes those insights possible. This will involve hydrating the data lake and building out data marts using structured data and unstructured data to support operational metrics and analytics. The work will include building out a data quality framework to ensure that data is clean, complete and accurate enough to support near\-time analytics and diagnostics across our channels and AI\-ready for future use cases. The location of this position is Salt Lake City UT. **The Expertise and Skills You Bring** * Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field * 3\-5 years of hands\-on experience working with SQL or Data Engineering * Solid experience in writing complex SQL queries on Oracle (PL/SQL) and Snowflake * Hands\-on experience with SQL performance optimization and tuning * Experience working with large data sets * Experience with ETL strategies, design, and development. Prior experience with Alteryx or similar tools is helpful but not required * Python experience or a desire to learn * Familiarity with Dev Assist supporting artifacts/assets is a plus * You can create and maintain infrastructure documentation and diagrams * You understand database design concepts and modeling techniques * You have a data quality mindset and knowledge of techniques to ensure data quality * You have a good understanding of AWS compute and database services * You have strong database programming skills in Oracle SQL and/or Snowflake SQL. * Familiarity with continuous integration pipelines and automated deployment tools such as Jenkins, etc. * Passionate and open to learning new tools and developing with the latest technologies and frameworks. **The Team** The Data Engineer, Analytics and Performance Insights is part of Fidelity’s Brokerage group, specifically within the Strategy, Planning and Enablement Team. We provide holistic reporting and analytics support to the Brokerage Client Services organization. We are a leading provider of investment management, retirement planning, family conversations, portfolio guidance, brokerage, benefits outsourcing, and many other financial products and services. We believe in building relationships, not just in building sales or building our assets. After all, our clients will place their investments, their savings, and their futures in our hands. This is an important responsibility and that’s why we’ll surround you with amazing, supportive people and all the tools you need.
