jobs.title: Southeast Water Market Leader
jobs.description: Responsibilities: Mead \& Hunt has an exciting opportunity for a business developer. This role is specifically focused on growing the water business in the Southeast United States and across business units for Mead \& Hunt. This person will have the opportunity and support to grow this role into a position of national prominence and cultivate a key leadership position within the firm. The individual will join a well\-established water supply and wastewater treatment group with a strong portfolio of nationally recognized projects and considerable technical expertise. This person will be responsible for working with existing and new public clients to leverage that expertise into expanded relationships and service offerings from Mead \& Hunt. Project delivery will take the form of traditional professional services, design\-build management and engineering/procurement/construction (EPC) contracting. With the resources available through Mead \& Hunt, the professional in this role will have an opportunity to make their mark in providing engineering and client services that meet and exceed our clients’ expectations and goals. Flexible remote\-work options are available and candidate will report to the nearest regional Florida Mead \& Hunt office. Please indicate location preference when applying. In this role, the individual will be traveling up to 75%. **Essential Duties*** Learn and familiarize oneself with the Municipal Water/Wastewater industry while comprehending how these services can translate to cross\-selling opportunities within Food \& Beverage and other manufacturing industries to better support customers’ water and wastewater needs. * Discover and engage with current and potential customers to learn their business and understand how Mead \& Hunt can support their organization’s initiatives; continuously follow up to improve customer satisfaction and ensure repeat business communicating any concerns and solutions to the One Water National Market Leader. * Communicate effectively with clients and internal staff using digital media such as web conferences, phone calls, LinkedIn, and in\-person meetings when applicable. * Meet regularly with the One Water National Market Leader and Marketing to communicate needs, foreseeable concerns, goal achievement progress and any other updates. * Operate within our CRM system on a frequent basis ensuring consistent updates for other appropriate users. * Draft and develop technically written proposals using information from subject matter experts, vendors, and partners. * Identify new sales leads and clients for prospective project development; assist with outlines of customized series of questions while documenting project history and coordinating introductory meetings and any follow\-ups. * Support proposal development for the Sales team in the following tasks: developing an outline of the project or tasks with the client; identifying comparable example proposals with the One Water National Market Leader; drafting proposals or supporting the proposal team with preparing sections; coordinate and handle peer review and support the subject matter expert in the task; ensure proposals run through the appropriate review process, are reviewed by leadership, and document updates in CRM. * Participate in trade associations and events regionally/nationally upon approval by the One Water National Market Leader. * Understand and keep current on market drivers such as regulatory compliance topics and funding. * Participate in Go/No Go process for proposals. * Participate in trade associations specific to the municipal waste/wastewater industry and identify potential events to promote Mead \& Hunt’s business while sharing technical information references with Mead \& Hunt subject matter experts. * Coordinate and facilitate client and vendor meetings; attend meetings and document activities such as agenda, minutes, action items, and follow\-up with tasks assigned until complete. * Manage the CRM by maintaining a forecast including accurate information on important dates, cost, probability of proposals won and anticipated project durations; ensure the Marketing team is aware of proposal due dates while following up on pending actions in addition to documenting future action steps and any sales calls. * Coordinate and facilitate cross market group meetings (One Water, Food \& Beverage \& GHGR); draft and develop meeting agenda and content with Client Managers including project updates and learned lessons from staff following completed projects; review with One Water National Market Leader and execute. * Assist with meeting and developing regional growth projections and goal setting for yourself and client managers. * Prepositioning for and identifying strategic pursuits within the water market in FL, GA and the Carolinas. **The successful candidate** **must have****:*** Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related technical field from an accredited college or university AND at least five (5\) years of marketing experience, including at least three (3\) within a relevant industry **OR*** If no degree, must have at least nine (9\) years of relevant experience with five (5\) years within a relevant industry **The ideal candidate will have any/all of the following:*** 15\+ years of experience preferred * Florida PE license or ability to obtain within six months * Background in water/wastewater services. * Proven track record in business development with such clients as municipalities, government agencies, food and beverage facilities and/or industrial processing facilities. * Robust time and expense management skills with the ability to prioritize while calmly working under pressure to meet deadlines and changing demands. * A creative mind with good written and verbal communication skills, along with interpersonal skills. * Highly resourceful and self\-motivated individual that can work independently and within a team. * Ability and drive to visit with prospective clients * Experience or familiarity with generative AI\-driven tools, platforms, or systems (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) to enhance productivity, automate tasks, and reduce errors * Ability for travel If you’re highly communicative, self\-motivated and approach sales efforts with an energetic attitude, a passion for sustainable solutions within the water industry, manage strict deadlines and adaptive to changing markets, you’ll do well in this role. jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer, Staff
jobs.description: Overview: Medallia is the pioneer and market leader in Experience Management. Our award\-winning SaaS platform, Medallia Experience Cloud, leads the market in the management of experiences, insights, and actions for candidates, customers, employees, patients, and residents alike. We believe that every experience is a memory that can last a lifetime. Experiences shape the way people feel about a company. And they greatly influence how likely people are to advocate, contribute, and stay. At Medallia, we are committed to creating a world where organizations are loved by their customers and their employees. We empower exceptional people to create extraordinary experiences together. Bring your whole self. The Role and Team We are looking for a Staff AI/ML Engineer to join our Medallia AI Platform team and set the technical direction for our AI platform. You will define the architecture and standards that the next generation of AI products is built on, and you will lead engineers across teams to deliver them. As a Staff AI/ML Engineer on the AI Platform team, you will own the technical strategy for our AI platform and architect the building blocks of our next\-generation AI products. You will influence design across product, platform, and infrastructure teams, mentor senior engineers, and make the tradeoffs that keep the platform secure, scalable, and reliable for enterprise customers. Responsibilities: * Set the technical direction for the AI/ML platform and lead its evolution, including compliance, security, and performance standards. Architect in\-house and cloud\-native ML infrastructure. * Define how models and ML pipelines are monitored, maintained, and optimized in production, and raise the bar for reliability across the platform. * Design secure data pipelines that operate across national boundaries, and establish the standards teams follow. * Partner with product, design, and engineering leadership to shape innovative features for the Customer Experience space * Architect scalable solutions for large\-scale data processing made available to clients with high performance. * Define API strategy and design the interfaces that power front\-end applications. * Identify and drive process improvements across teams: automating manual processes, optimizing data delivery, and redesigning infrastructure for greater scalability. * Mentor senior engineers, lead design reviews, and raise engineering quality across the AI Platform organization. * Participate in a scheduled on\-call rotation and own the response for high\-severity issues affecting internal platforms and customer\-facing production systems. Qualifications: **Minimum Qualifications*** BA/BS degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * 8\+ years of software development in production environments using Python, Java, or Scala, including experience leading technical design beyond a single team. * Deep experience designing and operating microservices at scale. * Demonstrated experience deploying and operating services on Kubernetes (K8s); familiarity with K8s\-based deployment frameworks in regulated environments, including setting standards other teams follow. * Demonstrated experience with distributed systems: Spark, Hadoop, Kafka. * Demonstrated experience with Relational SQL including Postgres. * Track record of driving technical decisions across multiple teams and mentoring senior engineers. **Preferred Qualifications*** Familiarity with AWS services (EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, EKS, SageMaker) for cases where native AWS deployments are required outside the company's K8s framework. * AWS Certified Machine Learning Specialty or Solutions Architect certification. * Experience with ML model serving platforms: TensorFlow Serving, TensorRT, Triton, KServe. * Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools such as Airflow or Kubeflow. * Knowledge about Django or Spring framework. * Experience with NoSQL databases including ElasticSearch. * Experience defining platform strategy, technical roadmaps, or engineering standards for an organization. Medallia is committed to equal pay and transparency. The annual base salary range for this position is $172,500 \- $255,875\. Please note that the salary range information provided is a general guideline and combines all of the distinct labor markets within the US. It is uncommon for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on a variety of factors. Benefits and eligibility may vary by location and role. At Medallia, we celebrate diversity and recognize the value it brings to our customers and employees. Medallia is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age (40 and over), disability, genetic information, veteran status or military service, or any other status protected by state or local law. Individuals with a disability who need an accommodation to apply please contact us at ApplicantAccessibility@medallia.com. For information regarding how Medallia collects and uses personal information, please review our Privacy Policies. Applications will be accepted for 30 days from the date this role was posted or until the role has been filled.

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Post-training
jobs.description: ### **What We're Building:** If you want to shape the future of science, come build with us. Medra is building Physical AI Scientists: robotic systems that work hand\-in\-hand with leading biopharma partners to enable scientific breakthroughs faster than ever before. Physical AI that can operate scientific instruments with human\-level dexterity. Scientific AI that can analyze results, reason about next steps, and close the loop autonomously. We shipped our first production system over a year ago, recently raised a $52M Series A, and are opening one of the largest autonomous labs in the US. We're a small, ambitious team and you'd be joining early. ### **The Team:** * We’re a team of passionate, mission\-driven engineers from companies like Tesla, Amazon, SpaceX, and Neuralink. We’re collaborative and love moving fast, both with our product and on team trips skiing or go\-karting! * As a team, we love nerding out about engineering and robotics — plus other topics like race cars or cooking. We like learning new things and then sharing our new knowledge with each other. * Our team is opinionated and straightforward. We don’t mind intense discussions about design tradeoffs. If we have arguments or miscommunication, we resolve conflicts quickly and empathetically. ### **In this role, you will:** * Define post\-training recipes for our AI models — from deciding which problem matters and how to measure it, to engineering large data collections, to running ML experiments, to integrating post\-trained models into production workflows * Build and own the post\-training data pipelines integrating both internal data and public data * Create meaningful and trustworthy evaluations that tell us whether our models are improving scientific protocols and assay development * Develop agentic systems with context management and custom tool calls to surface new scientific insights about experimental design in real lab environments * Work closely with scientists, robotics engineers, and operation teams to bring reasoning capabilities into live experimental loops for leading biopharma partners * Shape the engineering culture and technical direction of a new machine learning team that's redefining how life science R\&D gets done **Let's talk if you have:** * Practical experience building AI\-driven workflows into the real world * Strong problem solving skills for debugging complex systems * A clear grasp of probability, statistics, and ML fundamentals * Ability to own the post\-training stack end\-to\-end: data pipelines, harnesses, RL environments, and agentic evaluations, even when things are loosely defined * Proficiency in Python and familiarity with at least one deep learning framework (e.g., PyTorch, JAX) * Experience with LLMs, post\-training, reinforcement learning, or agentic systems

jobs.title: Failure Analysis Engineer, Electromechanical Hardware
jobs.description: At Meta, we're building the future of human connection and the technology that enables it, continuously inventing for the next generation of experiences. To move toward advanced machine intelligence, we're enabling AI to go beyond vision and interact with the physical world.As we move closer to a future with intelligent robots and advanced AI models, we're hiring talent across robotics hardware, system software, machine perception, and artificial intelligence. You'll tackle open problems in robotics and AI, with the opportunity to shape new ways people connect around the world.We build complex electromechanical hardware, and the parts that move are the highest\-risk elements of any program. This role owns failure analysis for hardware that fails design\-verification, qualification, and production testing — from first symptom through root cause to a documented, transferable corrective action. You will work in the lab with hardware in your hands, in the data with logs and telemetry, and across electrical engineering, firmware, mechanical engineering, and quality teams to close the loop on defects before they reach a product. Scope spans actuators and drive systems, precision mechanisms, sensors, and the electronics and firmware that control them. ### **Failure Analysis Engineer, Electromechanical Hardware Responsibilities:** * Own end\-to\-end FA for units failing fixture, DVE, and qualification testing: intake, symptom capture, hypothesis\-driven teardown, root cause, disposition, and corrective\-action follow\-through * Build and maintain a failure\-mode taxonomy for the hardware in scope and classify incoming failures against it, so root causes transfer between units instead of being re\-derived every time * Diagnose by signature, not by guesswork — isolate the failing domain (mechanical, electrical, firmware, thermal, process) using periodicity, load\-vs\-position behavior, electrical waveforms, calibration and configuration data, and environmental correlation * Write and maintain analysis tooling (Python) that parses test\-station reports and time\-series logs to classify failure modes automatically at fleet/population scale * Run fleet\-level correlation studies to accept or refute candidate root causes, and document refuted leads as clearly as confirmed ones * Drive nonconformance (NC) and CAPA workflows: file, triage, and close NCs * present findings at CCB / design review * feed pass\-fail criteria improvements back into the test stations * Partner with design ME/EE/FW on containment and permanent fixes, and with suppliers on incoming quality and process escapes * Perform and interpret physical FA: precision teardown, dimensional/metrology inspection, wear and fracture surface inspection, optical/microscopy, and — where available — CT, SEM/EDX, and cross\-sectioning ### **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience * 5\+ years of hands\-on failure analysis, reliability, or test engineering on electromechanical hardware (motors and drives, gearboxes, precision mechanisms, consumer devices, instrumentation, or similar) * Demonstrated root\-cause methodology: 5\-Why, fishbone, fault\-tree, DOE, or equivalent, applied to real hardware failures you can talk through in detail * Hands\-on lab competence: DMM, oscilloscope, power supplies, load/test fixtures, DAQ * Experience writing technical FA reports that enable design engineers to act on findings without additional clarification — FA reports that a design engineer can act on without a meeting ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Familiarity with motor control and firmware concepts: commutation, field\-oriented control, current limits, calibration tables, and encoder error sources * Working knowledge of BLDC/PMSM motors, gear trains, bearings, brakes, and position encoders * Working knowledge of quality systems: 8D, PFMEA, DFMEA, control plans, MSA/Gage R\&R * Experience taking electromechanical assemblies — robotic joints and actuators, or comparable precision hardware — from prototype through DVT/PVT into production * Experience querying and building on large test\-data pipelines and dashboards * Reliability engineering depth: HALT/HASS, Weibull jobs.title: Prototyping Engineer - Model Maker
jobs.description: As a Prototyping Engineer within the multidisciplinary Proto Make Team, you will employ your expertise in problem solving and model making to accelerate product development across Meta's hardware organization. You will collaborate with teams within Hardware Engineering, Research and Development, and Industrial Design. These projects cover a wide variety of technical challenges unique to Meta's hardware portfolio, including Meta Quest, Ray\-Ban Meta smart glasses, AI wearables, robotics, and beyond. As the next stage of consumer hardware moves closer to the body, rapid soft element exploration has become exponentially more vital in creating human first technologies. This role requires expertise in molding and casting for use in prototype hardware informing early design decisions. Knowledge of silicone, polyurethanes, additive manufacturing and novel fabrication processes will be crucial in creating fast prototypes in all shapes and sizes. You will work throughout the hardware lifecycle with a particular focus on prototype ideation and early\-to\-mid stage development.This is a casting and molding specialist role. Your primary craft is mold design and construction and the casting of silicones, urethanes, and foams — you will independently own the most demanding casting and molding work in the lab, adding genuine specialist capacity and redundancy rather than task\-level coverage. jobs.title: Silicon Engineer, Infrastructure Validation
jobs.description: Meta is building custom silicon to power the infrastructure that underlies its family of products and services at global scale. Infrastructure Silicon delivers scalable, reliable custom ASIC solutions for Meta's data center needs and getting from first silicon to fleet\-scale production requires a systems\-based approach to validation and bring\-up.Our teams work across the full silicon lifecycle, from early architecture and design inputs, pre\-silicon validation on simulation and emulation platforms, first\-silicon bring\-up, post\-silicon characterization across process, voltage, and temperature corners, and productization into large fleets. We write tests, build bare\-metal environments and reusable frameworks that scale from pre\-silicon platforms to production deployments, and we build the automation that lets us do it at volume and velocity. ### **Silicon Engineer, Infrastructure Validation Responsibilities:** * Develop and execute functional validation plans for custom infrastructure ASICs across pre\-silicon and post\-silicon environments * Write and maintain test cases, validation scripts, and automation targeting simulation, emulation, and silicon platforms * Develop production diagnostics frameworks and kernel development targeted at silicon validation and productization from early labs to data center deployments * Perform post\-silicon bring\-up and debug of custom data center chips, including board\-level and system\-level * Root cause and resolve issues across silicon, firmware, driver, board, and test\-setup layers using debug tooling and internal interfaces to isolate causes * Collaborate with RTL design, physical design, firmware team, systems teams, internal and external partners to reproduce and resolve silicon bugs * Build and support validation infrastructure, including test automation frameworks, diagnostics, regression suites, and analysis tooling that scales from the lab to fleet * Characterize silicon performance, power, and timing margins across process, voltage, and temperature corners * Document validation findings, bug reports, and silicon errata with sufficient detail to drive design corrections, and feed insights from production back into next\-generation architecture * Contribute to the development of validation methodology and test plans for future silicon generations ### **Minimum Qualifications:** * Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Degree must be completed prior to joining Meta * 2\+ years of experience in ASIC or SoC development, validation, or first\-silicon bring\-up * Experience writing test cases or validation scripts in Python, C/C\+\+, System Verilog, or a comparable language * Experience with troubleshooting, debug and analysis of silicon products, including hardware debug tooling such as logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, JTAG interfaces, or protocol analyzers * Experience collaborating with RTL design or physical design, firmware or systems teams to reproduce and resolve silicon issues ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience across the silicon lifecycle for data center applications such as AI/ML or networking * Experience validating high\-speed interfaces such as PCIe, DDR, HBM, Ethernet, or SerDes in a data center or server silicon context * Experience with emulation or prototyping platforms used for pre\-silicon validation * Exposure to power management validation, including DVFS characterization and low\-power state verification on custom silicon * Familiarity with UVM\-based verification environments and functional coverage closure techniques * Experience developing diagnostics frameworks, low\-level kernels, or bare\-metal test environments for silicon validation * Experience with Linux systems, server systems management, and embedded bus protocols such as I2C, SPI, USB, or PCIe * Experience with silicon productization, manufacturing test, or fleet\-scale deployment ### **About Meta:** Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. jobs.title: Systems Integration Engineer, Embedded Systems / Mechatronics
jobs.description: At Meta, we're building the future of human connection and the technology that enables it, continuously inventing for the next generation of experiences. To move toward advanced machine intelligence, we're enabling AI to go beyond vision and interact with the physical world.As we move closer to a future with intelligent robots and advanced AI models, we're hiring talent across robotics hardware, system software, machine perception, and artificial intelligence. You'll tackle open problems in robotics and AI, with the opportunity to shape new ways people connect around the world.Hardware fails at the seams — where mechanical, electrical, firmware, and software meet, and again where a working prototype meets a repeatable build process. This role owns both. You will bring up new hardware in the lab, then carry it forward into a manufacturable, testable, scalable product: defining the build and test process, standing up the stations that verify it, and driving yield, throughput, and first\-pass quality as volumes grow. It is a deliberately blended role for someone who can debug a one\-off unit on the bench in the morning and improve a process that has to work on the hundredth unit in the afternoon. ### **Systems Integration Engineer, Embedded Systems / Mechatronics Responsibilities:** * Lead bring\-up of new platforms, actuator generations, and subassemblies: power\-on, firmware flashing, calibration, sensor validation, closed\-loop tuning, and first motion * Integrate subsystems end to end — actuators, encoders, IMUs, tactile and force sensing, cameras, power distribution, comms buses (CAN/CAN\-FD, EtherCAT, SPI/I2C, Ethernet), and onboard compute * Own system\-level behavior and interfaces: define and hold the mechanical, electrical, and software interface contracts between subsystems, and arbitrate the tradeoffs when they conflict * Debug hard, ambiguous, cross\-domain problems — intermittent faults, noise and grounding issues, timing and latency, thermal behavior, mechanical jobs.title: Technical Lead Engineer — Network Validation & Characterization
jobs.description: Meta's Infrastructure team delivers scalable and reliable custom ASIC solutions to meet Meta's data center needs. Ramping to production and solving data center scaling and deployment challenges requires a systems\-based approach to silicon bring\-up and validation.The team works on productization: early architecture and design inputs, pre\-silicon validation on emulation platforms, first\-silicon bring\-up, and post\-silicon characterization across process, voltage, and temperature corners. We write tests, build bare\-metal environments and reusable frameworks that scale from pre\-silicon platforms to large fleets of ASICs in the lab, and we build and maintain extensive lab automation to do it at volume and velocity. ### **Technical Lead Engineer — Network Validation \& Characterization Responsibilities:** * Own the end\-to\-end validation and characterization strategy for Meta custom silicon programs in your domain, from pre\-silicon emulation through post\-silicon bring\-up and PVT characterization * Define the test plan: measurement and benchmarking methodology, instrumentation, functional and performance coverage, corner coverage across process/voltage/temperature, and pass/fail criteria * Establish and document best practices for measurement rigor, accuracy, and correlation across bench, emulation, and ATE/production data * Drive validation of domain feature sets (power or networking) on emulation platforms pre\-silicon and on real silicon post\-silicon * Review schematics, power delivery networks, high\-speed interface designs, and board/platform configurations with hardware and design teams * provide early design and debuggability inputs * Write and review automation and analysis code that scales characterization from a single bench to many units in the lab * Lead debug of complex cross\-stack issues — silicon, firmware, driver, board, thermal, and fabric/switch layers — and drive root cause to closure with design, software, hardware, ODM, and vendor partners * Provide technical guidance and planning for a team of validation engineers * mentor engineers and improve standards for data quality and rigor * Partner with manufacturing, production, and data center teams to transfer characterization learnings into production screens and fleet health monitoring ### **Minimum Qualifications:** * 12\+ years of relevant industry experience * Demonstrated hands\-on validation and characterization experience on complex ASICs, SoCs, NICs, or high\-speed interfaces * Proven experience with PVT (Process / Voltage / Temperature) characterization * Ability to read and reason about schematics and either power delivery networks or high\-speed interface implementations * Proficiency in Python for test development, lab automation, and/or data analysis * Hands\-on lab experience with domain\-relevant instrumentation ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience taking a custom NIC or networking ASIC from first silicon through high\-volume production * Experience working directly with ODMs and silicon/IP vendors * Hands\-on lab experience with domain\-relevant instrumentation for Networking \- traffic generators, protocol analyzers, high\-speed scopes/BERTs, optics and cabling, switches * plus RDMA (RoCE and/or InfiniBand) at the protocol and debug level, Ethernet performance tooling (iperf, netperf, packet capture and analysis), and both front\-end and back\-end NICs and their differing traffic and scaling models * jobs.title: Senior Manager, Events Operations
jobs.description: Overview: **Who we are** The real world is the next frontier, and at Metropolis, we are creating artificial intelligence to make it responsive. We are pioneering the Recognition Economy — a future where mundane repetition disappears and being known unlocks access, comfort and belonging everywhere you go. From transforming parking into a seamless drive\-in, drive\-out experience for millions of Members to expanding our intelligence layer across retail and hospitality, we are building a world that feels instinctive and magical. The future isn’t coming; it’s here, and we need builders, innovators and problem solvers to help us create it. **Who you are** The Senior Manager, Event Operations, is responsible for the daily planning, administration and operations of all projects assigned. They ensure all accounts perform to the standards of Metropolis (**GAMEDAY**) in accordance with customized operating plans. The Senior Manager demonstrates effective leadership, with a strong focus on transportation planning and operations (e.g., bus systems, parking and access, and venue management), customer service, human resource management (e.g., project teams, independent contractors, temporary labor, etc.), budget management, and the integration of AI\-driven tools, the recognition economy, and future mobility solutions within special events. The Senior Manager ensures client retention and growth through implementation of best practices, service delivery, and operational efficiencies and successes while maintaining and improving financial performance. Responsibilities: **What you'll do** **Operational Planning \& Delivery** * Work as part of existing **GAMEDAY** teams to support existing clients \& projects. * Work with clients to define scope of work, set delivery timeline, define project deliverables and create budget for project operations. * Identify all existing and potential impacts to assigned projects; make proactive recommendations for improved performance. * Create and/or contribute to Concept of Operations plans for all projects assigned and update existing operating procedures as needed. * Ensure operational plans are validated and delivered as described and provide appropriate and timely responses to clients related to any operations issues or challenges * Ensure the prompt completion of paperwork for all projects assigned. * Create and deliver training programs for each project for all staff assigned. * Compile all After Action Reports and submit them to your Manager for review. * Provide a mandatory and prompt response to emergency situations during normally scheduled "off duty hours." * Report any unknown, observed or suspected violation of company policy, safety hazards or any unusual occurrence to your Manager. * Identify opportunities for additional layering of services with assigned projects/clients * Support other projects as overlap opportunities arise and/or time permits. **Client Retention \& Satisfaction** * Manage assigned projects pursuant to their contractual requirements. * Evaluate and understand the client requirements with respect to the operation and ensure the client’s needs are met or exceeded (e.g. proper and timely communications, responsiveness, etc.). * Ensure proactive communication with clients regarding opportunities to improve operations and communication. * Resolve customer requests and/or concerns and issues diplomatically escalating to Manager and/or client when required. * Create, review and submit event summary for review with Manager and eventually Client. **Financial Planning \& Budget Management** * Ensure that projects operate within agreed upon budget and seek client approval for budget increasing requests. * Make recommendations to achieve agreed upon budget if client reductions cause negative variances. * Provide accurate data and input into the budget planning process and the subsequent re\-forecasting process. * Confirm the client is aware of major unplanned discrepancies beyond the control of Metropolis (**GAMEDAY**) and seek appropriate consideration (change management process) before implementation. * Perform general accounting duties with Controller, such as project accounts receivable management and payroll submission. * Support and improve financial performance with assigned projects/clients through operational adjustments and services. **Workforce Management** * Identify and forecast adequate staffing levels for each position (during planning phase for budget consideration) as well as work schedules related to projects. * During operations, assign tasks and communicate shift times and check in locations and procedures. * Work with the Admin team to ensure that all paperwork has been completed in advance of the assigned operations and that paperwork is processed post\-event so that workforce is paid in a timely manner. *Complete other duties as assigned.* Qualifications: **What we're looking for** * Must have a 4\-year degree or 3\-5 years event management expe computer applications/systems (e.g., Google Workplace, Google Meet, Google Maps, Google Earth, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, etc.). * Must have experience creating and maintaining budgets. * Must be able to multitask and work independently. This is a remote position. * Must be detail\-oriented, organized and have a strong sense of urgency. * Must have the ability to lead and motivate team members. * Must be enthusiastic about customer service and client satisfaction. * Must have the ability to effectively respond positively to customer inquiries outside of standard work hours across different time zones. * Must have strong analytical and interpersonal communication skills. * Must have flexibility to adapt to changes in the work environment and the ability to deal with changes, delays, or unexpected events as they occur. * Must have the ability to work with all levels of the organization from contract staff, temporary labor, volunteers, executive staff and clients. **While not required, these are a plus:** * Prefer 5\-7 years event or project management experience. * Prefer experience with generative AI tools (e.g., Gemini, Claude) **ADDITIONAL INFORMATION** This is a work from home position that requires at least 50% travel. Travel will be dictated by assigned projects but employees should expect to be on the road 1\-2 weeks per month. Employees must be able to stand for extended periods of time outside in varying weather conditions (cold, rainy, snowy, harsh, hot, humid). Must be able to lift at least 50 pounds. All applicants must legally be entitled to work within the United States upon time of application and hold a valid passport. **Salary Range**: $85,000 to $110,000 annually per year **Benefits:** Eligible employees will participate in the various benefits plans including medical, dental, vision, flexible spending accounts, long/short term disability, life insurance, accident insurance, 401k and paid time off. *When you join Metropolis, you'll join a team of world\-class product leaders and engineers, building an ecosystem of technologies at the intersection of parking, mobility, and real estate. Our goal is to build an inclusive culture where everyone has a voice and the best idea wins. You will play a key role in building and maintaining this culture as our organization grows. The anticipated base salary for this position is* *$85,000\.00 USD to $110,000\.00* *USD annually. The actual base salary offered is determined by a number of variables, including, as appropriate, the applicant's qualifications for the position, years of relevant experience, distinctive skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location of residence and/or place of employment. Base salary is one component of Metropolis' total compensation package, which may also include access to or eligibility for healthcare benefits, a 401(k) plan, short\-term and long\-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, a lucrative stock option plan, bonus plans and more.* *Metropolis may utilize an automated employment decision tool (AEDT) to assess or evaluate your candidacy for employment or promotion. AEDTs are used to assist in assessing a candidate’s application relative to the required job qualifications and responsibilities listed in the job posting.* *As part of this process, Metropolis retains data relevant to your candidacy, including personal information, for a period that is reasonably necessary for the use of the tool. If you are hired for the position, your data may become part of your employee records.* *Metropolis Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We make all hiring decisions based on merit, qualifications, and business needs, without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation, or pregnancy), national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under federal, state, or local law.* Location : US\-REMOTE

jobs.title: Civil Engineer I-III
jobs.description: **Description** JOB INFORMATION: Title: Civil Engineer I\-III Authority: TA Department: Subways Division/Unit: MOW Engineering Location: 130 Livingston St Hours: 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM Reporting Manager (if Applicable): AVP, Track Engineering Deadline (if Applicable): 10/14/26 Compensation\\Authority \- Union TA – DC37 Civil Engineer I $90,551\* Civil Engineer II $107,655\* Civil Engineer III $120,427\* POSITON SUMMARY: These Track Engineering positions within MOW Engineering (Subways NYCT) provide essential support for track and third rail work across MOW, CPM, and capital projects. Responsibilities include designing special and standard track work, conducting field surveys and providing construction support, assisting Procurement with material inspection issues, reviewing shop drawings and first‑article materials, maintaining standard track drawings and specifications, and participating in investigations of derailments or other track incidents. This work is critical to completing track projects on time and ensuring the safety and reliability of NYCT’s track system. RESPONSIBILITIES: * Provide on\-time and accurate track engineering support to MOW, CPM and MTA capital projects that include track and third rail. * Perform special work and track work designs and conduct field engineering surveys and construction assistance, provide technical support to the Procurement Division to resolve inspection issues, review shop drawings and evaluate first articles materials, maintain and update the Standard Track Drawings and Standards Specification for Track, Infrastructure and Power Distribution Materials, participate in investigation of derailments and/or other track incidents. * Ensure a timely completion of track projects (both in\-house and third\-party contracts) as well to ensure the safety of the track system of NYCT. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: Civil Engineer I, II, and III: * A valid New York State Professional Engineer's License * Four years of full\-time experience in civil engineering. * A master's degree in civil engineering from an accredited college will be accepted as equivalent to one year of full\-time experience in civil engineering. Special Note: In addition to above qualification requirements, to be eligible for placement in Assignment Levels II and III, individuals must have at least one year within the last three years of experience as a major contributor or a project leader on a complex project requiring additional and specific expertise in the disciplines needed to design or construct the project. LICENSE REQUIREMENTS: A Motor Vehicle Driver’s License valid in the State of New York may be required for certain assignments. If required, this license must be maintained for duration of appointment. DESIRED SKILLS: * Computer\-savvy with CAD software and other MS office software. * Preferable knowledge of using surveying equipment. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills. * Ability to work independently and as part of a team. * Knowledge of MS Office suite and internet and mobile applications, as well as MicroStation and nonconformity databases. * Knowledge of structural inspection of concrete and steel. * Ability to read and write technical drawings and correspondence. * Preferable familiarity with Track Design and/or Construction. * Preferable Knowledge of Material test reports interpretation. * Strong communication skills. * Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office, Adobe Acrobat Pro, Tableau, Power BI applications. * Preferable Strong writing, research, and interpretation skills. * Ability to function independently with limited work direction. SELECTION METHOD Based on evaluation of education, skills, experience, interview, and written assessment. All selected candidates will be subject to a full background investigation that includes employment and education. Discrepancies may lead to dismissal. OTHER INFORMATION Appointment may be at a comparable level to current level of selected candidate. (If necessary) As an employee of MTA NYC Transit, you may be required to complete an annual financial disclosure statement with the state of New York, if your position earns more than $101,379 (this is subject to change) per year or if the position is designated as a policy maker. For 55\-a eligible titles: Candidates selected for this position may be placed in a competitive or non\-competitive class position based on their qualifications. Qualified candidates who are placed in a competitive class position are eligible for the 55\-a Program. Please indicate in your cover letter and in the upper right corner of your resume that you would like to be considered for the position under the 55\-a Program. For detailed information regarding the 55\-a Program, please visit the following link https://www1\.nyc.gov/site/dcas/employment/55\-a\-program.page TA APPLICANTS MUST BE IN A PERMANENT CIVIL SERVICE STATUS IN THE TITLE(S). IF YOU ARE ON AN ESTABLISHED LIST, YOUR LIST NUMBER MUST BE REACHABLE TO BE CONSIDERED FOR APPOINTMENT. The Metropolitan Transportation Authority is North America's largest transportation network, serving a population of 15\.3 million people across a 5,000\-square\-mile travel area surrounding New York City, Long Island, southeastern New York State, and Connecticut. The MTA network comprises the nation’s largest bus fleet and more subway and commuter rail cars than all other U.S. transit systems combined. MTA strives to provide a safe and reliable commute, excellent customer service, and rewarding opportunities. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION Final salary is determined experience, skillset, and alignment with compensation practices. The posted range reflects expected compensation and may be updated as market or business needs evolve. To be eligible for consideration for a new role, current MTA employees must complete at least one year of service in their current role prior to applying. Additionally, eligibility to interview is contingent upon maintaining a satisfactory record of job performance, attendance, and disciplinary conduct. Pursuant to the New York State Public Officers Law \& the MTA Code of Ethics, all employees who hold a policymaking position must file an Annual Statement of Financial Disclosure (FDS) with the NYS Commission on Ethics and Lobbying in Government (the “Commission”). HOW TO APPLY Qualified applicants can submit an online application by clicking on the ‘APPLY NOW’ button from either the CAREERS page or from the JOB DESCRIPTION page. If you have previously applied online for other positions, enter your Username and Password. If it is your first registration, click on the CLICK HERE TO REGISTER hyperlink and enter a Username and Password; then click on the REGISTER button. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Marketer
jobs.description: **ABOUT MINERVA** ----------------- Minerva builds AI for marketing leaders. Our platform lets marketers focus on telling the story of their brand while AI agents handle the operationally intensive work: data management, segment creation, analytics, measurement and reporting. Everything is built on Minerva’s proprietary consumer graph: an identity and attribute layer covering 270M\+ U.S. consumers across 2,000\+ through\-time attributes. On top of it sit two agentic systems built in partnership with OpenAI: an Agentic Data Engineer that unifies and standardizes a brand’s first\-party data in hours, and an Agentic Data Scientist that trains robust targeting models at scale. Together, our data and platform improve the quality of a brand’s first\-party data, lift campaign performance and give marketing teams their time back. We work with leading consumer brands across categories, including the NBA, Capital One, Hard Rock Stadium Group / Miami Dolphins, Wander and Trust \& Will. We’ve raised $20M from The General Partnership, 8VC, Lingotto, NBA Investments, Topology Ventures, Future Positive, Background Capital and many others. Our team brings together operators and investors from Citadel, Dentsu, Bridgewater, Meta Superintelligence and Lazard, alongside researchers from Berkeley, MIT, Stanford and Cambridge. **THE ROLE** ------------ An agent that can do almost anything has the same problem as a blank page. Someone has to decide what it does first. Minerva’s agents can unify a brand’s data, build the audience, train data science models and read the measurement. For a VP of Marketing with a quarter to hit, that range is the hard part. Which use case proves value inside a pilot? Which one comes second? You make that call. You scope every pilot, pick the campaign that will move a real number, and show the customer everything else Minerva can do, so the next request comes from them. This is a senior individual contributor seat with no direct reports. You’ll work directly with the founders, alongside our account executives and forward deployed engineers. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** ------------------ * **Scope every pilot.** Sit in pre\-sale with the AE and pick the use case that will move a brand\-side number inside the trial window. * **Make the call when a number isn’t moving.** Every brand’s first\-party data is shaped by its own history. You tell a data problem from a definition problem, send the first to our FDEs and fix the second yourself. * **Build the first use case with their marketing team.** That means a live audience, activated and measured. You’re done when they run the second one without you. * **Show them the whole map.** Prove one thing first, then make sure the customer knows everything else Minerva can do for them. * **Design what doesn’t exist yet.** When a customer wants something we have no play for, you design it and the account team sells it. * **Generalize the motion.** For each vertical, work out which use case goes first, which audience definitions survive a real campaign, and what the VP needs to see in week two. * **Feed product the specific thing.** What you reached for in the middle of real work shapes what we build next. **WHAT YOU HAVE** ----------------- * **You’ve owned a brand’s marketing outcome.** A campaign or a whole function, with the target and the result in your name. Agency\-side counts if the client’s number was yours. Supporting the person who owned it doesn’t. * **You understand the full cycle,** from strategy through audience, activation and measurement, and you can speak to every stage without handing off. * **You know enough about data to diagnose.** You don’t need to fix a broken pipeline, but you can tell when one is the problem. * **Agent\-native.** You already do a team’s work with AI and can show us the workflows. We test for this live in the loop. * Located in or willing to relocate to New York City. **YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU ARE…** ---------------------------------- * A **client lead at a performance or lifecycle agency** who has owned outcomes across several brands and is tired of handing off the recommendation. * A **growth or lifecycle lead at a consumer brand** who has run the full cycle on one brand’s data and wants to do it across many. * A **strategy consultant who went in\-house** and found they’d rather own the number than advise on it. * A **solutions lead at a marketing data platform** who came up in marketing and wants to own the outcome, not the implementation. * Or you don’t fit any of these neatly, but you can name the number you moved for a brand and walk us through every stage. Apply. **NICE TO HAVES** ----------------- * **SQL,** even basic. This is the highest\-slope accelerant for this seat. **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** --------------------------- * **First 90 days:** you’re on every pilot scoping call. At least one brand\-side number has moved because of a use case you designed, and one vertical has a written playbook. * **First 6 months:** you can name the number you moved on every account you deployed this quarter. At least one expansion exists because you designed something new. The roadmap carries items that trace back to you. * **The number you own:** brand\-side outcomes moved per deployed account, per quarter. **COMPENSATION** ---------------- $175,000–$220,000 base salary, depending on experience. Early\-stage equity. Medical, dental and vision. **Apply:** hiring@minerva.io \+ cc justin@minerva.io \| Subject: Forward Deployed Marketer Candidate Skip the cover letter. Send us one marketing outcome you owned, for a campaign or a whole function: the number, what you built and what happened. If you were agency\-side, tell us the client’s number and which part of it was yours. Applications without a number won’t be reviewed.

jobs.title: Principal Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on \- 6 Oct 2026 At MiniMed, you can begin a lifelong career of exploration and innovation, while helping make a difference in the lives of people living with diabetes around the globe. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation for a more connected, compassionate world. **About the Role** ================== As a Principal Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), you will own the end\-to\-end reliability, scale, and performance of our global healthcare platform built on Amazon Web Services (AWS). This role bridges the gap between software engineering and systems operations, with a hyper\-focus on maintaining HIPAA compliance, HITRUST standards, and cybersecurity frameworks. You will architecture automated, self\-healing platforms that ensure our life\-critical applications remain highly available 24x7\. Champion GitOps practices by treating infrastructure exclusively as code using tools like CloudFormation. * Observability \& Alerting: Build and mature deep telemetry frameworks using NewRelic, CloudWatch and OpenSearch to actively trace application health and catch system regressions before they hit patient care workflows. * Incident Response \& Postmortems: Lead high\-severity incident responses as an Incident Manager. Lead Blameless Postmortems and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to drive long\-term engineering remediations. * Data Security \& Compliance Audits: Ensure technical safeguards are enforced across AWS data stores containing Protected Health Information (PHI). Developer Enablement: Co\-design cloud\-native microservices alongside our Core Engineering teams, building automated CI/CD guardrails that allow developers to deploy code safely and autonomously. * **Required Knowledge and Experience:** Requires a Bachelor's Degree and minimum of 7 years of relevant experience, or advanced degree with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience. **Nice To Have Qualifications:** * Advanced AWS Expertise: Deep architectural knowledge of core AWS services, including networking (VPC), computing (EC2, ECS), IAM permission isolation, and data layers (RDS, DynamoDB). * Experience: 5\+ years of dedicated experience in Site Reliability Engineering or DevOps supporting production workloads at scale. * Healthcare Domain Mastery: Direct experience operating platforms within a regulated environment subject to HIPAA, SOC2, or FDA medical device software regulations (IEC 62304\). * Container Orchestration: Heavy production experience configuring and troubleshooting containerized workloads via Amazon ECS. The employee is also required to interact with a computer and communicate with peers and co\-workers. Contact your manager or local HR to understand the Work Conditions and Physical requirements that may be specific to each role. **Benefits \& Compensation** ============================ **MiniMed offers a competitive salary and flexible benefits package** At MiniMed, we put people first. A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values: We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every stage of your career and life. Salary ranges for U.S (excl. PR) locations (USD):138,000\.00 \- $234,000\.00 For roles located in California, Seattle WA, Washington DC, Boston MA, and New York City, the salary range is $153,000\.00 \- $261,000\.00 USD. Actual compensation may vary based on factors including experience, education, certifications, skills, market conditions, internal equity, and geographic location. At MiniMed, we are committed to supporting the well\-being and financial security of our employees. In addition, all regular employees enjoy incentive plans, a 401(k) plan with company match, short\-term disability coverage, paid time off and holidays, participation in our Employee Stock Purchase Plan, and access to our Employee Assistance Program. Eligible employees may also benefit from our Non\-qualified Retirement Plan Supplement and Capital Accumulation Plan, subject to IRS minimum earnings requirements. Please note that “regular employees” refers to those who are not temporary staff, such as interns, and some benefits may not apply to employees in Puerto Rico. MiniMed Benefits Overview **About MiniMed** ================= MiniMed is a full\-stack insulin delivery company dedicated to supporting people living with diabetes through every step of their journey — when and how they need it. For more than 40 years, we’ve been committed to redefining what’s possible: intelligent dosing systems designed for real life, predictive insights that stay a step ahead, and always on support when it’s needed most. jobs.title: Manager, Fleet Operations
jobs.description: At Mobius Renewables, we’re helping lead the global energy transition by transforming waste into renewable energy and measurable decarbonization. We’re a fast\-growing team of expert innovators, engineers, and problem\-solvers committed to advancing global sustainability, fueling a circular economy, and creating a cleaner future for all. Join us and help shape the future of renewable energy. **Position Summary:** Mobius Renewables is seeking an experienced, hands\-on Fleet Manager to lead the daily operations of our mid\-sized CNG/RNG virtual pipeline trucking fleet. This role is responsible for safe, compliant, and efficient fleet performance across drivers, tractors, trailers, and customer deliveries. The Fleet Manager will assist with dispatch execution, driver accountability, BOL reconciliation, customer invoicing reconciliation, driver payroll, contract management, maintenance coordination, regulatory compliance, and asset utilization to ensure reliable service and strong operational performance. The ideal candidate brings a strong background in trucking operations, fleet leadership, and DOT/FMCSA compliance, along with the ability to build a safety\-first culture, improve fleet efficiency, and support consistent on\-time delivery for our customers. **Key Responsibilities:** * Fleet Operations Management: Lead day\-to\-day fleet operations for a mid\-sized trucking fleet, including dispatch coordination, route execution, asset deployment, and delivery performance across regional and assigned lanes. * Driver Leadership \& Accountability: Supervise and support drivers to ensure safe operations, professionalism, policy compliance, and strong service performance. Coach drivers and address attendance, performance, and disciplinary matters as needed. * Safety \& Regulatory Compliance: Maintain compliance with all applicable DOT, FMCSA, HOS, ELD, DVIR, and vehicle inspection requirements. Partner with internal teams to promote a strong safety culture and ensure readiness for audits, inspections, and regulatory reviews. * CNG/RNG Virtual Pipeline Operations: Oversee the safe and efficient movement of CNG/RNG equipment and gas deliveries, including coordination of trailer availability, site scheduling, loading/unloading workflows, and customer delivery requirements. * Maintenance Coordination: Partner with maintenance providers and internal stakeholders to manage preventive maintenance schedules, repairs, inspections, and equipment downtime. Ensure tractors and trailers are safe, road\-ready, and operating at high levels of reliability. * Asset Utilization \& Efficiency: Monitor and improve tractor and trailer utilization, route efficiency, fuel performance, driver productivity, and empty\-mile reduction. Identify opportunities to increase uptime and improve operating performance. * Dispatch \& Service Performance: Work closely with dispatch and operations teams to ensure timely load planning, schedule execution, customer communication, and rapid resolution of service disruptions. * BOL, Invoicing and Driver Payroll Reconciliation: Assist director of operations with reconciling daily BOL’s, accurate monthly invoicing, and accurate driver payroll execution. * Customer Contract Management: Assist director of operations with company’s adherence to contractual obligations and address with management when terms and conditions are not properly executed. * Incident Response \& Corrective Action: Lead response efforts related to accidents, breakdowns, service failures, and safety incidents. Support investigations, document findings, and implement corrective and preventive actions. * Documentation \& Recordkeeping: Ensure accurate and timely fleet documentation, including driver qualification records, inspection records, maintenance files, training records, and compliance\-related reporting. * KPI Management \& Continuous Improvement: Track and report key fleet performance indicators such as on\-time delivery, safety events, CSA\-related trends, equipment uptime, driver turnover, and cost performance. Use data to identify trends and drive operational improvements. * Vendor \& Service Provider Coordination: Manage relationships with third\-party service providers, including maintenance vendors, roadside assistance providers, and other operational partners that support fleet continuity and compliance. **Qualifications:** * Education: Bachelor’s degree in Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain, Business, Operations Management, or a related field preferred. Equivalent fleet leadership experience will also be considered. * Experience: 3 \+ years of experience in trucking, transportation, or fleet operations, including direct responsibility for drivers, equipment, dispatch, and compliance. * Leadership Experience: Demonstrated success leading a fleet team in a fast\-paced operating environment with responsibility for safety, service, and operational execution. * Regulatory Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of DOT/FMCSA regulations, including Hours of Service, ELD compliance, driver qualification files, vehicle inspections, and CSA\-related performance expectations. * Fleet Operations Knowledge: Experience managing tractors, trailers, driver schedules, asset utilization, and service performance in a private, dedicated, or specialized fleet environment. * Safety Focus: Proven ability to reinforce safe work practices, lead incident follow\-up, and maintain high standards of driver and equipment compliance. * Technical Skills: Proficiency with fleet management systems, ELD/telematics platforms, dispatch software, and Microsoft Excel for reporting and performance tracking. * Problem\-Solving: Strong operational decision\-making skills with the ability to prioritize issues, solve problems quickly, and maintain service continuity in a dynamic environment. * Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work effectively across drivers, dispatch, operations leadership, maintenance partners, and customers. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience in CNG, RNG, industrial gas, energy distribution, bulk transport, or other specialized trailer operations. * Experience with hazmat\-regulated operations, high\-pressure gas equipment, or safety\-sensitive transportation environments.

and interests, you will have the opportunity to align with one of our specialized domains: * **Agent Client Tools \- Buy Side:** Crafting collaborative, client\-facing interfaces and agent tools that guide buyers through every step of the journey, from initial home search to close. * **CRM \- Comms:** Designing and scaling the communication engines *(email, text, and notifications)* that enable users. * Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with district employees, administrators, vendors, and technology personnel. * Ability to research, evaluate, and recommend technology solutions. * Ability to prepare technical documentation and procedures. * Ability to write and coordinate the RFP process. **Minimum Education and Experience** **Education** One of the following: * Bachelor's degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Networking, or a related field**; **or** * Associate's degree in a related field with appropriate industry certifications, successfully perform the essential functions of the position. **Preferred Qualifications** Preference may be given to candidates with experience in: * K\-12 school district technology environments * Cisco networking * Meraki networking * Active Directory * Google Workspace for Education * VoIP systems * Mobile Device Management (MDM) * Network security * Content filtering systems * IP camera and **Physical Requirements** The employee must be able to physically perform the basic operational functions of the position, including: * Reaching * Walking * Standing * Talking * Lifting * Hearing * frequently, with a negligible amount of force required to constantly move objects. jobs.title: Product Manager - NYC
jobs.description: **About Morning Consult** ------------------------- Morning Consult is a global decision intelligence company changing how modern leaders make smarter, faster, better decisions. The company pairs its proprietary high\-frequency data with applied artificial intelligence to better inform decisions on what people think and how they will act. This role is available in any of our office locations (Washington, DC; New York, NY; Chicago, IL) or can be based remotely, though candidates in Washington, DC or New York, NY are preferred. Our award\-winning and modern, open concept offices are located in Washington, DC, Chicago, IL and New York, NY. All three offices are accessible by public transportation and in close proximity to great restaurants and shopping. Join us in the office for catered lunch on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, or grab a beverage from the fridge for an impromptu after\-work happy hour! **The Role** ------------ We're looking for a Product Manager to join our highly collaborative, driven, and creative Product \& Engineering team. It’s never been a more exciting time to work at a data company building products on mountains of proprietary data. For the last few years, we’ve been continuously innovating on how we leverage AI to meet the next level of customer need, with creativity and speed. This is an execution\-first role. You'll partner day\-to\-day with Engineering to turn priorities into a strong, well\-run backlog — writing tickets, unblocking work, tracking down the follow\-up nobody else caught, and making sure nothing stalls between teams. We do a lot of our work in ambiguous problem spaces that are being mapped out as we go. Your job is to bring clarity and momentum to the work, not to have all the answers on day one. You'll work closely with a Senior PM who owns the broader strategic picture across two engineering teams. What we need most is someone who can lock into the details, keep things moving, and build trust with engineers and stakeholders along the way. Over time, as you build context and track record, this role has room to grow into more strategic ownership and direct client\-facing work. We're intentionally open on background here. We're less focused on whether you've run a product team before and more focused on whether you're a self\-starter who's smart, curious, and proactive. A few years of relevant experience is great; what matters most is how you operate. **What You'll Be Working On** ----------------------------- **Execution (the core of this role)** * Own a clean, prioritized backlog with clear user stories, requirements, acceptance criteria, and scope decisions. Following up until requirements actually land * Partner with engineering on solution design and scope, pushing for iterative releases that get value out the door without waiting for perfect * Set the team up for productive planning and refinement by coming prepared, not catching up in the room * Track the metrics that tell you whether something's actually working, and use them to inform what's next * Proactively surface risks, blockers, and things that aren't connecting — before they turn into fire drills **Strategy (collaborative, growing over time)** * Work with Engineering leads and your Senior PM partner to help shape and prioritize problem statements * Build enough domain fluency — through relentless, good\-natured question\-asking — to understand not just what you're building, but why it matters and what it unlocks downstream * Communicate clearly to a range of audiences: writing help docs and release notes, and keeping stakeholders honestly informed on status * As you grow in the role, take on more direct stakeholder and client conversations — asking the right discovery questions rather than just relaying what Engineering tells you **About You** ------------- * Roughly 3\-5 years of relevant experience — this can be product management, or another background (engineering, operations, client success, program management) that's built the same muscles * Proactive, low\-ego, and collaborative — you care more about the team's outcomes than individual credit, and you'd rather ask "want me to jump in on this?" than wait to be assigned * A strong, clear communicator who shares status and priorities without being asked, and who's comfortable saying "here's where this actually stands" * Comfortable moving fast and showing work early, even when it's not fully polished — you'd rather check in on direction than burn a week perfecting something that might be off\-track * Curious enough to dig into a technical domain you haven't worked in before and keep asking questions until you genuinely understand it * A relationship\-builder — engineers trust you, and people don't worry about what's happening on your team * Experience with APIs or technical/data products is a plus, but not required * It is not required that you meet each of the above to qualify for consideration. A combination of experience and demonstrated ability may qualify you for the role. ***Note:*** *We view the above section as a guide, not a checklist. Research shows that underrepresented/marginalized groups are less likely to apply for a job if they feel that they don’t meet 100% of the qualifications. We welcome diverse and non\-traditional backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you don’t satisfy every single bullet on this list! It’s expected that you’ll learn and grow throughout your time at Morning Consult, so if you’re open to building new skills, we’d love to hear from you.* The expected salary range for this position is $107,500 – $174,900, with a midpoint of $141,200\. In most cases, we target the midpoint of our salary ranges for new hire compensation. This placement is reflective of full proficiency in a role. This role is eligible for an equity grant, which will be discussed in your initial recruiter conversation. Please see an overview of Morning Consult’s benefits on our Career Page. **We are committed to a work environment that is inclusive to all and free of discrimination. It is our policy to be an equal opportunity employer without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic predisposition or carrier status, veteran status, citizenship status or any other factors prohibited by law. Morning Consult will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals.** \#LIRemote MORNING CONSULT PRIVACY POLICY

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer - ED&A - Global Industrial
jobs.description: **Site Reliability Engineer \- ED\&A** **The Site Reliability Engineer – EDA** is a technical contributor responsible for Site Reliability Engineering practices supporting the Enterprise Data \& Analytics platform. This role performs reliability and operational engineering for data and analytics platforms, integrations, pipelines, and related services, including platforms such as Google BigQuery, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Power Platform, and associated Azure and Google Cloud services. The Site Reliability Engineer establishes service\-level indicators, service\-level objectives, error budgets, monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and runbooks while driving incident response, root\-cause analysis, automation, capacity planning, performance tuning, resilience, and production readiness. This role provides technical guidance, engineering standards, and operational best practices for engineers supporting EDA services, and partners closely with data engineering, application, cloud, security, and governance teams to improve reliability, supportability, and business outcomes. **JOB DUTIES** * Performs reliability and operational engineering for the Enterprise Data \& Analytics platform, including Google BigQuery, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Power Platform, associated data pipelines, integrations, automation, reporting services, and dependent cloud services. * Establishes and governs service\-level indicators, service\-level objectives, error budgets, availability targets, performance baselines, monitoring standards, alerting practices, dashboards, runbooks, and operational health metrics for EDA services. * Analyzes telemetry from monitoring, logging, tracing, platform administration, pipeline execution, query performance, capacity, consumption, and cost\-management tools to identify reliability, performance, security, scalability, and efficiency improvements. * Partners with data engineering, application, cloud, security, governance, analytics, and infrastructure teams to improve platform design, integration patterns, deployment practices, release readiness, supportability, resilience, and production operations. * Drives automation for provisioning, deployment, remediation, monitoring configuration, environment validation, job and pipeline health checks, alert enrichment, access reviews, incident response workflows, and operational reporting. * Guides capacity planning, performance tuning, resilience engineering, disaster recovery planning, backup and restore validation, service continuity planning, architecture reviews, and production readiness assessments for EDA services. * Troubleshoots and resolves incidents involving data and analytics platforms, workloads, integrations, pipelines, APIs, automation flows, connectors, workspaces, gateways, permissions, queries, semantic models, and platform dependencies. * Drives incident response, root\-cause analysis, post\-incident reviews, corrective actions, and reliability improvement plans to reduce recurrence, improve operational maturity, and strengthen customer experience. * Provides technical guidance, engineering standards, implementation patterns, peer support, operational reviews, documentation practices, and reliability expectations for engineers supporting the EDA platform. * Promotes secure, compliant, cost\-effective, and well\-governed data and analytics operations by supporting access controls, data protection practices, platform governance, resource utilization reviews, lifecycle management, and operational reporting. **EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE** Typically requires a bachelor's degree and five (5\) to seven (7\) years of experience in a technology and/or software engineering role or an equivalent combination. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES** * Advanced understanding of SRE principles, including reliability engineering, observability, automation, incident response, root\-cause analysis, post\-incident improvement, service\-level indicators, service\-level objectives, error budgets, and production readiness. * Experience performing reliability, operations, or engineering support for enterprise data and analytics platforms used for reporting, data engineering, integration, automation, business intelligence, and business productivity workloads. * Experience with Google Cloud data services such as BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, IAM, networking concepts, and workload or job performance troubleshooting. * Experience with Microsoft Azure services and operational capabilities, including Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Azure networking, identity and access management, resource management, and cloud\-native administration. * Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Power Platform, Power Automate, Power Apps, gateways, connectors, workspaces, data pipelines, semantic models, and platform administration concepts. * Ability to monitor, troubleshoot, and tune platform performance, capacity, reliability, availability, jobs, queries, pipelines, APIs, integrations, automation flows, and dependent services. * Knowledge of identity, access, security, data governance, compliance, data protection, backup, recovery, and change\-management practices for enterprise data and analytics platforms. * Experience creating and governing operational dashboards, alerting standards, runbooks, production support documentation, platform standards, reliability scorecards, and continuous improvement plans. * Experience with automation, scripting, infrastructure as code, configuration management, and CI/CD tooling such as Azure DevOps, Terraform, PowerShell, Python, or similar tools. * Experience with observability and monitoring platforms such as Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Monitoring, Grafana, Datadog, Dynatrace, or similar tools. * Ability to provide technical guidance across infrastructure, security, data, application, cloud, governance, and business technology teams to improve reliability, supportability, standards adoption, operational maturity, and customer experience. * Strong troubleshooting skills across cloud services, network dependencies, APIs, databases, operating systems, authentication, authorization, and enterprise integration patterns. * A strong mix of software engineering, systems engineering, data platform operations, automation, production support, technical guidance, and cross\-functional collaboration skills. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS:** **LICENSES \& CERTIFICATIONS:** **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:** **BUDGET RESPONSIBILITY:** No **COMPANY INFORMATION:** Motion offers an excellent benefits package which includes options for healthcare coverage, 401(k), tuition reimbursement, vacation, sick, and holiday pay. **DISCLAIMER:** This job description illustrates the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this job classification. It is not intended to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and skills required. Management retains the right to add or modify duties at any time. Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by joining our Talent Community on jobs.genpt.com or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest! GPC conducts its business without regard to sex, race, creed, color, religion, marital status, national origin, citizenship status, age, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability, military status, status as a veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
