jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer I
jobs.description: **About Us** At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive "sick\-care" to proactive health care. Our award\-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non\-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient\-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against "we caught it too late again". **We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer I to join our team!** You will be responsible for ensuring the quality of a suite of tools for providers, patient workflows, and diagnostic reporting. Successful candidates will be ambitious, self\-driven, and organized, deeply invested in both the user experience and the real\-world functionality of our products. **This role is fully remote; however, we have a preference for candidates able to work in the Pacific Time Zone (PST) hours to better align with team collaboration.** **This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).** Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting\-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise \- join us to make a difference in people's lives! **What You'll Do** * Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and developers to shape quality from the ground up. * Analyze and evaluate business requirements with product managers and translate them into test strategies. * Create, execute, and maintain test documentation and test plans. * Create and execute manual and automated testing of web applications: exploratory, functional, acceptance, regression, and UI testing. * Test APIs and backend services (REST, GraphQL) for robustness and correctness. * Ensure that quality issues and defects are appropriately identified, documented, prioritized, and tracked. * Lead root cause analysis with developers to accelerate defect resolution. * Mentor junior QA engineers and help instill best practices across the team. * Be an active voice in process improvements to raise product quality and engineering performance. * Integrate testing into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous quality. * Ensure web applications meet accessibility standards (WCAG/ADA) through manual and automated testing. * Contribute to performance and security testing efforts where applicable.. **What You'll Bring** * 4\+ years of professional experience in software QA. * Strong knowledge of QA methodologies, tools, and processes. * Experience with test design techniques and practical implementation. * Strong knowledge of web technologies: HTML, CSS, client\-server architecture, and APIs. * Experience testing RESTful and GraphQL APIs. * Awareness of accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG) and experience testing with tools like Axe, Lighthouse, or screen readers. * Experience with automated testing frameworks (Selenium, Cypress, Appium, Espresso, XCUITest). * Solid experience with bug tracking systems (e.g., JIRA). * Strong analytical and communication skills, with proven problem\-solving abilities. * A collaborative mindset and a passion for delivering high\-quality, user\-centered products. * BS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience. **Nice to Have** * Experience testing native mobile applications (iOS and/or Android). * Familiarity with mobile app testing tools such as Xcode, Android Studio, Appium, Detox, or BrowserStack. * Understanding of mobile app distribution workflows (TestFlight, Google Play Console) and CI/CD integration. * Experience designing and executing accessibility test strategies to ensure inclusive user experiences. * Experience contributing to performance and security testing initiatives. * Experience testing healthcare applications, electronic health record (EHR) systems, or products handling sensitive health data (HIPAA, PHIPA, or similar compliance environments). **Our Values** First: we are **Pioneers** * Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding. Second: we are **Platform\-Builders** * We're always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what's ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission. Above all: we are **Patients** * We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients' lives, and we won't stop till everyone can benefit from our work. **What We Offer** * An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health * We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team \- Prenuvo provides free, whole\-body scans to each team member * Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we're doing big things with bright minds \- there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way * Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do \- our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize * Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing \- we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it * Retirement made easy! Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre\-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions. * We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family * **The base salary for this role ranges from** **$140,000\-$153,000** **in local currency, depending upon experience and geographic location** *We are an equal\-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.* *As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal, provincial, and state rules.* **Please be advised that official communication from our recruitment team will only come from our authorized domain \[****prenuvo.com****]. If you are contacted by a recruiter, please ensure their email address ends with @prenuvo.com. We do not use third\-party recruitment services or any other email domains for hiring purposes. If you receive communication that you believe to be fraudulent, please report it immediately to jobs@prenuvo.com.**

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Junior Software Engineer** **This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in\-office.** Our Technology team is the backbone of our company: constantly creating, testing, learning and iterating to better meet the needs of our customers. If you thrive in a fast\-paced, ideas\-led environment, you’re in the right place. **Why this job’s a big deal:** Join an Agile team of professionals that are instrumental in building the next generation of travel applications. We constantly explore new technologies and engineer better solutions for ever demanding user needs. You will play a pivotal role in transforming complex AI models into intuitive, user\-friendly experiences that engage and empower users. This position gives you the chance to directly shape how AI enhances digital interactions by designing and developing cutting\-edge solutions that bring advanced AI capabilities seamlessly into users' travel tasks. You’ll work at the heart of innovation, pushing boundaries in both applied AI and UX to create impactful, real\-world applications. If you're passionate about creating meaningful, user\-centered AI experiences, this role offers an unparalleled opportunity to lead in a dynamic, forward\-thinking environment. **In this role you will get to:** * Participate in mission critical projects with direct impact on the evolution of Priceline's business. * Be part of a cross\-functional agile team that continuously experiments, iterates and delivers on new product objectives. * Showcase your development skills of Core Java or similar programming languages. * Apply your programming skills towards building low latency and high throughput transactional services with continuous integration and automation testing. * Implement SQL composition skills that collects and queries data for investigation and analysis in real time from our applications. * Utilize your knowledge to understand our codebase, systems and business requirements to effectively make changes to our applications. * Effectively collaborate and engage in team efforts, speak up for what you think are the best solutions and be able to converse respectfully and compromise when necessary. * Design, develop, and optimize sophisticated Generative AI\-driven applications that enhance user experiences and streamline interactions across platforms. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including software engineers of various disciplines, UX designers, and product managers to define user needs and translate them into effective AI solutions. * Join in and propose some of the architecture and implementation of applied generative AI models, ensuring they are seamlessly integrated into user interfaces and enhance the overall functionality of the platform. * Conduct testing and performance optimization to ensure high\-quality and responsive user experiences, including troubleshooting and debugging as necessary. * Work with developers and contribute to the development of best practices within the team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation. * Stay ahead of industry trends in AI and UX, bringing new ideas and techniques to the team to ensure we remain competitive and at the cutting edge of technology. **Who you are:** * Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or related field. * 0\-1 year of experience in software engineering and development. * Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust. * Strong coding experience in JavaScript/TypeScript and corresponding tooling, NodeJS, HTML, CSS and React or equivalent frameworks are a must. * Strong understanding of UX principles and user\-centered design. * You have hands\-on experience with applied generative AI development using tools like the Langchain suite, Vercel AI, Mastra AI, Spring\-AI or model provider APIs. * Knowledge or experience with GraphQL is a strong bonus. * Experience developing in Docker and Cloud environments, especially GCP and AWS is nice to have. * You excel in cross\-functional environments, effectively communicating complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * You have strong analytical skills, able to troubleshoot and refine algorithms and code for optimal performance. * You’re passionate about exploring new technologies and approaches in AI and UX, eager to bring fresh ideas to your projects. * The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential. \#LI\-JB1 \#LI\-Hybrid There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, certain roles may be eligible for an annual bonus and/or equity grant. The salary range for this position is $80,000 \- $100,000 USD. **Who We Are** ============== **WE ARE PRICELINE.** Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding \- we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers. Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown\-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized. We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration. Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable. If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out! **Flexible work at Priceline** ============================== Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office. **Perks \& Benefits at Priceline** ================================== Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to: **Health \& wellness coverage** including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources **Generous time off** including PTO, holidays, a company\-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days **Work/life support** including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location) **Financial security programs** such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax\-advantaged accounts **Signature travel perks** including employee\-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits **Additional perks \& discounts** like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits **A people\-first culture** with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together *Specific benefits and programs vary by location.* **Inclusion is a Big Deal!** ============================ To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work. Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary. **Applying for this position** We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all **current employees**, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply. External candidates are required to have an account before applying.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer II
jobs.description: About Prime: **Introducing Prime Controls, L.P.** Established in 2004, Prime Controls, L.P. is a family\-owned Systems Integration and I\&C Construction firm dedicated to meeting clients’ industrial automation and control requirements. As a Main Automation Contractor, we offer comprehensive solutions, supported by our size, expertise, and extensive experience. With a professional team of 1000\+ employees, Prime Controls serves customers nationwide from our Dallas, Texas headquarters and offices throughout the United States. Our mission is to deliver the highest quality professional services while prioritizing our employees’ well\-being and fostering an exceptional workplace environment. Overview: As an Automation Specialist II you will be responsible for the design of control system details, instrumentation configuration, preparation for implementation, implementation, testing, documentation, and training. **A Typical Day at Prime Controls*** Collaborates with project managers and estimators to assess potential projects and submit proposals. * Reads and interprets diagrams and documentation and communicates with customers to understand objectives and preferences. * Develops the overall architecture and communication strategy between control system elements. * Works with the customer and other stakeholders to define and document control system functionality. * Develops BOMs, IO lists, and requirements for control panels * Serves as the technical lead for small projects. This includes building PLC and HMI templates for the project. * Develops PLC programs in Ladder, Function Block, and other languages. * Develops the human machine interface (HMI). * Develops hardware and software test plans and writes simulation logic for the testing of the PLC and HMI system. * Develops a training plan and materials to train operations and maintenance personnel. * Communicates and coordinates with management of the installation team to ensure that technicians are executing per documented processes. * Tests the installed system to observe system functionality and ensure that the programs function as designed. * Troubleshoots problems that occur during startup that are caused by incorrect drawings, changes in customer desires, inaccurate instrumentation specifications, or other technical issues. Diagnoses and resolves software and hardware interface issues. * Trains customers on use and operation of client\-specific system integration software. * Interfaces with manufacturers and vendors of software and application products, especially with regard to problem diagnosis and resolution. * Works with others to address design problems as necessary. * May respond to service calls to troubleshoot, diagnose, and repair programming and system failures. * Mentor and train less experienced employees. **What You Will Bring** ***The Basic**** 4 years Industrial Controls experience in architectural, engineering or construction (AEC) industry or similar field * Bachelor of Science Degree in Mechatronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, related Bachelor’s discipline, related degree from a Technical College or equivalent Industrial controls experience * 4 years of experience in PLC programming * Proficiency with Allen Bradley equipment and systems * Proficiency in PLC Programming including ladder logic, function block, and structured text * Familiarity with networking (Ethernet/IP) * Experience and knowledge of HMIs ***The Preferred**** 6 years of experience in architectural, engineering or construction (AEC) industry or similar field * Proficiency with AutoCAD – Autodesk software Benefits: **What We Offer:** Full\-time employees enjoy a great benefits package including, but not limited to:* Health, Dental, and Vision coverage * Flexible Spending Account(s) * Generous PTO * Numerous culture events * ESOP * 401k matching and more! Work Environment \& Physical Demands (Text Only): Physical requirements and work environment expectations vary by position. Generally, roles at Prime Controls may involve moderate noise, occasional exposure to outdoor weather conditions, and, depending on the role, work at heights or around airborne particles and electrical components. Physical activities may include standing, walking, sitting, climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, or crawling, as well as the use of hands, arms, and voice communication. Some roles may require lifting and/or moving up to 50 pounds. Vision requirements may include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. EEO: Prime Controls is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Affirmative Action/Veteran/Disabled employer. As a federal contractor, Prime Controls is required to participate in the federal government’s E\-Verify program, which confirms employment authorization of all newly hired employees and most existing employees through an electronic database maintained by the Social Security Administration and Department of Homeland Security. For new hires, the E\-Verify process is completed in conjunction with the Form I\-9 Employment Eligibility Verification on or before the first day of work. E\-Verify is not used as a tool to pre\-screen candidates.

jobs.title: IT Field Technician
jobs.description: Overview: Location: Spokane, Washington Salary Range: $22\.00\-34\.00 per hour Travel: 30% travel between Spokane, Washington and Los Angeles, CA. **Candidate must reside near Spokane, WA.** **Job Description Summary / Scope** Owns the day\-to\-day performance, reliability, and security of on\-site technology for an assigned territory of approximately 10–20 PRISM locations and serves as the primary point of local IT presence and accountability. Acts as the face of IT to clinic staff, office managers, and providers, building the relationships needed to catch and resolve small issues proactively, before they escalate into disruptions. Does not hold, nor is expected to have, administrator\-level access or specialized expertise for every system. Instead, the role is expected to recognize scope boundaries and engage the right resource (helpdesk, application teams, systems admin, security team, the third\-party MSP, or McKesson's broader technology organization), staying engaged as the site's point of accountability until resolution. Leads device deployment and initial setup for new and existing locations following established checklists, and uses available tools (ticketing/ITSM, RMM, AI\-assisted troubleshooting resources) to work efficiently across the assigned territory. Operates independently with minimal direct daily supervision. Responsibilities: **Key Responsibilities (priority order)** * Provide proactive, in\-person support — regularly checking in with clinic staff, office managers, and providers, and staying alert for wear and early warning signs (a fraying cable, a struggling access point) so issues are caught and resolved before they disrupt clinical operations. * Travel on\-site to resolve hardware, peripheral, and connectivity issues that require hands\-on intervention (desktops, monitors, keyboards/mice, printers, network drops) across all assigned locations. * Recognize issues that fall outside the role's scope or access, and engage the right resource — application analysts, systems engineers, security, or McKesson's broader technology teams — remaining engaged as the site's point of accountability until resolution. * Maintain clean, organized, and locked network closets and equipment areas at each site. * Document all work performed clearly and in a timely manner within the ticketing system, written well enough to feed the team's AI\-assisted knowledge base for future reuse. * Log, triage, and troubleshoot tickets within PRISM's ITSM platform for the assigned territory, coordinating with helpdesk on issues that originate as remote tickets, using AI tools to speed ticket documentation and summarization. * Use approved RMM tools and AI\-assisted troubleshooting resources to remotely access and diagnose devices, resolving issues without a site visit wherever possible to manage travel time efficiently. * Perform device deployment for new and existing locations: unboxing, installing, and testing functionality of PCs and peripherals, staging networking equipment, labeling devices, and completing initial setup per provided checklists, and ensuring the secure return or disposal of legacy hardware/e\-waste. * Maintain basic security and compliance vigilance: identify devices missing patches or endpoint security software, ensure physical data privacy (e.g., reporting printed user credentials, screen positioning to protect PHI), and flag physical security gaps such as unsecured network closets, escalating as appropriate. * Collaborate with external support partners within the assigned territory. This includes collaborating with the third\-party MSP partner for overflow and after\-hours support coverage, facilitating on\-site hardware repairs and acting as the local coordinator for telecom and IT vendors during on\-site maintenance visits. Qualifications: **Minimum Qualifications** ***Education/Training*** * High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate degree in IT or related field a plus. ***Business Experience*** * Hands\-on experience troubleshooting desktop hardware, peripherals, and basic networking, gained through prior work, internship, or equivalent training. ***Specialized Knowledge/Skills*** * Working knowledge of desktop OS environments (Windows required; macOS a plus) and common peripheral troubleshooting. * Experience working within a ticketing/ITSM system and using remote monitoring and management (RMM) tools for remote diagnosis and resolution. * Basic understanding of network fundamentals (connectivity, wireless, cabling) sufficient to diagnose and escalate appropriately. * Basic security awareness: identifying missing patches/AV status and physical security gaps. * Strong interpersonal skills; ability to work independently in a clinical setting while maintaining professionalism with providers, staff, and patients. * Preferred: CompTIA A\+ or Network\+ certification (or obtained within 6 months of hire); prior healthcare/medical office IT support experience; familiarity with EMR workstation environments; knowledge of medical imaging devices and their associated PCs (OCT cameras, X\-ray systems, and similar equipment). **Working Conditions** * Field\-based role; no fixed office location. Regular travel by personal vehicle within an assigned territory; mileage reimbursed per company policy. * Must maintain a valid driver's license, reliable vehicle, and clean driving record. * Requires lifting/carrying IT equipment (up to 50 lbs), and working in varied physical spaces including network closets, under desks, and similar tight spaces. * Occasional support outside standard business hours for site openings, major deployments, or urgent escalations. * HIPAA training and standard background check required, consistent with a clinical work environment.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description: Description: **About Us:** PurgeRite, the leader in high\-quality mechanical flushing services, is seeking highly motivated and experienced engineers. We serve all sizes of commercial mechanical companies across the U.S. with end user clients that include many top Fortune 100 companies. Projects include data centers, semiconductor and EV battery manufacturers, universities, health care facilities, and district energy systems. **Position Overview:** Our customers choose PurgeRite because of our unique ability to deliver turn\-key flushing solutions for some of the most complex hydronic systems being deployed today. The Project Coordinator is a key support role within the Project Management team, responsible for tracking, updating, and managing project schedules and change orders in a dynamic, fast\-paced construction environment. As project timelines shift and change orders evolve, this role ensures that schedules remain up to date, change orders are properly documented, and critical project information is consistently organized. This key position is responsible for planning, executing, and closing projects while managing resources, timelines, and stakeholder expectations. **Key Responsibilities:** * **Project Schedule Tracking \& Updates:** + Maintain and update project schedules as upcoming construction project timelines shift. + Actively monitor and track schedule changes, ensuring all stakeholders are informed. + Work closely with Project Managers to ensure milestone tracking aligns with project execution and billing schedules. + Develop and enforce standardized scheduling processes in the PMO, NetSuite, MS Project, for consistency across all projects. * **Change Order Management \& Documentation:** + Track and follow up on all change orders to ensure they are properly documented, approved, and logged. + Ensure change orders are fully executed before work is performed to mitigate financial risk. + Maintain an organized change order log, providing visibility to Project Managers and leadership pending, approved, and rejected changes. + Communicate regularly with PMs, field teams, and customers to keep change order status up to date. * **Project Coordination \& Process Standardization:** + Support Project Managers by organizing and maintaining project documentation, including RFIs, submittals, contracts, and approvals. + Assist in defining and implementing structured processes for tracking project progress, scheduling, and change management. + Develop reporting and dashboards within VMB, MS Project \& NetSuite to provide visibility into project timelines, changes, and status updates. + Ensure project tracking data remains current, reducing gaps in scheduling and billing accuracy. * **Communication \& Follow\-Up:** + Act as a liaison between Project Managers, field teams, vendors, and customers regarding scheduling updates and change orders. + Proactively follow up with internal and external stakeholders to keep schedules and change orders moving forward. + Assist in scheduling internal and external project meetings and preparing necessary reports. Requirements: * 2\+ years of experience in project coordination, scheduling, or construction administration. * Experience in the mechanical construction industry or large\-scale construction projects is preferred. * Strong organizational skills with the ability to track multiple moving project schedules simultaneously. * Proficiency in project management software and ERP systems; experience with NetSuite is a plus. Strong Microsoft Excel skills are essential. * Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to follow up persistently. * Ability to work in a fast\-paced, constantly changing environment while maintaining attention to detail. * Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to work independently. PurgeRite is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We promote equal opportunities for all with respect to hiring, terms of employment, mobility, training, compensation, and occupational health, without discrimination as to age, race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy status (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression (including transgender status or sexual stereotypes), genetic information, citizenship status, national origin, protected veteran status, political affiliation, or disability.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI Applications
jobs.description: Why RTI: RTI International is an independent, scientific research institute dedicated to improving the human condition. Our vision is to address the world's most critical problems with technical and science\-based solutions in pursuit of a better future. Clients rely on us to answer questions that demand an objective and multidisciplinary approach—one that integrates expertise across social, statistical, data, and laboratory sciences, engineering, and other technical disciplines to solve the world’s most challenging problems. We believe in the promise of science and technical solutions, and we push ourselves every day to deliver on that promise for the good of people, communities, and businesses in the US and around the world. If you are looking for the opportunity to make a real difference, RTI is the place for you. About the Hiring Group: **You are:** A ***Software Engineer*** with experience **building cloud\-native applications and applying AI technologies to practical business, research or client needs**. You have contributed to systems beyond the proof\-of\-concept stage and understand the engineering work required to make AI\-enabled applications reliable, secure and maintainable. You are comfortable working through ambiguity, explaining technical trade\-offs and collaborating with researchers, data scientists and software engineers. You can distinguish between a compelling demonstration and a solution that is ready to support real users. You have personally contributed to building and deploying AI\-enabled applications, not just experimenting with models or using AI tools as an end user. You can clearly explain the systems you worked on, your individual contribution, the technical decisions you made, and how you evaluated whether the solution worked. What You'll Do: **The Work:** You will work closely with internal teams and clients to contribute to the design, development, and deployment of AI‑powered solutions across sectors such as health, energy, and education. You will help translate business and research needs into technical implementations, build and refine multi\-step AI workflows, and support the delivery of scalable, secure systems in enterprise environments. You will contribute to new systems and enhancements that integrate with existing infrastructure, collaborating with colleagues and partners to deliver practical solutions that can be tested, deployed, maintained, and supported over time. In this role, you will support the development of AI systems and enhancements that integrate with RTI’s research infrastructure—including survey data collection platforms, systematic review pipelines, data quality assurance systems, and proposal development workflows—working closely with data scientists, domain researchers, and software developers to ensure solutions meet the rigor expected in federally regulated and research‑driven environments. **Location preference****:** **For this position, we strongly prefer candidates who are located within reasonable driving distance of RTI’s headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina. Proximity to RTP will allow for periodic in\-person collaboration, team meetings, and other on\-site activities as needed.** **As part of the interview process, candidates will be asked to discuss a system they personally helped build. The discussion will cover their individual contribution, key technical decisions, challenges encountered, evaluation approach and results. Candidates will also participate in a job\-related technical discussion and exercise.** **Responsibilities:*** **AI System \& Agent Development.** Design, build, and maintain AI‑enabled systems and multi\-stepworkflows, including retrieval, tool use, orchestration, and iterative improvement, with a focus on production readiness and maintainability. * **Enterprise \& Research Infrastructure Integration.** Contribute to AI systems that integrate with and extend RTI’s existing platforms—such as survey data collection, systematic review pipelines, data quality assurance tools, and proposal workflows—working within established architectures and constraints. * **Cloud‑Native Engineering.** Develop and deploy cloud‑native services using APIs, containers, and modern CI/CD practices, contributing to scalable, secure, and cost‑aware AI solutions in enterprise environments. * **Workflow Translation \& Automation.** Translate research, business, and client needs into working AI applications that automate or augment workflows, collaborating closely with data scientists, researchers, and software engineers to ensure practical value and methodological rigor. * **Evaluation, Quality, and Reliability.** Contribute to testing and evaluation approaches for AI systems, including performance monitoring, reliability checks, and cost/quality trade‑off analysis appropriate for federally regulated and research‑driven contexts. * **Client \& Cross‑Team Collaboration.** Participate in technical discussions, workshops, and pro n through APIs or model\-serving infrastructure. * Experience developing systems that work with sensitive, restricted, or confidential data, and understanding how data access, privacy, and compliance requirements influence system design. * Proficiency with shared version control (e.g., Git) and collaborative software development workflows. * Familiarity with modern deployment and delivery practices, including CI/CD pipelines, containers, and basic infrastructure\-as\-code concepts. * Experience working in cross\-functional, team\-based environments, including participating in technical discussions, reviews, and iterative delivery. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain AI system behavior, trade\-offs, and limitations to non\-technical researchers, clients, and federal stakeholders. * To qualify, applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States and should not require, now or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H\-1B visa status, etc.). **Preferred jobs.title: Digital Experience Designer I
jobs.description: **About Radiant Technology** ============================ Radiant Technology is a technology integration and professional services company focused on digital signage, audio\-visual systems, data\-driven experiences, and enterprise visualization. Our Digital Experience Management (DXM) Division designs, deploys, integrates, and supports integrated digital experience systems across airports, manufacturing facilities, healthcare environments, corporate spaces, and enterprise organizations. Radiant combines: * Systems integration * Professional services * Digital experience strategy and technical expertise * Infrastructure and deployment engineering * Software\-driven operational solutions Our teams work across software platforms, infrastructure, networking, hardware, monitoring systems, and real\-time operational data environments to deliver scalable, maintainable customer solutions. Within that work, the Digital Experience Team owns the audience\-facing content and experience. **About the role** ================== The Digital Experience Designer I is an entry\-level, hands\-on design and implementation role. You will help determine what an audience needs, design clear and engaging content, build the experience in supported digital\-signage and web tools, test it in the real environment, and help customers and teammates use what was delivered. This is not a role where you hand off a mockup and walk away. You will carry assigned work from idea through implementation, testing, documentation, training, and handoff\-with regular direction and review as you build independence. You do not need to arrive as a digital\-signage expert or web developer. You do need to have intentionally trained as a designer and developed a strong eye for hierarchy, typography, composition, color, consistency, usability, and the overall quality of an experience. You must also be curious about how systems work and genuinely willing to learn content management systems, digital\-signage platforms, and basic web technologies. **What you will do** ==================== **Design for the audience** --------------------------- * Review the project requirements and identify what the audience needs to understand or do. Ask questions about the content, setting, and project constraints before you begin designing. * Organize the content and design the layouts, graphics, motion, video, data displays, or interfaces the project needs. * Explain your design decisions and revise your work based on feedback. **Build and test the experience** --------------------------------- * Build and configure content in the digital\-signage and content\-management platforms Radiant supports. Follow the team's established methods. * Learn HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and browser testing, then use them to build basic web content with guidance. * Build a sample for early review. Test the completed content on the intended screens, players, and browsers. Check resolution, orientation, and playback schedules. Fix design and configuration issues and test again. **Help people use and support the work** ---------------------------------------- * Document your work so another team member can support or update it. Prepare and deliver assigned customer or team training using walkthroughs, guides, or recorded demonstrations. * Keep the team informed about progress, missing information, and problems that may affect delivery. Get approval before releasing work to customers. * Use what you learn on later assignments. Suggest changes when you see a way to improve a recurring task. **What you bring** ================== **Required** ------------ * A bachelor's degree in graphic design, visual communication, interaction design, digital media design, or a closely related design\-focused discipline. * A portfolio that shows your use of hierarchy, typography, composition, color, and consistency. Your work should show how you organize information for an audience. Be prepared to explain the assignment, your decisions, and how you revised the design. * The ability to explain your work in writing and conversation, check details, and work with customers and teammates in design and technical roles. * The ability and willingness to learn unfamiliar software and technical tools. You ask questions when you need direction, use feedback to improve your work, and follow through on assigned tasks. **Preferred** ------------- * Experience with digital signage, content\-management systems, web\-content tools, presentation systems, or low\-code or no\-code platforms. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, or JavaScript is also helpful. * Design experience with motion, video, interactive content, data visualization, or content for physical spaces and audio\-visual systems. **What Level I means at Radiant** ================================= * You own assigned work within a project rather than being expected to lead the entire engagement immediately. * You use established methods and supported tools with regular review from experienced team members and the Creative Director. * You ask when the objective, authority, priority, or expected result is unclear. * You obtain approval before customer\-facing work is released. * You are expected to learn from specific feedback, apply it to later work, and become increasingly independent. **Why join Radiant Technology** =============================== You will see your designs run on customer screens and learn how to build, test, and maintain the content. You will collaborate with designers, engineers, developers, project managers, and support staff on projects in airports, manufacturing, healthcare, and corporate offices. **Benefits** ============ Radiant Technology offers a benefits package for eligible full\-time employees, including: * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Health Savings Account (HSA) and Health Reimbursement options * Company\-paid life insurance * Short\-term and long\-term disability coverage * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * 401(k) retirement plan with company match * Paid time off and company holidays * Professional development opportunities

jobs.title: Civil Engineer / Senior Civil Engineer – Data Centers
jobs.description: **Company Description** Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation\-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment \& Health, Water, Energy, and Planning \& Urban Design. **Job Description** **Hybrid\-based position in our Pennsylvania, Seattle, Texas, or Louisiana** **office.** Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. No sponsorship is available for this position We invite you to bring your civil engineering and land development experience into play as you support the planning, permitting, and design of data center and other large\-scale industrial sites. This role will provide hands\-on technical leadership for site feasibility, conceptual layouts, grading, drainage, stormwater management, utilities, access, and civil permitting. The successful candidate will have direct experience coordinating with local AHJs and will help strengthen Ramboll's technical capabilities in one or more strategic U.S. data center markets. To succeed in this role, you should have a bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering and approximately 5\+ years of relevant experience. Are you excited about understanding, interpreting, and navigating complex projects with real\-life implications? Are you motivated by creating sustainable change that benefits society and nature? Are you a curious and open\-minded person? If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Environment \& Health Division as our new **Civil Engineer / Senior Civil Engineer – Data Centers** and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future. **Your new role** You will join Ramboll's Civil Engineering and Design team within the Environment \& Health business. The team supports data center, mission\-critical, industrial, and other large\-scale development programs through site due diligence, conceptual master planning, preliminary engineering, permitting, detailed design, and construction support. You will collaborate with civil engineers, CAD designers, environmental specialists, geotechnical engineers, transportation professionals, utility specialists, and other technical disciplines. **Your key responsibilities will be:** * Lead civil engineering and land development services for data center, mission\-critical, and large industrial projects from site selection through construction. * Manage project scope, schedule, budget, staffing, risk, client communication, proposals, and subconsultants across multiple projects. * Direct technical work including site layout, grading, stormwater, drainage, utilities, access roads, erosion control, and permitting. * Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams, clients, agencies, and authorities while navigating codes, permitting requirements, and development standards. * Review technical deliverables, mentor engineers and CAD staff, support team growth, and contribute to client development and market expansion. **Qualifications** **About you** * Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Civil Engineering with approximately 5\+ years of relevant civil/site engineering experience. * Professional Engineer (PE) license strongly preferred, with ability to obtain licensure by comity in target states. * Extensive experience with land development and site civil design for large, complex projects, ideally in industrial, logistics, manufacturing, or mission\-critical environments. * Strong project management and technical expertise, including grading, drainage, stormwater, utilities, permitting, budgeting, scheduling, and client coordination. * Experience working with AHJs and leading multidisciplinary teams; familiarity with Civil 3D and permitting practices in Pennsylvania, Washington, Texas, or Louisiana preferred. **Additional skills:** * Strong ownership of project outcomes with a practical, solutions\-oriented approach. * Clear communication skills with the ability to explain technical issues to clients and nontechnical stakeholders. * Strong commercial judgment and ability to manage scope, schedule, budget, and risk. * Collaborative leadership style with strong prioritization and mentoring skills. * Client\-focused approach with a commitment to safety, quality, and professional standards. **Additional Information** **What we can offer you** * Investment in your development * Being valued for the unique person you are * Never being short of inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects * The long\-term thinking of a foundation\-owned company **Salary Transparency Statement** At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $81,515 \- $101,894 per year. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well\-being, professional development, and work\-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process. **Ready to join us?** Please submit your application with your up\-to\-date CV. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply. Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application. **Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll in the Americas** Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation\-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment \& Health, Water, Energy, and Planning \& Urban Design. **Where People Flourish** Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do. Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward\-thinking solutions to our clients. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We are committed to equal employment opportunity, regardless of age, disability or medical condition, gender identity, marriage and domestic partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, ancestry, or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, military service and veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Ramboll wants to ensure opportunities are accessible to candidates with disabilities. So, please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at job.advert.accessibility@ramboll.com with such requests.

jobs.title: Aerospace Engineer - Level 1
jobs.description: **About Re:Build** ------------------ At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions. We operate an advanced, end\-to\-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full\-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation. The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. *(link to* The Re:Build Way principles*)* **About Re:Build Answer Engineering** ------------------------------------- Answer Engineering, a Re:Build Manufacturing company, is an exceptional engineering firm providing aerospace design and analysis services to companies around the world. The team tackles challenging engineering problems ranging from electric vertical take\-off platforms (EVTOL), to space tourism. To meet the demands of our customers, Answer Engineering is embarking on building a first\-class support organization to ensure the engineering team can remain focused on engineering challenges. Answer Engineering is a casual work environment where discussions take place in the open, events are frequent including company BBQs and ski trips, and our office remains stocked with a variety of snacks and beverage options. Answer Engineering reinforces the value of having a diverse workforce and promotes equity and inclusion for all employees. **Who are we looking for?** --------------------------- We are seeking Staff Engineers to add to our growing team! This position will give you the opportunity to apply all aspects of your education and experience to tackle the challenges of the aerospace community. You will be responsible for design and analysis of a variety of aerospace structures and systems, routinely using CAD and Finite Element Analysis programs to bring ideas to life. You will take part in the creation, modification, manufacturing, and testing of new and existing aerospace vehicles. At Answer Engineering, you are responsible to honor your commitments and deliver quality results to our customers. Collaboration across teams to go above and beyond is a must. **What you get to do!** ----------------------- * Design and analysis of primary and secondary aerospace structures and systems * Create CAD and FEA models, technical reports, and presentations for customers * Develop and implement structural tests and experiments * Communicate across engineering teams to make program critical decisions * Collaborate with other engineers, both internally and externally * Develop supporting material for design such as bill of materials, assembly or installation procedures, and weight optimization trades * Support and collaborate with program management, analysis, procurement, and manufacturing teams **What you will bring to the Team** ----------------------------------- * B.S. in mechanical or aerospace engineering (or comparable education/work experience) * Moderate travel **Preferred Coursework and Experience:** * CAD modeling and drafting parts and assemblies * Finite element theory and modeling * Technical writing and strong presentation skills * Understanding of aerodynamics and aircraft loads * Exposure to engineering software (ANSYS, Catia, LabVIEW, MATLAB, SolidWorks, etc.) * Demonstrated involvement in hands\-on projects (Formula SAE, SAE Heavy Lift, MiniBaja, BotWars, etc.) * Shop or hands\-on experience; part fabrication and assembly * Exposure to composite materials and fabrication * Prior internships or meaningful work experience * Graduate teacher fellow, teaching assistant, or student grader **Salary Range** ---------------- The base salary range for this position is $75,000\-$120,000 per year. This range represents the Company's good faith estimate of the base compensation for this role at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for annual incentive compensation and/or long\-term incentives, subject to Company plans. The Company offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, retirement, paid time off, and other benefits. **The BIG payoff** ------------------ We are a company who is going to make a difference in the industries and the communities in which we choose to operate. Every employee of Re:Build will share ownership in the company and will share in the financial rewards of the success we achieve together, at all levels of the company! **We want to work with people that reflect the communities in which we operate** Re:Build Manufacturing is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, parental status, cultural background, organizational level, work styles, tenure and life experiences. Or for any other reason. Re:Build is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at accommodations.ta@ReBuildmanufacturing.com or you may call us at 617\.909\.6275\.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Growth Acquisition (Growth & Marketing Data)
jobs.description: San Mateo, CA, United StatesEngineeringID: 36620 Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. The User Life Cycle team owns how people discover Roblox, become active, and stay engaged over time. Growth and Marketing are central to that journey, and the quality of our data determines how well we can invest: which channels bring in people who stay, which campaigns actually move the needle, and where people drop out of the funnel. As a Senior Data Engineer embedded in Growth Org, you will build the data foundation behind our marketing measurement and growth flywheel. That includes the pipelines and models that power Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), multi\-touch and incrementality\-based attribution, and end\-to\-end funnel analytics from first touch to long\-term retention. You will work side by side with Marketing, Data Science and Product, and you will report directly to the Engineering Director. #### **You Will:** * Design, build and operate reliable batch and streaming pipelines that unify paid, owned and organic marketing data (spend, impressions, installs, sessions, conversions) with in\-platform user behavior. * Own the data foundation for MMM: build well\-documented, versioned, analysis\-ready datasets and backfills that Data Science can use to train, refresh and validate models on a regular cadence. * Partner with Marketing and Data Science to build attribution and funnel data products, and to define shared metrics (acquisition, activation, retention, reactivation, LTV) that the whole organization can trust. * Architect event taxonomies and logging standards for acquisition and lifecycle events, and influence client and server instrumentation across product surfaces. * Integrate with ad channel platforms, mobile measurement partners and other third\-party sources, with strong attention to data quality, freshness, identity resolution and privacy\-safe design. * Set standards for table design, data quality monitoring, observability, lineage and documentation used across the Growth and Marketing space. * Support experimentation and incrementality work (geo tests, holdouts, lift studies) by making experiment data easy to join to spend and outcomes. * Mentor other engineers, raise the bar on data practices, and collaborate with Data Engineering, Data Infrastructure and ML Platform teams to leverage shared tooling. * Work with partner teams across Roblox to make sure our measurement approach respects user privacy and safety and reflects our community\-first values. #### **You Have:** * 8\+ years of industry experience as a data engineer or data\-focused software engineer building scalable batch and streaming pipelines (SQL and Python, PySpark or Scala). * Experience with orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster or similar) and large\-scale data processing (Spark, Flink, Kafka or similar), including multi\-terabyte datasets. * Strong data modeling skills: you have designed dimensional or event\-based models that analysts and data scientists rely on every day. * Experience working directly with business and data science partners to turn ambiguous questions into durable data products. * Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP or Azure) and modern warehouse or lakehouse technologies. * Comfort with standard software practices: code review, CI/CD, testing and monitoring of data pipelines. #### **Bonus Points:** * Hands\-on exposure to marketing measurement: MMM (for example Robyn, Meridian, PyMC\-Marketing or in\-house models), attribution, incrementality or experimentation platforms. * Experience with marketing and ad data sources (ad platform APIs, mobile measurement partners, CRM or lifecycle tooling) and with identity resolution. * Experience with data privacy constraints in measurement (consent, aggregation, clean rooms, differential privacy). * Experience in consumer products with a growth, ads, personalization or lifecycle focus. #### **You Are:** * A Technical Leader: you have initiated and led challenging technical solutions, and you nurture a culture of technical excellence. * Analytical: you enjoy digging into large, ambiguous problems and quantifying both the problem and the solution. * A Strong Partner: you explain data trade\-offs clearly to non\-engineers and build trust with Marketing and Data Science. * User Oriented: you start with the needs of your customers, whether they are Roblox users or internal teams. * Team Oriented: you lift up your peers and find ways to make the team stronger. For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job\-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full\-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on **this page**. Annual Salary Range $243,290—$295,250 USD Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted). jobs.title: Civil Engineer
jobs.description: **About SMEC** For 75 years, SMEC has built a reputation as a trusted partner on major transport and energy infrastructure projects around the world. Our design leaders and specialist teams draw on deep expertise and experience delivering projects across a range of diverse environments, from some of the world’s most remote locations to some of the densest urban surroundings. We understand the value of relationships to ensure that we comprehensively address all requirements at each stage in a project’s development. By closely collaborating with our clients, contractors, subcontractors and asset operators, we deliver commercially informed design thinking through local specialists who understand on\-the\-ground context and industry expectations. Along with parent company the SJ Group, 2016\-2022 was a period of significant growth and development for SMEC. Spanning 40\+ countries and with the specialist expertise of over 5,000 employees, SMEC continued to deliver complex major projects, world\-class technical excellence and advanced engineering solutions. As part of the SJ Group, SMEC is able to leverage the capabilities of our parent and sister companies to operate flexibly and effectively in local and global markets. We have access to global network of design and engineering expertise, with 16,000 colleagues across 10 multi\-disciplinary brands including architects, designers, planners, engineers and other specialists. **About the Role** The Civil Engineer provides professional civil engineering services to support the delivery, performance, and growth of infrastructure projects within SMEC Solomon Islands. The role involves undertaking design calculations, preparing technical reports, managing project delivery requirements, and supporting client engagement and business development activities. The position also contributes to technical excellence, compliance with environmental and social standards, and continuous professional development while ensuring projects meet client expectations and organizational objectives **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s Degree (Civil Engineering) * Professional Membership of Engineering Body * Minimum 5 years’ experience in civil engineering (preferably in PNG or similar environment) * Male or female * Good communication in English Language **Job Descriptions** * Deliver civil engineering outputs including reports, design calculations, and documentation. * Manage and coordinate project activities in line with client and company requirements. * Provide technical outputs aligned with environmental, social, and quality standards. * Support business development initiatives including proposals and marketing activities. * Supervise and guide drafting and technical support staff where required. * Maintain strong client relationships and contribute to successful project delivery. Has the demonstrated ability to consistently: * Good conceptual understanding of technical subjects * Basics Knowledge Preparation of Bill of Quantities * Basics knowledge on civil, structural and geotechnical design. * Utilise good time management skills with the ability to plan workloads and meet deadlines; * Effectively work across a variety of projects learning new skills and knowledge quickly and efficiently; At Surbana Jurong, we put talent, hard work, teamwork and a fun workplace together to approach problems and solve them creatively and collaboratively. Join us in making a positive impact on the world!

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: Within SSOE’s Tool Install division, we specialize in high\-tech Tool Installation design, offering top\-tier design and engineering services to a diverse array of clients and markets. Our team is composed of highly skilled and knowledgeable professionals who excel across various disciplines. We pride ourselves on our cross\-disciplinary approach, which allows us to understand and address our clients' needs more comprehensively than traditional, siloed methods. What sets us apart is our ability to seamlessly conceptualize, plan, and detail every aspect of design. Our in\-house experts collaborate closely, optimizing and enhancing our work through multi\-discipline strategy sessions. By leveraging cutting\-edge techniques and state\-of\-the\-art software, we deliver industry\-leading technology and innovative solutions from day one. We are currently hiring a skilled **Senior Electrical Engineer** to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will lead design engineering and shaping the future of advanced high\-tech semiconductor, industrial, biotech, healthcare, and pharmaceutical facilities for the world’s leading high\-tech companies. As a Senior Electrical Engineer at SSOE, you will have an opportunity to leverage your expertise and contribute to projects that redefine industry standards. If you have a passion for cutting\-edge technology, your expertise will be crucial in ensuring the quality, compliance, and innovation of our designs. AI and Innovation: At SSOE, we don’t just talk about the future, we build it. As a leader in industry AI adoption, we empower our team to work smarter by providing responsible access to the industry leading AI Large Language Models, vibe\-coding platforms, and securely integrating advanced tools into every role. From day one, you’ll receive the training and support needed to leverage AI as a core tool for enhancing productivity, sparking creativity, and streamlining complex workflows. Responsibilities: * Lead the design, review, and stamping of detailed electrical power distribution and lighting system designs for semiconductor, pharmaceutical, and high\-tech industrial facilities, ensuring compliance with NEC and applicable NFPA guidelines. * Develop coordinated design deliverable documents using AutoCAD, with data\-driven integration of power distribution equipment. * Collaborate closely with all disciplines to synchronize electrical infrastructure to enable efficient constructability and maintain operational safety. * Prepare and review comprehensive basis of design (BOD) documents, electrical system narratives, manpower estimates, project proposal documents and technical specifications aligned to client requirements and code mandates including the International Building Code (IBC) and International Fire Code (IFC). * Manage and execute QA/QC workflows, including peer reviews, design validation, and site walkthroughs, ensuring design intent is executed as specified and system performance goals are met. * Interface regularly with clients, contractors, and vendors to clarify scope, evaluate proposed equipment substitutions, respond to RFIs, and oversee submittal reviews, ensuring robust communication and project transparency throughout the delivery lifecycle. * Utilize modeling tools to perform arc flash hazard analyses, load flow studies, and short circuit calculations, and coordination studies to optimize system safety and operational reliability within complex industrial power systems. * Direct the coordination and integration of electrical drawings and design fabrication packages within Bluebeam. * Lead troubleshooting and commissioning support during turnover, resolving design\-related issues and verifying system functionality to client satisfaction. * Champions, mentors, and coaches the development of our less experienced staff and look for ways to elevate the technical and professional expertise of the team. * Participate in risk assessments associated with electrical designs and contribute to workplace safety practices in alignment with NFPA 70E and site\-specific OSHA requirements. * Support scheduling and cost estimation processes by providing input on electrical system scope, vendor lead times, and constructability considerations relevant to project delivery phases. * Contribute technical expertise during interdisciplinary coordination meetings, providing timely resolution of design conflicts and ensuring alignment with client operational requirements and timeline constraints. Qualifications: \#p* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, which qualifies for licensure in the state of practice, is required. * An active Professional Engineer (PE) license in the state of practice or the ability to obtain reciprocity within 6 months of employment is required. * Experience in designing low and medium voltage power distribution for normal, emergency, uninterruptible power distribution systems, and lighting systems and controls for the semiconductor, pharmaceutical, high\-tech industrial, or technically related industries. * Experience working with Navisworks, EasyPower and/or other similar programs is required. Experience with AutoCAD \& Revit programs is a plus. * Demonstrated experience performing field verifications and site walks to identify, validate, resolve, and integrate solutions into design packages. Ability to troubleshoot design problems on\-site during construction. * Professional knowledge of the National Electrical Code (NEC), as well as working knowledge of the International Building Code, International Fire Code, and NFPA guidelines. * The ability to interface with customers to define scope of work and basis of design. * Salary Range: $90,000 \- $140,000/year depending on location, education, experience, and any certifications that are directly related to the position. * Benefits include health, dental, and vision insurance, life insurance, 401K retirement savings plan (with company matching), opportunities for professional development and training, generous PTO \& paid holidays. us at SSOE, where your expertise will thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment dedicated to pushing the boundaries of design and engineering excellence. If you're passionate about innovation and eager to make a significant impact, we invite you to apply and become a part of our forward\-thinking team. hx

jobs.description: Job Posting: SCIENTIFIC AID State Water Resources Control Board JC\-534033* SCIENTIFIC AID SCIENTIFIC AID $18\.26 \- $21\.67 per Hour New to State candidates will be hired into the minimum salary of the classification or minimum of alternate range when applicable. **Final Filing Date:** **10/12/2026** **Application Methods:**Electronic (Using your CalCareer Account) By Mail Drop\-off Print Job Save Job ### **Job Description and Duties** **Please note, the Water Boards do not participate in E\-Verify.** **This position is paid on an hourly basis and limited to 1500 hours in a rolling year. The salary range for Scientific Aid is $18\.26 \- $21\.06 per hour.** The State Water Resources Control Board, Los Angeles Regional Water Quality Control Board, has an opening for a Scientific Aid in the Enforcement Unit II. The position is located at 320 West 4th Street, Suite 200, Los Angeles, CA 90013\. Under the direct supervision of a Senior Environmental Scientist (Supervisory), the Scientific Aid provides entry\-level technical, scientific, data management, field, and administrative support to professional staff in the Enforcement Unit II. The position provides an opportunity to gain practical experience in water quality protection, environmental compliance, regulatory programs, field investigations, and enforcement. The Scientific Aid will assist professional staff with reviewing environmental, scientific, and engineering technical reports; retrieving, compiling, organizing, and analyzing water quality and compliance information; maintaining regulatory and enforcement information in databases and tracking systems; conducting scientific research; and preparing routine scientific, inspection, compliance, and enforcement\-related documentation. The Scientific Aid may also accompany professional staff during inspections of regulated facilities, construction sites, waterways, and other field locations and participate in environmental sampling activities. Field assignments may include documenting site conditions using photographs, electronic tablets, GPS or other field equipment; assisting with sample collection; and organizing field and monitoring information for evaluation by professional staff. The position also provides program support through records management, public file reviews, preparation and distribution of correspondence and regulatory documents, and other activities supporting the Enforcement Unit II. **Additional information:** Candidates must possess essential personal qualifications including integrity, initiative, dependability, good judgment, the ability to work cooperatively with others, and the ability to perform the assigned duties of the class. If the position requires driving, you must possess a current and valid Driver license. Please let us know how you heard about this position by taking this brief survey: Recruitment Survey. You will find additional information about the job in the **Duty Statement**. ### **Working Conditions** **Positions at the Water Boards may be eligible for telework with in\-person attendance based on the operational needs of the position and might be expected to comply with** **Executive Order (EO) 22\-25** **after July 1, 2026\.** **In accordance with the Statewide Telework Policy and GC 14200, the successful candidate must reside in California upon appointment.
