jobs.title: Product Manager, Documentation Systems
jobs.description: **About Versapay \\uD83D\\uDE80** Versapay turns accounts receivable (AR) into a competitive advantage. Inefficient AR processes slow cash flow and stall growth. Versapay removes friction, unlocks working capital, and accelerates momentum — giving finance leaders the clarity and control they need to drive business forward. Versapay automates accounts receivable, removing barriers to collecting and reconciling B2B payments. Our solutions connect finance teams, customers, and business systems in one ecosystem to ensure cash flow clarity. With over 10,000 customers and 5M\+ companies transacting on the platform, Versapay processes over 110M transactions and $257B annually. Think you might be the next Veep to join? Read on!! **How you’ll make an impact here – and on your career:** Product management at Versapay is a craft that blends strategic thinking, customer empathy, and strong execution. As Product Manager, Documentation Systems, you will own our documentation as a product: the in\-product Help our customers rely on, the implementation and support knowledge our internal teams run on, and the systems that produce both. This is a build role. Our AI tooling can draft a help article. It cannot tell us whether that article is true, decide whether it should exist, or get an engineer to explain what shipped. You will own the pipeline that produces our documentation, the standards it runs on, and the judgment calls it cannot make. You will sit on the Product Management team as a peer to the product managers who own our platform and our embedded ERP applications. You will have modern LLM tooling, fully sanctioned and connected to our internal systems, and a mandate to build on it. ### **What you'll do:** **Own the Documentation Surface** * Own our full documentation surface: in\-product Help, implementation guides, support runbooks, and release notes, across our platform and our embedded applications. * Decide what gets documented, what gets rewritten, and what gets retired. * Build an information architecture prioritized by what customers search for and get stuck on, rather than by what shipped most recently. * Define and own the metrics: documentation shipped with the release, page freshness, Help searches returning no results, and support volume on topics we believed were covered. **Build the Documentation Pipeline** * Design and build an AI\-assisted pipeline that drafts documentation from our real sources of truth: tickets, pull requests, release artifacts, and recorded demos. * Build the evaluation process that catches the pipeline producing convincing but incorrect content before a customer does. * Automate change detection, terminology and style enforcement, screenshot capture, and publishing. * Own the toolchain. We author in MadCap Flare today and publish into a repo that our product loads. You will decide what to keep, what to automate around, and what to change. **Improve How We Capture Product Knowledge** * Our tickets today describe what we set out to build, not what we shipped, so documenting a feature currently means reverse engineering it. Change that. * Partner with Product and Engineering to establish a definition of done that captures how a feature works: navigation, permissions, configuration, error states, and impact on existing users. * Build the terminology and style standards that let both people and models write consistently across four ERP surfaces where the same concept carries four different names. **Keep Documentation True** * ERPs change their interfaces on their own schedule, and our documentation goes stale when they do. Design the detection and revalidation process and own the SLA on it. * Learn our products by using them, working out how they behave rather than reading specifications describing how they were intended to. * Write the small share of content that requires a person: migration guides, error taxonomies, and integration behaviour, where being wrong costs a customer their month\-end close. ### **What you'll bring to the team:** **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years owning an outcome rather than a queue: product management, implementation or solutions consulting, technical program management, support engineering, developer experience, or technical enablement. * Demonstrated experience automating your own work. You are comfortable in Git, on a command line, and in a codebase you did not write. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you do need to build. * Practical experience shipping something real with an LLM, including how you evaluated its output and caught it being wrong. * Direct exposure to customers in difficulty, through implementation, support escalation, solution consulting, professional services, or training. You understand why documentation can be technically correct and still fail the reader. * Ability to learn a complex product without a specification, and to remember what confused you while learning it. * Proven ability to influence product managers and engineers you do not manage. * Comfort saying no. This is one person against a large surface, and prioritization is most of the job. ### **What Will Make You Stand Out (Nice to Have)** * It would be beneficial to have worked with MadCap Flare before, as it is what we author in today. * Deep familiarity with at least one complex enterprise system is preferred, such as an ERP or accounting platform, and an appetite to learn more. * Experience with docs\-as\-code or CI\-driven publishing. * B2B fintech, payments, or accounts receivable exposure. * You have built an internal tool that other people came to depend on. \#LI\-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About this role:** Within COO Technology, Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Data Engineer to help shape and scale our cloud‑native data ecosystem. In this role, you will focus on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services and frameworks, leading the design, build, and operation of reusable data capabilities that power analytics and AI at enterprise scale. The ideal candidate is passionate about standardized frameworks, self‑service data platforms, and governance‑by‑design, enabling secure, reliable, and compliant data solutions across Google Cloud services. The COO Technology group powers the firm’s most critical operations by modernizing and optimizing enterprise technology platforms that enable resiliency, regulatory excellence, data services, customer experience, and strategic execution across the Chief Operating Office. **In this role, you will:** * Design and implement scalable, secure data platforms on Google Cloud using managed services (BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Composer).) * Build reusable frameworks and tooling (ingestion, transformation, quality, orchestration) that can be adopted by multiple product and domain teams. * Enable self‑service data consumption and governance by standardizing patterns, templates, and platform capabilities rather than one‑off pipelines. * Design logical and physical data platform architectures leveraging BigQuery, Dataflow/Apache Beam, Dataproc/Spark, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Storage. * Define and implement standardized ingestion, transformation, and serving patterns (batch and streaming) as reusable blueprints. * Optimize cost, performance, and reliability of GCP data workloads (partitioning, clustering, storage classes, autoscaling strategies). * Build opinionated data ingestion frameworks (e.g., config‑driven pipelines, connectors, schema handling, error handling) on top of Dataflow, Dataproc, or Composer. * Develop shared transformation libraries in Python/SQL/Beam (e.g., common SCD patterns, data quality checks, masking/tokenization routines). * Provide orchestration capabilities via Cloud Composer or Cloud Workflows with reusable DAGs/templates and CI/CD integration. * Implement robust data modeling (dimensional, data vault, or canonical models) and semantic layers in BigQuery and related tools. * Enforce data quality, lineage, and observability using standardized metrics, validation rules, and monitoring dashboards. * Apply security and governance controls: IAM, VPC‑SC, CMEK, row/column‑level security, and policy‑driven access patterns * Partner with domain data engineers, analytics, and ML teams to onboard use cases onto platform services and frameworks * Document patterns, runbooks, and best practices, and provide enablement through workshops and code examples. * Contribute to platform roadmap, tool selection, and evaluation of new GCP services and open‑source components **Required Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of Database Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education * 5\+ years of data management experience within Public Cloud (GCP, AWS, Azure) * 5\+ years of hands on experience of Python or Java, plus Spark SQL for building data pipelines, libraries, and automation tooling. * 5\+ years with orchestration tools (Cloud Composer/Airflow) and CI/CD (Cloud Build, Git‑based workflows) for data workloads **Desired Qualifications:** * Experience with logging/monitoring stacks (Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, error reporting, metrics dashboards * Experience with automated testing, data quality checks, and monitoring for pipelines and platform services. * Knowledge of cloud architecture principles (networking, security, IAM, reliability, cost management). * Experience with core GCP data services: BigQuery, Dataflow/Apache Beam, Dataproc, Pub/Sub. * Experience with Agile transformations and technology roadmaps. * Experience working with onshore and offshore teams. **Job Expectations:** * Flexible to provide both application development and production support during off\-hours * This role is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship * Hybrid schedule (3 days in office, 2 days remote) * Work Transparently: You always deal in an honest, direct, and transparent way * Take Ownership: You embrace responsibility and find joy in having the answers * Learn More: You regularly self\-educate and improve your skill set **Job Posting Locations:** 300 S Brevard St., CHARLOTTE, North Carolina 28202 401 Las Colinas Blvd W Bldg A, Irving, Texas 75039 **Posting End Date:** 4 Oct 2026* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.*** **We Value Equal Opportunity** Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic. Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance\-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements. Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process. **Applicants with Disabilities** To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo. **Drug and Alcohol Policy** Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more. **Wells Fargo Recruitment and Hiring Requirements:** a. Third\-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo. b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Application Development
jobs.description: Choose To Make A Difference: **Summary** Reporting to the Director, Applications Development in a multi\-faceted, multi\-location academic setting, the Sr. Manager, Application Development provides hands\-on technical and people leadership across web application engineering, AI\-enabled solutions, and application portfolio management for American Career College, West Coast University, and Administration. This role partners closely with the Director to translate institutional strategy into practical technology delivery, driving measurable outcomes that enhance student, faculty, and staff experiences. The Sr. Manager collaborates with global development teams, academic leaders, Information Technology pillar owners, and operations to ensure solutions are architected well, built to standard, and delivered on time. The role leads end\-to\-end solution design efforts, brings deep Azure platform expertise, and champions an AI\-first mindset in all aspects of development. Conducts periodic reviews of the application portfolio and contributes to building business cases for enhancing technology necessary to anticipate institutional needs, enhance stability, and/or improve price/performance. **Essential Functions \& Responsibilities** * Solution Design and Architecture \- Lead end\-to\-end solution design for complex application initiatives; evaluate and recommend architectural patterns aligned with institutional goals. Produce design artifacts including architecture diagrams, solution overviews, technical specifications, and API contracts. Partner with enterprise architects and the Director to ensure alignment with the broader technology roadmap. * Azure Platform Expertise and Cloud Engineering \- Serve as the team's Azure subject matter expert; drive adoption of Azure PaaS services including App Service, Functions, API Management, Service Bus/Event Grid, Key Vault, Application Insights, Azure SQL/Cosmos DB, and AKS/containers. Champion Infrastructure as Code (Bicep/Terraform) and CI/CD practices (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps). Guide teams on cloud cost optimization, scalability patterns, and reliability engineering. * AI\-First Development Leadership \- Embed an AI\-first mindset across all development practices; identify and prioritize opportunities to integrate AI/ML capabilities into existing and new applications. Deliver AI\-enabled experiences using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, vector stores, and Azure Machine Learning. Establish AI application development patterns, prompt engineering practices, model evaluation, telemetry, and Responsible AI guardrails in collaboration with Security, Legal, and Compliance. * Global Team Collaboration \- Manage and collaborate effectively with geographically distributed development teams across multiple time zones; establish clear communication rhythms, shared standards, and asynchronous workflows that support global team productivity. Foster inclusive team culture and equitable participation across locations. Coordinate delivery across onshore, offshore, and nearshore resources. * Hands\-On Technical Leadership \- Provide day\-to\-day technical direction; PR/code reviews, lead design reviews, and unblock complex engineering problems. Set and uphold engineering standards: coding practices, testing, performance, security, documentation, and accessibility (WCAG 2\.2\). Lead development of React/TypeScript front ends and .NET 8/ASP.NET Core APIs and microservices. * Web and Application Delivery \- Oversee delivery of web applications and services that meet quality, performance, resiliency, and scalability standards. Manage sprint execution, release planning, and delivery commitments across teams. Ensure accessibility, security, and compliance requirements are built into every delivery cycle. * Integration and Enterprise Platforms \- Support API\-first integration with SIS/ERP/CRM/HCM and LMS ecosystems (e.g., CampusNexus/CampusVue, Salesforce, Oracle HCM, etc.). Implement data and event integration patterns; partner with Data/Analytics on cloud data management platforms (eg. Databricks/Synapse/Fabric) where applicable. * DevSecOps, Reliability, and Compliance \- Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated quality gates, and environment management. Embed security and privacy by design: SAST/DAST/secrets scanning, RBAC/least privilege with Entra ID, FERPA/PCI considerations. Support observability practices using Application Insights/OpenTelemetry; participate in incident response and problem management. * People Leadership and Communication \- Hire, develop, and coach engineers and technical leads; foster an inclusive, high\-accountability team culture. Communicate effectively across audiences — stakeholder demos, written status updates, and technical deep dives. Partner with vendors and managed service providers to define SLAs and govern delivery quality. **Minimum and Preferred Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, electronics engineering, voice/data communications, public/business administration, or a related field required. * Master's degree in computer science, information systems, electronics engineering, voice/data communications, public/business administration, or a related field preferred. **Experience \& Skills** * 10\+ years of progressive experience in application development, including at least 3 years in people management or team lead capacity. * Proven experience collaborating with global or distributed development teams across multiple time zones and geographies. * Strong solution design and architecture experience: ability to produce design artifacts, evaluate architectural patterns, and guide teams from concept through implementation. * Deep Azure expertise: hands\-on proficiency with Azure PaaS (App Service, Functions, API Management, Service Bus/Event Grid, Key Vault, Application Insights, Azure SQL/Cosmos DB); experience with AKS/containers, CI/CD (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps), and Infrastructure as Code (Bicep/Terraform). * AI\-first mindset with demonstrated experience delivering AI\-enabled applications using Azure OpenAI/OpenAI APIs, Azure AI Search, vector stores, and Responsible AI practices. Ability to identify AI integration opportunities across the application portfolio and drive adoption of AI tooling in day\-to\-day development workflows. * Hands\-on expertise with React and TypeScript; modern front\-end build tooling. Proficiency in .NET 6\-10, ASP.NET Core, RESTful APIs, and integration patterns. * Demonstrates a high level of understanding of enterprise architecture discipline and has working knowledge of current and planned Information Technology systems portfolio. * Exceptional communication skills: able to translate technical concepts into business outcomes for diverse audiences including executives, faculty, and partners. * Experience with CampusVue, Salesforce CRM, Oracle HCM, and Great Plains desired, but not required. (Preferred) * Previous experience with higher education strongly preferred. * Ability to manage and work effectively in a highly ethnic and culturally diverse student and associate community. * Excellent analytical and organizational skills. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. This position will support network services for the LAN and WAN infrastructure including Palo Alto firewalls, Cisco routers, and switches and Arista wireless infrastructure. Detail oriented with the ability to work with minimum supervision, and thoughtful customer service. Availability to be on\-call for periodic tasks outside of normal working hours. Able to travel. The Senior Network Engineer is also responsible for recommending and implementing best security and performance practices for continued improvement to the network infrastructure. * This is an in\-office position designated to work 5 days a week from our Salt Lake City headquarters. **Responsibilities** * Manages and supports LAN and WAN network devices. * Manages and supports Internet access and security appliances. * Manages and supports remote and wireless access. * Tests and evaluates network systems to eliminate problems and make improvements. * Escalates network problems to appropriate vendors and/or internal personnel. * Manages technology planning through ongoing research and consulting. * Architects, plans, implements and supports the voice, data, and wireless network and computing infrastructure. * Performs other job\-related duties as assigned. * Knowledge of switching (Capacity Planning \& VLAN’s) and routing (OSPF, EIGRP, BGP) * Knowledge of WAN Technology (MPLS, VPLS, VPN) and Voice Technology (VOIP, QOS, SIP) * Skilled at large scale wireless deployments. * Ability to use security software, including anti\-virus, anti\-spam, and anti\-spyware. * Knowledgeable in application transport and network infrastructure protocols (SSL/TLS, DNS, DHCP, WINS, NTP, FTP, HTTP, SMTP, CIFS, LDAP, and Microsoft AD) and possesses an understanding of how to support these applications/protocols when accessed through VPN and firewall appliances. * Deep understanding of load balancing technologies (F5, ELB) and network automation (Cisco ACI, VRO) * Knowledge of VMware and/or Hyper\-V for server virtualization * Knowledge and experience with IPv4, IPv6, TCP, HSRP/GLBP, IPSEC, VPN, DNS, and HTTP * Energetic self\-starter * Ability to work with minimum supervision * Thorough and detail oriented * Ability to be ‘on\-call’ for period tasks outside of normal working hours. * Ability to travel * Knowledge of power management * Must be able to lift 30lbs * Experience with cross connection and rack management **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. (Equivalent relevant experience performing the essential functions of this job may substitute for education degree requirements. Internal WGU employees will need to apply through the internal job board in Workday. **Additional Information** Disclaimer: The job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job. It’s not all\-inclusive. Accommodations: Applicants with disabilities who require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process should contact our Talent Acquisition team at recruiting@wgu.edu. Equal Employment Opportunity: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic as required by law.

and/or mentor interns, graduate engineers, and design technicians **Skills and Qualifications:** * Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering or Renewable Engineering Program * Knowledge of NEC and NESC * Knowledge and proficiency in the use of an electrical power system modeling program(s) * Approximately 3\-7 years of experience in the design of electrical distribution, generation, and or general electrical construction * Working knowledge and ability to read and create construction drawings and specification packages * Proficiency with Microsoft Office products * Professional appearance with excellent written and verbal communications skills, including ability to write detailed technical reports with minimal oversite * Experience with progress reports, managing project data and communicating project requirements to internal stakeholders. * Must have a strong work ethic along with a positive attitude * Must be a supportive team member, able to work in a collaborative environment * Must be self\-motivated with an ability to balance multiple projects under tight deadlines with minimal supervision * Ability to use AutoCAD in at least a limited capacity For Preferred Consideration (Not Required): * Experience and knowledge of overall design and construction of renewable power projects * Experience with EV Chargers * Experience in lighting design and photometrics analysis using AGI32 or Visual Lighting * Proficiency in AutoCAD Civil 3D * Electrical PE License or ability to be licensed in the future * Experience with energy storage systems (battery, flywheel, or capacitor) * Experience with ETAP, CYMCAP, WinIGS, and/or DigSilent, PowerFactory to model electrical power systems and perform load flow, short circuit, voltage drop, grounding, thermal, and center design * Experience with PSS/E, PSCAD, EMTP, or similar software and performing transient/dynamic modeling and studies or power systems **For Preferred Consideration (Not Required):** * licensed in multiple states * Experience with energy storage systems (battery, flywheel, or capacitor) * Proficiency with ETAP, CYMCAP, WinIGS, and/or DigSilent PowerFactory to model electrical power systems and perform load flow, short circuit, voltage drop, grounding, thermal, and protective device coordination studies and analysis. * Experience with PVsyst, Helioscope, SAM, or other PV production modeling software * Experience with Helios 3D. (Westwood)** At Westwood, our purpose is to create a better world for people through our work. jobs.title: IT Engineer - Salesforce
jobs.description: **Primary Objective of Position**: The Salesforce Engineer owns the design, delivery, integration, administration, and optimization of the Winnebago Motorhome Salesforce platform. This techno\-functional role translates business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions, supports enterprise integrations, and presents solution strategy, risks, and recommendations to senior leaders to enable informed decision\-making. **Key Areas of Responsibility** **Project Delivery \& Development** * Design, develop, test, and deploy Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flow, and platform capabilities. * Lead technical delivery of Salesforce projects from requirements through deployment. * Support integrations using MuleSoft, APIs, Platform Events, and other enterprise integration technologies. * Participate in architecture and design reviews, providing recommendations for scalable, secure, and maintainable Salesforce solutions. * Operate independently through ambiguous or complex work, balancing business priorities, technical constraints, and delivery timelines. * Support Agile planning, estimation, and sprint execution. * Conduct code reviews and enforce development standards. * Manage Salesforce environments, deployments, source control, and CI/CD processes. **Application Support** * Troubleshoot and resolve complex application issues and provide advanced user support. * Partner with stakeholders to prioritize defects, enhancements, and continuous improvement opportunities based on business impact. * Apply techno\-functional expertise to understand business processes, assess platform impacts, and recommend practical Salesforce solutions. * Maintain Salesforce security, data integrity, and system performance. **Continuous Improvement** * Identify opportunities to improve business processes through automation and platform enhancements. * Develop and maintain technical documentation, testing artifacts, and solution designs. * Train and mentor designated business users and citizen administrators on approved Salesforce configuration, data management and administrative activities. * Promote Salesforce best practices, governance standards, and user adoption across the organization. * Evaluate new Salesforce releases, features, and emerging technologies for business value and platform optimization. * Generate test plans, create test cases, and maintain changes in appropriate test environments. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Critical Competencies** * Strong experience with Salesforce Platform development including Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flow, and Lightning Experience. * Experience implementing enterprise integrations using MuleSoft, REST APIs, Platform Events, and middleware technologies. * Proficiency in SOQL, SQL, and data analysis techniques. * Proficiency with Salesforce DX, Git, Azure DevOps, JIRA, Gearset, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps best practices. * Strong understanding of Salesforce security model, sharing, permissions, and governance. * Experience leading technical project delivery and mentoring development teams. * Excellent problem solving, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis skills. * Strong communication skills, including the ability to translate technical topics for business stakeholders and senior leaders. * Ability to present solution options, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations clearly to cross\-functional teams and senior leadership audiences. * Knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Industry Clouds (such as Automotive Cloud) preferred. * Ability to evaluate Salesforce platform features and emerging technologies for practical business value. **Education \& Experience** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience. * 5\-8\+ years Salesforce application development experience. * Working knowledge of Salesforce administration, configuration, security, and data management. * Salesforce Platform Developer I certification preferred. Salesforce Administrator, Platform Developer II, App Builder, and MuleSoft certifications are a plus. * Experience designing and implementing Salesforce solutions utilizing Flow, MuleSoft, APIs, and event\-driven architectures. * Experience leading projects and providing technical guidance to development teams. * Experience working within Agile software delivery environments. This posting includes a range of the salary across a geographical market. The base pay for this position ranges from $120,000\.00/year in our lowest geographic market up to $130,000\.00/year in our highest geographic market. Pay is based on a number of factors including market location, internal equity, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Dependent on the position other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits. For more information, please visit https://www.winnebagoind.com/careers/total\-rewards.

jobs.description: Wintrust provides community and commercial banking, specialty finance and wealth management services through its 16 bank charters and nine non\-bank businesses. Wintrust delivers the sophisticated solutions of a large bank while staying true to the relationship\-focused, personalized service of our community banking roots. We serve clients in all 50 states with more than 200 branch banking locations in Illinois, southwestern Florida, northwestern Indiana, west Michigan and southern Wisconsin and commercial banking offices in Chicago, Denver, Milwaukee, Grand Rapids, Mich., and in key branch banking locations throughout Illinois. Our people are the heart of our business and we are proud to rank consistently as a top place to work. Wintrust is a $66 billion financial institution based in Rosemont, Illinois, and listed on the NASDAQ Global Select Market under the symbol “WTFC.” **Why join us?** * An award\-winning culture! We are rated a Top Workplace by the Chicago Tribune (past 12 years) and Employee Recommended award by the Globe \& Mail (past 6 years) * Competitive pay and discretionary or incentive bonus eligible * Comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental, vision, life, a 401k plan with a generous company match and tuition reimbursement to name a few * Promote from within culture **Why join this team?** * This position has the opportunity to interface with and have a positive impact on multiple areas of Wintrust's business * We hold ourselves accountable to high standards, share wins, operate ethically, and have fun **Position Overview** The Senior Identity Access Management Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining critical security systems within the Identity domain. This role serves as the subject matter expert (SME) focused on privileged access management and NHI. regressions, flaky hardware, and infrastructure issues. * Develop automated methods to identify which merges cause failures in long\-running test suites. * Evaluate and integrate AI techniques practices, including versioning schemes, independent component release trains, and compatibility matrices. * Reduce developer toil and time\-to\-signal across the product, dev, test, and release pipeline. * Partner with development groups and Quality Engineering to drive adoption of new tooling and best practices. ### **What You Will Bring** * Track record of building automation that measurably reduced toil or time\-to\-signal in a CI, release, or dev\-tooling context. * Release engineering experience, including versioning schemes, independent component release trains, and compatibility matrices. * Architectural judgment on trade\-offs such as AI versus deterministic software, and compute availability versus data locality. * Strong software engineering fundamentals, perspective. * Hands\-on experience with containerized workloads, VMs, and Kubernetes. * Experience with observability of distributed systems, including metrics, logging, reporting, and alerting. * jobs.title: Research Scientist – Neural 3D Objects
jobs.description: ### **About Mecka AI** Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI. We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware\-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems. We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real\-world data, simulation, learning\-based systems, and deployed hardware. **About the role** ------------------ We're looking for a **neural objects researcher** to own the architecture for generating 3D objects from video. Given egocentric footage of someone manipulating an object, you build the models that recover its geometry — and, ultimately, a simulatable asset with the physical properties to drop into a physics simulator. You'll own the hardest, most open part of the objects effort: reconstructing objects that are small in frame, partly occluded by the hand, and sometimes deformable. You'll push the frontier, then hand results to the integrations researcher who takes them into the production pipeline. **This is a research role for someone who wants an open, unsolved problem** on real, large\-scale data — not a fully\-specified spec. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Neural 3D reconstruction.** Models that recover object geometry from monocular / egocentric video — sequential and multi\-view approaches robust to occlusion and low resolution. * **Generative refinement.** Use generative 3D to complete and clean up partial reconstructions while rejecting hallucinated geometry. * **Toward simulatable objects.** Move beyond geometry toward assets that carry physical properties and rigging, so a reconstructed object can be simulated, not just rendered. * **Contact\-aware reconstruction.** Use hand contact as a signal to constrain object shape and pose where the hand touches the object. * **Deformables.** Take on the genuinely hard frontier — objects that change shape as they're handled. * **Prototype \& hand off.** Build research prototypes and hand them to the integrations researcher for productization; publish where it makes sense. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * **Strong 3D / neural\-reconstruction research.** Neural implicit or explicit 3D, 4D reconstruction, or generative 3D — you've worked at this frontier. * **Deep\-learning depth.** You design and train models, and can read and reproduce frontier papers. * **3D geometry foundation.** Structure\-from\-motion / multi\-view geometry, meshes, and differentiable rendering. * **Research taste.** You can find the tractable decomposition of a hard, open problem and make steady progress on it. * **Engineering to match.** You prototype fast in clean Python / PyTorch and can get a research idea working on real data. **Strong plus** --------------- * Generative 3D (diffusion / feed\-forward 3D\-generation families). * Differentiable rendering, NeRF, or Gaussian splatting. * 4D / dynamic\-scene reconstruction from video. * Physics simulation and rigging — turning geometry into a simulatable asset. * Hand\-object interaction; publications at top vision or graphics venues. **Tech stack** -------------- * Python / PyTorch (primary) for model design and training. * 3D deep learning — neural implicit / explicit representations, differentiable rendering. * Generative\-3D toolkits; mesh processing (Open3D, trimesh). * Physics simulators for the path from geometry to simulatable object. The exact stack matters less than depth in 3D deep learning and the judgment to make progress on an open problem. **How this role fits —** you own neural 3D object generation: reconstructing manipulated objects from monocular egocentric video, including the hard cases — heavy occlusion, low resolution, and deformable objects — and pushing toward objects that carry the physical properties needed to be simulated. This is an architecture\-level research role that sets the direction the objects team builds on. **What success looks like** --------------------------- * Manipulated objects reconstruct from egocentric video at usable quality — including small, occluded, and deformable cases. * A credible path exists from interaction video to a simulatable 3D object. * Your research transfers into the pipeline through the integrations seat, not just into papers. * The objects pod builds on the architecture and direction you set. **Who this role is not for** ---------------------------- * Applied\-only engineers who don't want open\-ended research. * Researchers who need a fully\-specified problem handed to them. * Anyone without a 3D and deep\-learning foundation. **Why this role at Mecka** -------------------------- * Define how a company turns everyday manipulated objects into simulatable 3D assets. * Own an open, high\-impact research problem on real, large\-scale egocentric data. * A clear path from research to product through a dedicated integrations seat. * Direct impact on the data that trains real robots. **A Note on Applying** ---------------------- Studies show women and candidates from underrepresented groups often only apply when they meet 100% of the listed qualifications, while others apply after meeting 60%. If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match. **Inclusive Hiring at Mecka** We are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive candidate experience. Should you require any accommodation whatsoever during the interview process, please inform us without any hesitation. Mecka is dedicated to ensuring equal treatment and opportunity in all phases of recruitment, selection, and employment, in compliance with employment law. We do not discriminate based on gender, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, disability, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other protected category. Mecka is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, fostering a culture of inclusivity and maintaining a work environment that is free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. **Use of Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment** Mecka uses artificial intelligence (AI) responsibly to support administrative and efficiency\-focused aspects of our recruitment process. This includes activities such as drafting job descriptions, generating interview questions, note\-taking and recordings, and supporting sourcing and scheduling workflows. All candidate evaluations, interviews, and hiring decisions are made by members of the Mecka team. While AI tools may assist with screening and assessment, they do not replace human judgment in selection decisions. Our use of AI is intended to streamline routine tasks, improve consistency, and enhance the overall candidate experience. We are committed to upholding principles of fairness, transparency, and accountability in all hiring activities. Mecka regularly reviews its recruitment practices to mitigate bias and to ensure alignment with applicable laws and evolving best practices. Compensation Range: CA$200K \- CA$230K
